texts.name: Sanhua
texts.skillDisplay: Basic Combo：Basic Attack*2 → Resonance Skill → Hold - Basic Attack (Charge) → Resonance Liberation → Echo Skill → Outro Skill

baseTexts.roleDescription:
1. Sanhua is a Glacio sub-DPS focused on Resonance Skill DMG.
2. Sanhua has exceptional Concerto Energy generation.
3. Sanhua's Outro Skill boosts the Basic Attack DMG of the next character.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
1. Tip: Intro Skill, Resonance Skill, Resonance Liberation. This leaves behind [Ice Thorn], [Ice Prism], and [Glacier]. Hold Basic Attack, and release when the pointer hits the [Frostbite] zone to trigger [Ice Thorn], [Ice Prism], and [Glacier].
2. Rotation: E-R-H-Q.
3. Team Comp: The most suitable main DPS is Camellya. The team setup of Camellya + Sanhua + Shorekeeper/Verina/Baizhi works well. Please refer to the full guide for team rotation.

baseTexts.introductionDetail:
Skill Breakdown
1. Forte Circuit
When Basic Attack is held, a pointer moves across the energy bar. Release Basic Attack within the Forte Gauge [Frostbite] zone to unleash Heavy Attack Detonate (counts as Heavy Attack DMG).
● Heavy Attack Detonate detonates [Ice Thorn], [Ice Prism], and [Glacier] within range, dealing Glacio DMG (counts as Resonance Skill DMG).
● [Frostbite] Expansion: Each 1 stack of [Clarity] widens the [Frostbite] zone. Max 2 stacks.
● [Clarity] Gain: 5th Basic Attack hit, Intro Skill, Resonance Skill, Resonance Liberation. Using Heavy Attack Detonate consumes all [Clarity] stacks.
2. Resonance Liberation
Deal Glacio DMG, leave behind [Glacier].
3. Resonance Skill
Deal Glacio DMG, summon 1 [Ice Prism].
4. Normal Attack
● Basic Attack: up to 5-hit combo.
● Heavy Attack: Consumes STA to attack.
● Mid-air Attack: Consumes STA to perform a Plunging Attack.
● Dodge Counter: Triggered by dodging and shortly tapping Basic Attack.
5. Intro Skill
Deal Glacio DMG, leave behind 1 [Ice Thorn].
6. Outro Skill
Increase Basic Attack DMG of the next character.

Team Comp Analysis:
Sanhua’s Outro Skill increases the Basic Attack DMG of the next character, making her ideal for teams centered around Basic Attack main DPS.

Team Comp & Rotation:
In the following rotations: A = Basic Attack; H = Heavy Attack; E = Resonance Skill; R = Resonance Liberation; Q = Echo Skill.

● Cantarella + Sanhua + Shorekeeper/Verina/Baizhi
① Sanhua starts with ERH, not fully stacking Concerto Energy.
② Healer quickly fully charges Concerto Energy.
③ Sanhua re-enters with Intro Skill. Use EHQ to max out Concerto Energy.
④ Cantarella enters with Intro Skill. ERZ - Enhanced EQHE to achieve full Concerto Energy and swap out.
⑤ Repeat.

● Changli + Sanhua + Brant
Sanhua buffs Basic Attack DMG for Brant. Brant provides DPS, healing, and shielding, while boosting Changli’s Fusion and Resonance Skill DMG.
① Changli starts with EA, not fully stacking Concerto Energy.
② Sanhua ERHA to achieve full Concerto Energy.
③ Brant enters with Intro Skill, uses R-H-H, then enhanced E to achieve full Concerto Energy and leave the field.
④ Changli re-enters with Intro Skill, A-EA-EA, H (4 Enflamement stacks) + R + H (4 Enflamement stacks), achieve full Concerto Energy, swap out.
⑤ Repeat.

● Camellya + Sanhua + Shorekeeper/Verina/Baizhi
Sanhua increases Camellya's Basic Attack DMG, with the survival role offering healing or DMG bonus.
① Start with Camellya using E.
② Switch to Sanhua and use ERH without fully charging Concerto Energy.
③ Healer quickly fully charges Concerto Energy.
④ Bring in Camellya for Intro Skill. Use Basic Attack, but don’t max out Concerto Energy.
⑤ Switch to Sanhua EHQ to achieve full Concerto Energy;
⑥ Camellya re-enters with Intro Skill, uses Basic Attack fully charging Concerto Energy. Activates enhanced E + Basic Attack, fully charging Concerto Energy again. Leaves the field.

baseTexts.roleDescription: Zhezhi is a Glacio sub-DPS/Support who provides off-field off-field Coordinated Attacks with Resonance Liberation. Her Outro Skill increases Glacio DMG and Resonance Skill DMG for the next character.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
Core Mechanics: [Afflatus] & [Phantasmic Imprint]
[Afflatus]: Max 90 points. Every 30 points summons one [Phantasmic Imprint] (up to 3) Cast [Resonance Skill - Manifestation]. Consumes 60 [Afflatus] to summon [Phantasmic Imprint - Left] and [Phantasmic Imprint - Right]. Casting [Heavy Attack - Conjuration] consumes 30 [Afflatus] to summon 1 [Phantasmic Imprint - Middle].
[Afflatus] Gain: Normal Attack/Intro Skill
[Phantasmic Imprint]: When a [Phantasmic Imprint] is present, Zhezhi's E is enhanced, consuming one [Phantasmic Imprint] to summon a Ivory Herald that deals DMG (considered Basic Attack DMG) while granting 1 stack of [Painter's Delight]. If a [Phantasmic Imprint] is present and [Painter's Delight] reaches 2 stacks, Zhezhi's E is further enhanced. Consumes all [Painter's Delight] stacks and all [Phantasmic Imprints] to summon a Ivory Herald that deals higher DMG (considered Basic Attack DMG) while increasing Zhezhi's Basic Attack DMG.
baseTexts.introductionDescription: Team Comp Analysis: Zhezhi provides Coordinated Attacks and boosts Glacio DMG and Resonance Skill DMG, making her a great fit for Glacio and Resonance Skill-based main DPS.

texts.name: Manifestation
texts.description:
Deal Glacio DMG. If Afflatus is no less than 60, consume 60 Afflatus to summon Phantasmic Imprint - Left and Phantasmic Imprint - Right.

-Press the button on the ground to summon the Phantasmic Imprints on the ground.

texts.name: Ink and Wash
texts.description:
Phantasmic Imprint

Zhezhi may summon Phantasmic Imprints at the cost of Afflatus when casting Resonance Skill Manifestation or Heavy Attack Conjuration.

Up to 1 of each of Phantasmic Imprint - Left, Phantasmic Imprint - Middle, and Phantasmic Imprint - Right can exist at the same time, each lasting for 15s.



Heavy Attack - Conjuration

The 5 moves below consume STA to perform Conjuration to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG.

-Hold the Normal Attack button shortly after Basic Attack Stage 3.

-Press the Normal Attack button shortly after casting Resonance Skill Manifestation.

-Hold the Normal Attack button shortly after casting Resonance Skill Stroke of Genius or Resonance Skill Creation's Zenith.

-Hold the Normal Attack button while in mid-air.

-Hold the Normal Attack button after a successful Dodge.

If Zhezhi has at least 30 Afflatus when performing any of these, consume 30 Afflatus to summon a Phantasmic Imprint - Middle.



Resonance Skill - Stroke of Genius

When a Phatasmic Imprint is nearby, the Resonance Skill is replaced with Stroke of Genius, which can be cast while in mid-air. When it is cast, Zhezhi will:

-Move to the location of the Phatasmic Imprint, remove it, and then summon an Ivory Herald to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG, considered as Basic Attack DMG. Refresh the mid-air Dodge attempts if the target Phatasmic Imprint is in mid-air.

-Gain 1 stack of Painter's Delight, lasting for 8s and stacking up to 2 times.



Resonance Skill - Creation's Zenith

When a Phantasmic Imprint is nearby and there are 2 stacks of Painter's Delight, Stroke of Genius is replaced with Creation's Zenith, which can be cast while in mid-air. When it is cast, Zhezhi will:

-Lose all stacks of Painter's Delight

-Move to the location of the Phantasmic Imprint, remove it, and then summon an Ivory Herald to attack the target, dealing greater Glacio DMG, considered as Basic Attack DMG, additionally increasing the Basic Attack DMG Bonus by 18% for 27s. Refresh the mid-air Dodge attempts if the target Phatasmic Imprint is in mid-air.



Afflatus

Zhezhi can hold up to 90 Afflatus.

Normal Attacks grant Afflatus on hit.

Casting Intro Skill grants Afflatus.

weaponTexts.recommendDescription:
● Rime-Draped Sprouts: Zhezhi‘s BIS 5-star weapon. It provides Crit. DMG as a sub-stat, easing Crit. Rate & Crit. DMG balancing. Its passive consistently boosts ATK and stacks ATK buffs upon effect activation. It also enhances Basic Attack DMG when off-field, making it a perfect fit for Zhezhi’s role and playstyle.
● Stringmaster: The best alternative if signature weapon is unavailable. It provides Crit. Rate, helping balance Crit. Rate & Crit. DMG stats, and its passive grants an Attribute DMG bonus. It also boosts ATK and further increases ATK when the user is off-field, aligning well with Zhezhi’s rotation.
● Cosmic Ripples: A standard 5-star weapon that also synergizes well with Zhezhi. It boosts ATK as a sub-stat, offers a stable Energy Regen bonus to optimize Resonance Liberation rotation, and increases Basic Attack DMG, making it a strong alternative for Zhezhi.
● Augment: Provides Crit. Rate as a sub-stat and boosts ATK upon effect activation. It aligns decently with Zhezhi’s playstyle.

roleResonanceTexts.recommendDescription:
Carlotta's 1st Sequence "Beauty Blazes Brightest Before It Fades" is a significant quality of life improvement. The additional 30 points of Substance allows for smoother and faster rotations, while alleviating the possible downtime from her signature weapon, "The Last Dance" when building Substance. Carlotta also receives a 12.5% Crit Rate boost when dealing DMG to targets inflicted with Deconstruction. With Carlotta's Inherent Skill "Ars Gratia Artis", this will provide a 12.5% Crit Rate boost for all of Carlotta's significant attacks. With enough Crit Rate from echo substats and this sequence unlocked, Carlotta can equip a Crit DMG 4-COST Echo instead of a Crit Rate 4-COST Echo.

Carlotta's 3rd Sequence, "Adelante, Cortado, Spinning in Grace", is the second most significant damage increase for Calotta. The additional instance of damage from Carlotta's Outro Skill has a high damage multiplier, and Carlotta's Resonance Skill ability deals increased damage.

Carlotta's final sequence, "As the Curtain Falls, I Remain What I Am", is Carlotta's most significant damage increase. This sequence will immobilize enemies from Death Knell attacks while providing significantly increased damage.

weaponTexts.recommendDescription:
Carlotta's signature weapon, "The Last Dance" R1/R5 provides 48%/96% Res. Skill DMG Bonus as well as a fixed ATK% increase. Her Forte attack "Imminent Oblivion" and all Res. Liberation attacks are considered Res. Skill DMG, allowing Carlotta to maximise both the weapon potential and her own.

Carlotta's 1st alternative option, "Static Mist" R1/R5 provides a valuable Crit. Rate increase and the highest base attack increase. Although the passive does not increase Carlotta's personal damage, the 12.%/25.6% Energy Regen boost for Carlotta allows for smoother and more reliable rotations.

Carlotta's 2nd alternative option, "Thunderbolt" R1/R5 can only be obtained via the Pioneer Podcast. This weapon provides a total of 21%/69% Res. Skill DMG Bonus for Carlotta, but requires Basic Attacks or Heavy Attacks to activate this passive. Pressing `Basic Attack` while in Carlotta's `Twilight Tango` state will not activate the passive.

baseTexts.roleDescription:
Hiyuki, a member of the Special Response Force, is the embodiment of icy purity.
The wishes entrusted to her in her brief encounters with others drive her on, carving a path forward.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
Hiyuki is a Glacio-Sword-wielding main DPS character. She utilizes the negative status, Glacio Chafe, in a unique way.

Most of Hiyuki's damage is considered Resonance Liberation Damage.
baseTexts.introductionDescription: Hiyuki will gain 1 stack of Snowforged Blade when outside of combat for 4 seconds, so it's best to wait 4 seconds before starting modes like Tower of Adversity.
baseTexts.introductionDetail:
Hiyuki is a character who utilizes Glacio Chafe throughout her kit. She has a unique passive that converts Glacio Chafe, into Glacio Bite, which is considered Glacio Chafe.

When Glacio Bite is inflicted, the target will take an instance of Glacio Bite DMG until the max stack is reached, which is 10. Hiyuki starts combat in Present Self State. When she uses her Basic Attack 3, she will gain 100 dedication, maxing out at 300. When she cast her Resonance Skill, she will gain an additional 100 dedication. Once her forte is maxed, she will be able to cast Forclaimed Self by using her Resonance Liberation.

Once she is in the Forclaimed Self state, her Forte Bar changes. Casting Basic Attacks will fill up her Forte. Her Resonance Skill will now be upgraded, putting Hiyuki in the air to follow up with Basic Attacks. When her Forte is 1/3 full, she is able to cast Iai when you Dodge, followed up with Basic Attack. Each cast of Iai is cast, Hiyuki will gain one stack of Whiteout Bitterfrost.

Once she has 3 stacks, she is able to cast her enhanced Forte with a Heavy Attack, Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self, dealing significant Resonance Liberation Damage. She will also gain one stack of Snowforged Blade. Hiyuki can hold 3 stacks of Snowforged Blade, and each stack will power up Hiyuki's Enhanced Resonance Liberation.

She also gains 1 stack when she is out of combat for more than 4 seconds. When you hold down the Resonance Liberation, she will consume each stack of Snowforged Blade to increase the damage of her Resonance Liberation. Hiyuki's Outro Skill will amplify Glacio damage that hits targets affected by Glacio Chafe.

texts.name: Wishes of Quiet Snowfall
texts.description:
Inflicting Glacio Chafe on enemies increases Glacio DMG dealt by 10% for 15s. The Resonator gains the Snowfall effect for 15s, which can be triggered once every 25s. While Snowfall is active:
- Dealing Resonance Liberation DMG removes Snowfall and increases the Resonator's Crit. Rate by 25% for 6s. While the effect is active, dealing Resonance Liberation DMG extends its duration by 4s, triggered once every 0.5s, up to 6 times.
- Casting Outro Skill removes Snowfall and grants 25% Glacio DMG Bonus to the incoming Resonator for 15s.
When Snowfall is removed, only one of the effects above can be triggered.

Each shock increases the current character's Glacio DMG by 4.00% and Resonance Skill DMG dealt by 4.00% for 15s, stacking up to 3 times

texts.name: Fine Snow
texts.description:
When a Resonator in the team applies Glacio Chafe or Havoc Bane, Hiyuki gains 1 stack of Snow Rust. Snow Rust stacks up to 3 times. Each Resonator can trigger this effect only once in this way.
Based on Hiyuki's current stacks of Snow Rust, the following bonuses are unlocked:
1 stack of Snow Rust: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, Glacio Bite DMG is Amplified by 30% against targets within a certain range. Hiyuki's Crit. DMG is increased by 40%.
2 stacks of Snow Rust: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, each time she applies Glacio Chafe, she additionally deals an instance of Glacio Bite DMG with a fixed DMG Multiplier of 102%.
3 stacks of Snow Rust: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, Glacio Bite DMG is additionally Amplified by 30% against targets within a certain range.
This effect resets when new Resonators are added to the team.

texts.name: Flaming Sakura Blade Art
texts.description:
Basic Attack - Present Self
Normal Attack consecutively or hold it down to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG.
Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3 applies Glacio Chafe 1 time on hit.

Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self
When Dedication reaches 300 points, Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self becomes available.
Hold Normal Attack to shoot out 3 arrows one by one at the cost of STA, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG. Hiyuki is immune to interruptions and incoming DMG in the duration.
When the last arrow is shot, 300 points of Dedication is consumed and Foreclaiming: Inward Vision becomes available. The arrow applies Glacio Chafe 1 time on hit.

Mid-air Attack - Present Self
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack from Mid-air, dealing Glacio DMG.

Dodge Counter - Present Self
Normal Attack within a certain period after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG.
Normal Attack within a certain period after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3.

Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self
While in Foreclaimed Self, Basic Attack - Present Self is replaced by Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self.
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3, 4, and 5 each applies Glacio Chafe 1 time on hit.

Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self
In Foreclaimed Self, hold Normal Attack to enter Hold Breath, continuously consuming STA. When Normal Attack is released or STA is depleted, Hiyuki leaves the Hold Breath state and thrusts forward, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG. Normal Attack within a certain period after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 2.
If Hiyuki is attacked by an enemy within a certain period during the thrust, neutralize that instance of damage, Stagnate nearby targets, and become immune to interruptions for a certain period afterward while reducing all incoming DMG by 100%. Normal Attack within a certain period after triggering this effect to chain into Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 4 instead.

Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self
When Whiteout Bitterfrost is full, Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self is replaced with Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self. 
Hold Normal Attack and consume STA and 3 stacks of Whiteout Bitterfrost to gain 1 point of Snowforged Blade, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self applies Glacio Chafe 1 time on hit.
If Hiyuki is airborne while casting this skill, she'll land on the ground first.

Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self
While in Foreclaimed Self, Mid-air Attack - Present Self is replaced by Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self.
Consume STA to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks in Mid-air, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG. Stage 3 is a Plunging Attack.
Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 2 & 3 apply Glacio Chafe 1 time on hit.
The Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self cycle will not be reset by casting skills other than Basic Attack - Iai within a short period.
Hold Normal Attack while airborne to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA.

Dodge Counter - Foreclaimed Self
While in Foreclaimed Self, Dodge Counter - Present Self is replaced by Dodge Counter - Foreclaimed Self.
Normal Attack within a certain period after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
Normal Attack within a certain period after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3.

texts.description:
Resonance Skill - Present Self
Deal Glacio DMG.
Casting this skill enhances the next Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3, which now restores 100 points of Dedication when cast. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect.
or hold Normal Attack within a certain period after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3.

While in Foreclaimed Self, Resonance Skill - Present Self is replaced by Frostblight: Jade Cleave and Frostblight: Petalfall:

Frostblight: Jade Cleave
While on the ground, Resonance Skill to pull in nearby targets and deal Glacio DMG, removing the targets' Frostbind.
This skill shares a Cooldown with Frostblight: Petalfall.

Frostblight: Petalfall
While in mid-air, Resonance Skill to pull in nearby targets and deal Glacio DMG, removing the targets' Frostbind.
This skill shares a Cooldown with Frostblight: Jade Cleave.

texts.name: Everfrost Dominion
texts.description:
Glacio Bite
- While Hiyuki is in the team, Glacio Chafe inflicted by nearby Resonators in the team is converted to Glacio Bite. Every time a new stack of Glacio Bite is inflicted on a target, an instance of Glacio Bite DMG is triggered based on that enemy's current Glacio Bite stack limit. Glacio Bite can be inflicted on frozen targets. Glacio Bite is also considered Glacio Chafe and Glacio Bite DMG is also considered Glacio Chafe DMG.
- When Foreclaiming: Inward Vision or Basic Attack - Iai hits a target, if the target has no fewer than 10 stacks of Glacio Bite, consume 10 and trigger Frostbind once. 
- When Hiyuki joins the team, remove all stacks of Glacio Chafe from the targets. When Hiyuki leaves the team, if there is no other Resonator in the team who can convert Glacio Chafe into Glacio Bite, all enemies' Glacio Bite stacks are cleared.

Present Self
Hiyuki starts in Present Self. While in Present Self, casting certain skills restores Dedication.

Foreclaimed Self
Hiyuki enters Foreclaimed Self after casting Foreclaiming: Inward Vision. While in Foreclaimed Self, Hiyuki unlocks new moves and restores Frostheart through certain attacks.

Iai Stance
If Hiyuki has at least 100 points of Frostheart, performing any of the following actions causes her to flash backward at the cost of STA and enter Iai Stance:
- Dodge after casting any Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self other than Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self, Frostblight: Jade Cleave, Frostblight: Petalfall, Basic Attack - Iai, or Intro Skill - Frostedge.
- Hold Resonance Skill within a certain period after casting Frostblight: Jade Cleave or Frostblight: Petalfall.
While performing the actions above, if there is a valid target within the range and the forward input is held down, Hiyuki instead flashes behind the enemy at the cost of STA and enters Iai Stance.
Hiyuki may enter Iai Stance while airborne. Upon entering the Iai Stance, Hiyuki's mid-air Dodge charges are reset. Iai Stance ends if Hiyuki is switched out.

Basic Attack - Iai
Within a certain period after entering Iai Stance, Normal Attack and consume 100 points of Frostheart to cast Basic Attack - Iai, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
If Frostheart remains at 100 points or above after casting this skill, Normal Attack within a certain period to cast Basic Attack - Iai again.
If Hiyuki is attacked by an enemy within a certain period during Basic Attack - Iai, neutralize this instance of damage and become immune to interruptions for a certain duration afterwards while reducing all incoming DMG by 100%.
Each time Basic Attack - Iai is cast, if Hiyuki has Frostharden Iai, consume 1 point of Frostharden Iai to inflict 3 stacks of Glacio Chafe on hit, and gain 1 stack of Whiteout Bitterfrost.

Dedication
Hiyuki holds up to 300 points of Dedication.
While in Present Self, Dedication may be restored via the following ways:
- Casting Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3 restores 100 points of Dedication.
- Casting Intro Skill - Frostedge restores 200 points of Dedication.
Casting Resonance Skill - Present Self enhances the next Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3, which now additionally restores 100 points of Dedication. This effect ends when Hiyuki is switched out.

Frostheart
Hiyuki holds up to 300 points of Frostheart.
Frostheart is restored while casting Frostblight: Jade Cleave and Frostblight: Petalfall, or when Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self other than Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self hits the target.

Frostharden Iai
Frostharden Iai has a maximum of 3 points.
Casting Foreclaiming: Inward Vision grants 3 points of Frostharden Iai.

Whiteout Bitterfrost
Whiteout Bitterfrost stacks up to 3 times.
Each time Frostharden Iai is consumed through Basic Attack - Iai, gain 1 stack of Whiteout Bitterfrost.

Snowforged Blade
Snowforged Blade stacks up to 3 times.
Each time Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self is cast, gain 1 stack of Snowforged Blade.

texts.name: Foreclaiming
texts.description:
Foreclaiming: Inward Vision
Foreclaiming: Inward Vision becomes available after casting Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self.
While in Present Self, Resonance Liberation to cast this skill, dealing Glacio DMG. Upon casting this skill, gain 3 points of Frostharden Iai, remove 300 points of Dedication and Frostheart. Then, enter Foreclaimed Self and restore 50 points of Frostheart.
Foreclaiming: Inward Vision applies 4 stacks of Glacio Chafe on hit.
Casting Foreclaiming: Inward Vision does not consume Resonance Energy.

Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation
While in Foreclaimed Self, Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation can be cast via the following ways:
- Resonance Liberation and release to cast Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation. If Hiyuki has 3 points of Snowforged Blade, consume all Snowforged Blade. Otherwise, this cast does not consume Snowforged Blade.
- Hold Resonance Liberation to enter a charging state. During this state, consume 1 point of Snowforged Blade periodically. Release Resonance Liberation to cast Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation. If no Snowforged Blade is consumed when Resonance Liberation is released, Hiyuki will continue to charge the attack and cast the skill automatically after certain time. Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation will also be cast automatically when Snowforged Blade depletes. 
Hiyuki deals Glacio DMG. Each point of Snowforged Blade consumed increases the DMG Multiplier of this attack.
Casting the skill consumes 300 points of Dedication and Frostheart, and ends Foreclaimed Self.

In Foreclaimed Self, Normal Attack within a certain period after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 2.

baseTexts.roleDescription: Lucilla, President of Startorch Academy and idealist with both feet on the ground. She holds quiet vigil over her students as they rise to challenge the very sky.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
Lucilla is a Glacio, Rectifier sub-DPS character who specializes in supporting two gameplay styles depending on her Resonance Mode. Glacio Chafe and Echo.

She deals primarily Basic Attack damage, or Echo Skill DMG.

She holds 0 Resonance Energy, and her Resonance Liberation is unlocked upon filling her Forte Bar.
baseTexts.introductionDescription: Use Resonance Skill and Basic Attack to bring up the Focus Ring cursor → Land inside Perfect Focus → Restore Trace → Reach 3 Photos / full Forte Bar → Cast Resonance Liberation → Use Basic Attack chain until Tracing Forms Stage 3 → Hold or press Basic Attack to consume Photos → Cast Letting It Go → Use Outro Skill
baseTexts.introductionDetail:
Lucilla has two gameplay styles. Glacio Chafe support, and Echo support. Her gameplay loop is the same with each mode, but her buffs are different.

Lucilla's Resonance Skill will Pull nearby targets and bring up a cursor. After casting Resonance Skill or Basic Attack 3, hold Basic Attack or Resonance Skill to deploy Lucilla’s Focus Ring. You will hold this down until the Focus Ring Cursor is full, to deal additional damage, and restore Trace.
Every 50 Trace will generate one Photo for Lucilla. Each Photo is 1/3 of her Forte Bar, maxing out at 3. Landing the cursor inside Perfect Focus strengthens the Focus Ring effect, so this should be your goal every time.
When Lucilla has 3 Photos, maxing out her Forte bar, Her Resonance Liberation will unlock. When casting her Resonance Liberation Lucilla will deal Glacio Damage and enter Reminiscence.

Lucilla gains enhancements depending on her Resonance Mode.
Glacio Chafe:
Grants Lucilla 30% Basic Attack DMG Bonus for 10 seconds, and she will gain 4 stacks of Film Roll for 30 seconds, and whenever another team member inflicts Glacio Chafe, Lucilla will consume 1 stack of Film Roll and inflict Glacio Chafe on two nearby targets.

Echo:
Lucilla gains 30% Echo Skill DMG Bonus for 10 seconds, and she will gain 1 stack of Zoom, increasing the Crit DMG of the active Resonator's Echo Skill by 10%. Each effect lasts 30 seconds.

When casting Basic Attack 3 while in Reminiscence, Lucilla can continuously attack the target by holding or pressing Normal Attack to consume Photo Stack. Each Photo Consumed will deal damage and inflict Glacio Chafe if in Glacio Chafe Resonance Mode, and while in Echo Resonance Mode each Photo Stack will count as a separate Echo Skill used. When all stacks are consumed, she will automatically perform Letting It Go. Lucilla is immune to interruptions and damage when casting Letting It Go. Casting Letting It Go ends her Resonance Liberation Mode.

Lucilla's Outro Skill changes depending on Resonance Mode.
Glacio Chafe: Glacio Chafe DMG against targets are amplified by 60% for 30 Seconds.
Echo: Grants 50% Echo Skill DMG Amplification to the incoming Resonator for 14 seconds. This effect ends when that Resonator is switched off.

baseTexts.roleDescription: Encore is a Fusion main DPS. She deals high burst and off-field DMG through Basic Attack and Resonance Liberation DMG. Versatile in both melee and ranged combat.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
Core Mechanics: [Mayhem]. When [Mayhem] is full, using a Heavy Attack consumes all [Mayhem] and triggers a Mayhem state. While in this state, Encore takes 70% less DMG, and switching characters won’t cancel the effect. When it ends, she deals Fusion DMG.
While under Resonance Liberation, if Encore fills the [Mayhem] again, a Heavy Attack will trigger Cosmos' Mayhem state. This state also reduces DMG taken by 70% and persists through character switches. When it ends, she unleashes Cosmos Rupture for Fusion DMG.
[Mayhem] Gain: Hitting enemies with Normal Attack, Resonance Skill, or Intro Skill restores [Mayhem]. Under Resonance Liberation, all hits restore [Mayhem].

Rotation: E1→E2→R→AAAA*n→H.
baseTexts.introductionDescription:
● Encore + Changli + Verina/Shorekeeper/Baizhi
Changli and Encore perform quick-swap bursts. Shorekeeper/Verina/Baizhi provide healing and additional DMG.
① Changli QEA;
② Healer quickly fully charges Concerto Energy.
③ Changli enters with Intro Skill + AEA;
④ Encore QE. Changli AAAA-A-EA-H-R-H to achieve full Concerto Energy;
⑤ Encore enters with Intro Skill R-4A-E-4A Dodge - 4A-E-H;
⑥ Repeat.

● Encore + Sanhua + Shorekeeper/Verina/Baizhi
Sanhua buffs Encore's Basic Attack DMG. They sync rotations. Shorekeeper, Verina, or Baizhi offer healing and DMG boosts.
① Encore starts with E1;
② Switch to Sanhua for ERH;
③ Switch to Encore E2;
④ Healer quickly fully charges Concerto Energy;
⑤ Sanhua enters with Intro Skill + HQ to achieve full Concerto Energy;
⑥ Encore enters with Intro Skill + Q-R-E1-E2-AAAA*n-H.

● Encore + Brant + Shorekeeper/Verina/Baizhi
Brant buffs Encore’s Fusion and Resonance Skill DMG. Shorekeeper/Verina/Baizhi provide healing and additional DMG.
① Encore starts with E;
② Healer quickly fully charges Concerto Energy;
③ Brant enters with Intro Skill, uses R-H-H, then enhanced E to achieve full Concerto Energy and leave the field.
④ Encore re-enters with Intro Skill + R-EAAA*3 fully charging Concerto Energy + Heavy Attack, and swap out.
⑤ Repeat.
baseTexts.introductionDetail:
Team Comp Analysis: Prioritize teammates who boost Fusion DMG, Basic Attack DMG, or Resonance Liberation DMG. Since Encore has multiple off-field tools, she works well in coordinated rotations.

Team Comp & Rotation:
In the following rotations: A = Basic Attack; H = Heavy Attack; E = Resonance Skill; R = Resonance Liberation; Q = Echo Skill.

baseTexts.roleDescription: Mortefi is a Fusion character whose main source of DMG comes from Resonance Skills and frequent Coordinated Attacks.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
Core Mechanics: ① [Annoyance] When [Annoyance] is full, it upgrades Mortefi’s E into a stronger version. ② After Resonance Liberation, it enables Mortefi to perform Coordinated Attacks when off-field, triggered by the on-field character’s attacks.
[Annoyance] Gain: Basic Attack/Intro Skill/Resonance Skill.

Rotation: E-A-A-A-A-E-A-A-A-A-E-R
baseTexts.introductionDescription:
● Jiyan + Mortefi + Aero Rover
Mortefi buffs Jiyan’s Heavy Attack DMG. Aero Rover offers healing and Aero DMG boost.
① Aero Rover starts with EAA, not fully stacking Concerto Energy. 
② Mortefi E-R-AAA-E without fully charging Concerto Energy;
③ Jiyan E-Q without fully charging Concerto Energy; 
④ Aero Rover EAA-EAA. At max Forte Gauge, use ultimate EERQ to achieve full Concerto Energy; 
⑤ Mortefi enters with Intro Skill + EE-Q to achieve full Concerto Energy;
⑥ Jiyan takes the field with Intro Skill + R-AE-H.

● Jinhsi + Mortefi + Verina
Mortefi’s Coordinated Attacks help Jinhsi build passive stacks. Verina provide healing and DMG buffs.
① Jinhsi E1-AAAA-E2-E3-AAAA-E4 to trigger Unison;
② Verina enters with Intro Skill + REQ - Jump A to achieve full Concerto Energy;
③ Mortefi enters with Intro Skill + RAE + Enhanced EQ, fully charging Concerto Energy.
④ Jinhsi enters with Intro Skill + Q-E2-R-E3-AAAA-E4;
⑤ Verina enters with Intro Skill and repeat the rotation above.

● Roccia + Mortefi + Shorekeeper/Verina/Baizhi
Works best with Roccia's S6. Mortefi supports Roccia with Heavy Attack DMG buffs, while Shorekeeper/Verina/Baizhi provide healing and DMG buffs.
① Start with Roccia using E.
② Healer quickly fully charges Concerto Energy and leaves.
③ Mortefi enters with Intro Skill + RAE + Enhanced EQ, fully charging Concerto Energy.
④ Roccia re-enters with Intro Skill + AREAAA*n. (Can continuously use this attack at S6)
⑤ Switch to the healer and repeat the rotation above.

In the following rotations: A = Basic Attack; H = Heavy Attack; E = Resonance Skill; R = Resonance Liberation; Q = Echo Skill.

baseTexts.introductionName: How to Play and Build Brant
baseTexts.roleDescription: Brant is a 5 star fusion Sword user considered as a super hybrid character because he can fulfill multiple roles in your team building, including keeping your team alive with shields if you need it, healing your entire team with his basic attacks and liberation, does decent damage and extremely versatile when it comes to team building because he can be slotted into many teams where the other dps uses the fusion attribute or scales off resonance skill damage.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
Team compositions: The most common team for Brant is a free to play friendly team featuring Sanhua to provide basic attack damage amplification which significantly boosts his forte skill. You can also pai him with Changli since Brant’s outro skill synergises really well with Changli

Output suggestions: For Brant to work in any team composition, you simply need to use his liberation, hold basic attack to use his heavy attack twice and then proceed to spam your basic attacks in mid air which will fully fill his Bravo stacks. From there, all you need to do is to press your skill to drop the anchor on the enemy to deal massive damage 

Basic operations include: Ult→HA1→HA2→BA3->BA4→Skill

BA=Basic Attack, Ult=Liberation HA= Heavy attack
baseTexts.introductionDescription: If you’re into characters that are very fun to play, does decent damage, provides some of the the best buffing and sustaining capabilities in the game and have free to play weapons and teams readily available, then Brant is the right character for you.
baseTexts.introductionDetail:
Brant’s kit is heavily focused on his mid air basic attacks so knowing how they work in different situations will make him even more enjoyable. Whenever you finish BA1,BA2,or BA3 in mid air, he will perform a flip shot. When the flip shot ends, it means you can dodge in mid air. This means that Brant is not vulnerable in mid air compared to most characters because every basic attack in mid air except BA4 resets your dodge attempts. Whenever your dodge attempts resets, it means you can proceed with the next stage of his basic attack. 

Brant has access to heavy attacks as well and here’s how they work. You need to go in mid air by jumping or using his skill and then hold your basic attack button to start the Basic attack stage 1 and follow up with the first heavy attack. Now keep holding it and he will follow up with the second heavy attack. From there you can spam basic attacks to use basic attack 3 and 4. Keep in mind that if you press basic attack instead to use stage 1, it means you have exhausted the chance to use the heavy attack stage 1 after the flip shot is completed. Holding it afterwards will start heavy attack stage 2 but continuously pressing basic attacks will proceed with stage 2,3 and 4.

This detail is very important because during an intro skill, Brant does basic stage 1 and ends with a flip shot which means that holding your basic attack button afterwards will perform heavy attack stage 2 from there so be sure to keep that in mind. And that’s all you need to know on how to play Brant.

More detailed rotation for Brant’s strongest team with Changli and Lupa is as follows:

Changli skill→Ult (keep holding BA) → HA→BA→Skill→BA→Echo Skill→swap to lupa→skill 2x→Ult→BA 5x →skill→Brant intro→Ult→Hold BA→HA2→BA3→BA4→Skill→echo skill→Changli intro

BA=Basic Attack, Ult=Liberation HA= Heavy attack

Basic Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Fusion DMG.



Heavy Attack

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.



Heavy Attack - Rhapsodic Riff

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.

- After performing Basic Attack Stage 2 or Stage 4, hold Normal Attack to perform Heavy Attack - Rhapsodic Riff.

- After performing Mid-air Attack Stage 4, Normal Attack to perform Heavy Attack - Rhapsodic Riff.



Mid-air Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Fusion DMG.

Normal Attack following Mid-air Attack Stage 1 or Stage 2 to swing to the target with Grapple. Brant will attack the target if he reaches them with the swing. Release while in action to flip backward after the attack hits; or hold Normal Attack to attack the target continuously and flip backward after the finishing move. Brant flips backward automatically after Mid-air Attack Stage 3. Normal Attack after each flip to perform the next stage of Mid-air Attack. Flip resets Mid-air Dodge attempts.

- If Brant fails to reach the target with the Grapple swing of Mid-air Attack Stage 1, he instead performs a slash forward, dealing Fusion DMG.

- If Brant reaches the target with the Grapple swing of Mid-air Attack Stage 1 or Stage 2 but the attack fails to hit the target, he will drop down after a temporary suspension in mid-air.



Dodge Counter

Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.

Plunging Attack

Plunge at the target at the cost of STA, dealing Fusion DMG, which is considered Basic Attack DMG.

- If Brant fails to reach the target with the Grapple swing of Mid-air Attack Stage 1, he instead performs a slash forward. Afterward, Normal Attack to perform Plunging Attack.

- If Brant reaches the target with the Grapple swing of Mid-air Attack Stage 1 or Stage 2 but the attack fails to hit the target, Normal Attack to perform Plunging Attack during the suspension.

baseTexts.roleDescription:
1. Lupa is a Fusion Sub-DPS/Support, with a kit centered around Resonance Liberation DMG.
2. Lupa revolves around [Wolflame] and [Wolfaith] as core energy sources, enabling various enhanced attacks and Coordinated Attack.
3. When activating Resonance Liberation, Lupa gains an auto-recovery effect, increasing error tolerance.
4. Most of Lupa's skills can be cast mid-air, making her exceptionally effective at aerial combat.
5. Lupa provides buffs to the entire team based on the number of Fusion units present. Her Outro Skill boosts allies' Fusion DMG and Basic Attack DMG, significantly enhancing Fusion teams.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
1. Tip: After casting Resonance Liberation, use [Foebreaker] to trigger [Burning Matchpoint]. Within 12 seconds, perform full Basic Attacks to max [Wolflame], then use [Wolf's Gnawing], [Wolf's Claw], and finish with [Dance With the Wolf: Climax].
2. Rotation: Lupa R-A/E-A*n-H-A- Ultimate E.
3. Team Comp: The most suitable ally is Changli and Brant. The team setup of Changli + Lupa + Brant works well. Please refer to the full guide for team rotation.
baseTexts.introductionDescription:
Skill Breakdown
1. Normal Attack
      ● Basic Attack: 4-hit combo. After A3, can follow up with the 1st hit of Mid-air Attack. After Dodge Counter / Starfall / Shewolf's Hunt / Feral Fang, can chain into A2.
      ● Heavy Attack: Consumes STA to attack.
      ● Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing: Requires 50 [Wolflame].
      ● Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw: Requires 50 [Wolflame] + 1 [Wolfaith]. Can be shortcut-cast after Firestrike / Wolf's Gnawing.
      ● Mid-air Attack: 3-hit combo.
      ● Mid-air Attack - Firestrike: Replaces 3rd hit of Mid-air Attack if [Wolflame] ≥ 50 (counts as Heavy Attack DMG).
      ● Plunging Attack - Hold Basic Attack mid-air to cast, then short tap Basic Attack for Starfall.
      ● Basic Attack - Starfall: Deals Fusion DMG.
      ● Dodge Counter: Triggers Basic Attack on a successful dodge.
2. Resonance Skill
      ● Shewolf's Hunt (E1): Restores 15 [Wolflame], marks enemy for 8s, can follow up with Feral Fang. Hold to leap.
      ● Feral Fang (E2): Restores 15 [Wolflame], deals increased DMG to marked enemies.
      ● Inherent Skill: Lupa killing a marked enemy resets Shewolf's Hunt CD.
3. Forte Circuit
      ● Wildfire Banner: Boosts Lupa's ATK for 8s during certain skills.
      ● Resonance Skill - Dance With the Wolf (Enhanced E): Requires 2 [Wolfaith], counts as Resonance Liberation DMG.
      ● Resonance Skill - Dance With the Wolf: Climax (Ultimate E): Requires 2 [Wolfaith] + Burning Matchpoint. Also counts as Resonance Liberation DMG.
      ● Resonance Skill - Set the Arena Ablaze (Coordinated E): Within 8 seconds after casting enhanced/Ultimate E, switching characters lets the next teammate trigger a Lupa's Coordinated Attack 1 time when they use Resonance Liberation (counts as Resonance Skill DMG).
      ● [Wolflame] Gain: Up to 100 points. Gained via Normal Attack, Resonance Skill, Resonance Liberation.
      ● [Wolfaith] Gain: Up to 2 points. Lasts 10s. The duration is reset when Wolfaith is restored. At the end of its duration, each remaining point of [Wolfaith] becomes 50 points of [Wolflame]. Restore 1 point when casting Wolf's Gnawing / Wolf's Claw / Firestrike.
4. Resonance Liberation
      Deals DMG, clears [Wolfaith], restores 100 [Wolflame]. Short press Basic Attack or Resonance Skill to trigger Resonance Skill - Foebreaker.
      ● Resonance Skill - Foebreaker: Consumes all [Wolflame], deals DMG, enters Burning Matchpoint.
      ● Burning Matchpoint: 12s duration. Greatly boosts [Wolflame] gain from Normal Attack. Shewolf's Hunt/Feral Fang is unavailable.
      After activating Resonance Liberation, for 35 seconds your entire team can trigger up to 3 recovery effects and gain Pack Hunt and Glory (Glory requires unlocking an Inherent Skill).
      ● Pack Hunt: Increases ATK by 6%. When attacking a boss, Fusion DMG is increased by 10%. If there are 3 Fusion characters on the team, Fusion DMG gets an additional 10% boost. Using an Intro Skill grants an additional 6% ATK, stacking up to 18%. Once Pack Hunt is maxed, triggers Wild Hunt, which can only activate once per instance of Pack Hunt.
      ● Glory: Ignores 3% of enemy Fusion RES. For each additional Fusion character besides Lupa, this bonus increases by 3%, up to 9%. With 3 Fusion characters in the team, gain an extra 6%.
5. Intro Skill
      ● Deals Fusion DMG to the target. Allows a follow-up with the 3rd hit of Lupa's Mid-air Attack by tapping Basic Attack shortly after.
      ● Enhanced Intro Skill: When in Wild Hunt, Lupa's Intro Skill changes. Consumes all Pack Hunt and Glory on the team to deal powerful Fusion DMG (counts as Resonance Liberation DMG).
6. Outro Skill
        Boosts the next character's Fusion DMG and Basic Attack DMG.

Team Comp Analysis:
Lupa fits exclusively into Fusion teams. She mainly contributes through Resonance Liberation DMG and Outro Skill can boost allies' Fusion and Basic Attack DMG. Ideal teammates are Changli and Brant.

Team Comp & Rotation:
In the following rotations: A = Basic Attack; H = Heavy Attack; E = Resonance Skill; R = Resonance Liberation; Q = Echo Skill.

● Changli + Lupa + Brant.
The best team. Triple core synergy. Changli boosts Lupa's Fusion DMG and Resonance Liberation DMG. Lupa boosts Brant's Fusion and Basic Attack DMG. Brant boosts Changli's Fusion and Resonance Skill DMG, and provides teamwide healing.
① Changli starts with EA - EA, not fully stacking Concerto Energy;
② Lupa R-A/E-A*n-H-A- Ultimate E. Achieve full Concerto Energy and swap out;
③ Brant enters with Intro Skill, uses R-H-H, then enhanced E to achieve full Concerto Energy and leave the field.
④ Changli takes the field with Intro Skill + A-EA-H-R-H. Achieve full Concerto Energy and swap out;
⑤ Lupa enters with enhanced Intro Skill. Repeat.

● Encore + Lupa + Brant.
Lupa buffs Encore's Fusion DMG and Basic Attack DMG. Brant supports Lupa with Fusion and Resonance Skill DMG, plus team healing.
① Encore starts with E;
② Lupa R-A/E-A*n-H-A- Ultimate E. Achieve full Concerto Energy and swap out;
③ Encore takes the field with Intro Skill + R-E1E2-4A*3-H. Achieve full Concerto Energy and swap out;
④ Brant enters with Intro Skill, uses R-H-H, then enhanced E to achieve full Concerto Energy and leave the field;
⑤ Lupa enters with enhanced Intro Skill. Repeat.

● Chixia + Lupa + Brant.
Lupa buffs Brant's Fusion DMG and Basic Attack DMG. Brant boosts Chixia's Fusion and Resonance Skill DMG, and heals the team.
① Chixia starts with EE, not fully stacking Concerto Energy;
② Lupa R-A/E-A*n-H-A- Ultimate E. Achieve full Concerto Energy and swap out;
③ Brant enters with Intro Skill, uses R-H-H, then enhanced E to achieve full Concerto Energy and leave the field.
④ Chixia enters with Intro Skill + Held E-A-R- Held E-A- Held E-A to achieve full Concerto Energy and swap out;
⑤ Lupa enters with enhanced Intro Skill. Repeat.

Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing

Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw

When "Wolflame" reaches 50 points and "Wolfaith" reaches 1 point, Heavy Attack will be replaced by Wolf's Claw, consuming STA to attack the target and dealing Fusion DMG.

- If "Wolflame" reaches 50 points and "Wolfaith" reaches 1 point after performing Mid-air Attack - Firestrike or Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing, Normal Attack in time to perform Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw.

- This attack does not restore "Wolflame". Consume 50 points of "Wolflame" to perform this attack and gain 1 of "Wolfaith".



Mid-air Attack 

Consume STA to perform up to 3 attacks in mid-air, dealing Fusion DMG. The Mid-air Attack cycle will not be reset.



Mid-air Attack - Firestrike

When "Wolflame" reaches 50 points, Mid-air Attack Stage 3 will be replaced by Mid-air Attack - Firestrike, consuming STA to attack the target and dealing Fusion DMG (considered Heavy Attack DMG).

- This attack does not restore "Wolflame". Consume 50 points of "Wolflame" to perform this attack and gain 1 of "Wolfaith".



Plunging Attack

Hold Normal Attack while airborne to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing Fusion DMG. After performing this attack, Normal Attack in time to perform Basic Attack Starfall.

When the active Resonator casts Intro Skill, Pack Hunt is enhanced, granting an additional 6% ATK increase to all Resonators in the team, up to a maximum of 18%.

If Lupa's Pack Hunt reaches its cap within its duration, she enters Wild Hunt and Intro Skill Nowhere to Run! becomes available. Wild Hunt can be triggered once per Pack Hunt.

Consume all "Wolflame" to perform Foebreaker, dealing Fusion DMG and entering Burning Matchpoint state.

roleResonanceTexts.recommendDescription:
● S2: Boosts Fusion DMG for the whole team when using Resonance Liberation, Heavy Attack: Wolf's Gnawing, Heavy Attack: Wolf's Claw, or Mid-air Attack: Firestrike. Essential for Fusion team comps.

baseTexts.roleDescription:
Galbrena, a resonator with a demonic presence. She unleashes flashy and fast paced attacks, while raining down hellfire onto the enemies, only to finish the onslaught with a wingbeat flare, and a final devastating kick.

Galbrena combines smooth gameplay, with powerful damage, making her a powerful main DPS resonator.

She relies on her teammates to unlock a major portion of her damage, so good teambuilding is required for her to thrive.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
Its important to use as many Echo skills with Galbrena to enhance her most powerful state, Demon Hypostasis.

Pairing her with specific allies is highly recommended as they fuel her damage. Always start your rotation with her Resonance Liberation.
baseTexts.introductionDescription: Galbrena is a fusion pistol wielding character that specializes in high spurts of damage, and utilizes your teams Echo Skills to power up her enhanced Resonance Skill.
baseTexts.introductionDetail:
Galbrena specializes in Echo Skill Damage, and Heavy Attack Damage, but most of her damage comes from Echo skill damage, which most of her kit is considered.

When paired with Echo Skill users, she can output crazy damage, but she also has other teams that work exceptionally well. 

For each unique echo used in the party used, the damage of her attacks in the Demon Hypostasis Mode greatly increases.

She pairs exceptionally well with characters who use unique echo skills in their kit. 

Her gameplay consist of using other characters unique echo skills to power up her "Demon Hypostasis Mode", and then utilizing any part of her kit to build up her forte, and then activating the Demon Hypostasis mode with her Enhanced Resonance Skill.

In this state, all of her attacks are enhanced, and using her basic attack combo will unleash incredible damage. Each attack will use her built up gauge, and when its depleted, the Demon Hypostasis mode will end.

Additionally, her Resonance Liberation increases the Multiplier of her Demon Hypostasis mode.

Dash forward and leap in to the air. Flip backward upon hitting the target, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.


Resonance Skill - Ascent of Malice
Upon reaching 100 points of "Sinflame", Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill - Ascent of Malice.
Slash at enemies with her wings, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG. Upon casting this skill:
- Galbrena enters "Demon Hypostasis".
- "Sinflame" is converted into an equivalent amount of "Purging Flame".
- Can be followed by Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 2.

texts.name: Slayer's Trigger
texts.description:
Basic Attack
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Fusion DMG. Basic Attack Stage 1 to 3 DMG are considered as Heavy Attack DMG, and Basic Attack Stage 4 DMG as Echo Skill DMG.
Normal Attack right after performing Basic Attack Stage 4 to perform Basic Attack Stage 2.

Heavy Attack - Volley of Death
Consume STA to attack the target and perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Fusion DMG. Stage 3 DMG is considered as Echo Skill DMG.
Normal Attack right after performing Heavy Attack - Volley of Death Stage 1 to perform Basic Attack Stage 2. Normal Attack right after casting Heavy Attack - Volley of Death Stage 2 or 3 to perform Basic Attack Stage 3.

Mid-air Attack - Ashfall Barrage
While in mid-air, Normal Attack to consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Fusion DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
While in mid-air, hold Normal Attack to continuously consume STA to launch a barrage of shots at targets below, dealing Fusion DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG. If Galbrena does not land when interrupted during the barrage, she cannot immediately cast this skill again. Release Normal Attack during the barrage to cast Plunging Attack.
Normal Attack right after casting Plunging Attack to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

Dodge Counter - Blood for Blood
Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
Normal Attack right after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 4.

texts.name: Hellflare Overload
texts.description:
Attack the target and deal Fusion DMG.
Hold Normal Attack after casting this skill to cast Heavy Attack - Volley of Death Stage 2. While in "Demon Hypostasis", cast Heavy Attack - Volley of Death Stage 2 instead.

texts.name: Heart of Defiance Ever Ablaze
texts.description:
When casting Resonance Skill - Ascent of Malice, each point of "Afterflame" additionally grants 2% Crit. DMG, up to 80%, to Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution, Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict, Mid-air Attack - Hellsent Barrage, Resonance Skill - Ravage, and Dodge Counter - Purgatory Scourge which are removed upon exiting "Demon Hypostasis".
While in "Demon Hypostasis", Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 5, Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict Stage 3, and Mid-air Attack - Hellsent Barrage are immune to interruption.

texts.name: Hellbound Dive of Fire and Abyss
texts.description: "Burning Drive" grants 350% more ATK Bonus.

texts.name: Hunter’s Blood Oath Rekindled
texts.description: Resonance Liberation DMG Multiplier is increased by 130%.

texts.name: Carry Forth This Fading Spark
texts.description: When Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, all Resonators in the team gain 20% all-Attribute DMG Bonus for 20s.

texts.name: Though Light Fades, Torment Consumes
texts.description: The DMG Multipliers of Resonance Skill - Encroach, Resonance Skill - Ascent of Malice, and Resonance Skill - Ravage are increased by 150%.

texts.name: I Remain Who I am, Eternal My Flame
texts.description:
"Demon Hypostasis" becomes "Eternal Hypostasis". "Eternal Hypostasis" retains all effects of "Demon Hypostasis".
Additionally, "Eternal Hypostasis" lasts, the DMG Multipliers of Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution, Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict, Mid-air Attack - Hellsent Barrage, and Dodge Counter -Purgatory Scourge are additionally increased by 60%.

When casting Resonance Skill - Ascent of Malice, for every 1 point of "Afterflame" consumed, Galbrena's Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution, Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict, Mid-air Attack - Hellsent Barrage, Resonance Skill - Ravage, and Dodge Counter -Purgatory Scourge gain 0.875% Fusion DMG Amplification, up to 35%, which is removed upon exiting "Eternal Hypostasis".

roleResonanceTexts.recommendDescription:
S1: Grants Galbrena much needed interruption resistance during her most powerful attacks. Additionally grants a large Crit DMG Buff when casting her Resonance Skill and entering Demon Hypostasis Mode.

S2: Grants a HUGE ATK bonus to her "Burning Drive" from 20% to an incredible 350%. This state last for 4 seconds when casting Galbrena's Intro skill, and any version of her Resonance Skill.

S3: Greatly enhances the damage of her Resonance Liberation, more than doubling the damage output.

texts.effectDescription: ATK is increased by (12%/15%/18%/21%/24%). Upon dealing Echo Skill DMG, gain (24%/30%/36%/42%/48%) Heavy Attack DMG Amplification for (6/6/6/6/6)s. Upon dealing Heavy Attack DMG, gain (24%/30%/36%/42%/48%) Echo Skill DMG Amplification for (6/6/6/6/6)s. DMG Amplification on each attack is capped at (24%/30%/36%/42%/48%). While both effects are active, dealing damage ignores (8%/10%/12%/14%/16%) of the target's DEF.

texts.name: Static Mist
texts.effectDescription: Increases Energy Regen by (12.8%/16%/19.2%/22.4%/25.6%). Incoming Resonator's ATK is increased by (10%/12.5%/15%/17.5%/20%) for (14/14/14/14/14)s, stackable for up to (1/1/1/1/1) times after the wielder casts Outro Skill.

texts.name: Solar Flame
texts.effectDescription: Dealing Basic Attack or Heavy Attack DMG increases ATK by (2.2%/3.4%/4.7%/5.9%/7.2%) and grants (2.2%/3.4%/4.7%/5.9%/7.2%) Heavy Attack DMG Bonus for (7/7/7/7/7)s, stacking up to (4/4/4/4) times. This effect can be triggered (1/1/1/1/1) every (1/1/1/1/1)s.

weaponTexts.recommendDescription:
Galbrena's signature weapon, Lux & Umbra, grants incredible buffs to Echo Skill DMG, and Heavy Attack DMG, also ignoring 8% of the targets Defense.

An exceptional weapon that greatly empowered Galbrena. Her next best option is Static Mist, the generalistic weapon for any Pistol user. It grants a decent Energy Regen buff, but the passive is not too useful for her otherwise. It still offers high base attack, and Crit Rate, making it suitable.

The Battle Pass Weapon, Solar Flare, is a decent option, as it grants a large Heavy Attack DMG buff, and Crit Rate. Galbrena mainly focuses on Echo Skill DMG, but this weapon is still a decent choice.

ATK is increased by (12%/15%/18%/21%/24%). texts.skillDescription:
Summon the Talons of Decree to attack nearby enemies, dealing 273.60% Aero DMG.

The Resonator with this Echo equipped in their main slot gains 12.00% Aero DMG Bonus and 12.00% Heavy Attack DMG Bonus.

Casting Echo Skill grants 30% Heavy Attack DMG Bonus to the caster for 4s.

Additionally, all Resonators in the team gain 4% Echo Skill DMG Bonus for 30s, stacking up to 4 times. Echoes of the same name can only trigger this effect once. The record of Echo triggering this effect is cleared along with this effect. At 4 stacks, casting Echo Skill again resets the duration of this effect.

baseTexts.introductionName: The Shining Star of Dreams: Mornye
baseTexts.roleDescription: Mornye, the professor of the Department of Exostrider Engineering, is an Engineer with two prosthetic legs carrying her towards the stars of her dreams.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
Mornye is a powerful support resonator who can heal allies, and when played with other Tune Rupture Units, she can provide insane buffs to the entire teams damage.

She functions as a flexible 3rd option in many teams, but does very well when paired with characters like Lynae, who can perform a Tune Rupture.
baseTexts.introductionDescription:
Mornye scales with Def, so be careful with what echoes you equip her with.

Mornye needs 260% Energy Regen to max out her buffs. Very powerful all around character who can fit into virtually any team.
baseTexts.introductionDetail:
Mornye is is a fusion broadblade character who specalizes in healing, buffing allies, and increases the damage that enemies receive from all allies.

She provides a buff that also increases the Off-Tune Buildup Rate, allowing more ease with performing Tune Breaks.

Additionally, any enemy affected by Tune Rupture - Interfered, will take increased damage based on the amount of Energy Regen Mornye has.

Mornye's rotation consist of her filling up her initial forte gauge, Rest Mass Energy, by using any of her attacks, and then using her Heavy Attack to enter Wide Field Observation Mode, which generates Syntony Field. Syntony Field provides the following buffs: Continous Healing, Increased Off-Tune Buildup Rate, and enhanced interruption resistance for 25 seconds.

When Mornye cast her Resonance Liberation while in the Syntony Field, she will upgrade her Syntony Field to High Syntony Field, which further increases the teams DEF.

When Mornye fills up her Forte Gauge while in Wide FIeld Observation Mode, she can cast her Heavy Attack to unleash a powerful attack that marks the enemy with Observation Marker.

When Enemies with the marker are affected by Tune Break, this marker upgrades to an Interfered Marker.

Finally, when an enemy with this marker is affected by a Tune Rupture - Interfered, they will be debuffed, and take increased damage by the entire team. Mornye also has a powerful Outro Skill, which Amplifies the entire teams Attribute Damage.

texts.name: Blueprint
texts.description:
Mornye's Energy Regen is increased by 10%.
Casting Intro Skill - Convergence restores 20 points of Concerto Energy, triggered once every 20s.
Casting Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode Stage 3 restores 20 points of Concerto Energy, triggered once every 20s.

texts.name: Boundedness
texts.description:
Casting Resonance Skill - Expectation Error or Resonance Skill - Distributed Array grants Proof of Boundedness to all Resonators in the team:
- Proof of Boundedness lasts for 60s and can be gained once every 5 min.
- When the active Resonator takes DMG greater than 30% of their Max HP, they instead take DMG equal to 30% of their Max HP. This effect can trigger up to 3 . Proof of Boundedness is removed after triggering it 3 .
- When the active Resonator takes a fatal blow, they are not downed by this instance of damage. This effect can trigger up to 1 . Proof of Boundedness is removed after triggering it 1 .
- When Proof of Boundedness is removed, the active Resonator restores HP equal to 150% of Mornye's DEF.

texts.name: Recursion
texts.description: Resonators in the team gain 25% All DMG Amplification for 30s.

texts.name: Recursion
texts.description: Resonators in the team gain 25% All DMG Amplification for 30s.

texts.name: Decoupling
texts.description:
Mornye can respond to "Tune Rupture - Interfered" and "Tune Strain - Interfered".
- Responding to "Tune Rupture - Interfered": When any Resonator in the team deals "Tune Break" DMG and inflicts "Tune Rupture - Interfered", Mornye casts Tune Rupture Response - Particle Jet. Each target can be damaged by this skill up to once every 8s.
- Responding to "Tune Strain - Interfered": Each stack of "Tune Strain - Interfered" on the target increases Mornye's total DMG against them. Each point of Mornye's Tune Break Boost increases the total DMG by 0.12%. While Mornye is in the team, the max stack limit of "Tune Strain - Interfered" on a target is increased by 1.
Mornye can perform "Tune Break" against the targets with full Off-Tune Level.

texts.name: Ground State Calibration
texts.description:
Basic Attack
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Fusion DMG.

Heavy Attack
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.

Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode
While in "Wide Field Observation Mode", Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode.
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Fusion DMG. 

Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to perform Mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing Fusion DMG. Normal Attack within a certain time afterward to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

Dodge Counter
Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.
Normal Attack shortly after performing this attack to perform Basic Attack Stage 2.

Dodge Counter - Wide Field Observation Mode
While in "Wide Field Observation Mode", Dodge Counter is replaced with Dodge Counter - Wide Field Observation Mode.
Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to counterattack and deal Fusion DMG.
Within a certain time afterward, Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode Stage 3.

texts.name: Resolution
texts.description:
Expectation Error
Heal all nearby Resonators in the team and enter the Parry state, during which DMG taken is reduced by 100% for a time. Switching to another Resonator ends this state immediately.
If attacked while in the Parry state, exit the state and cast Resonance Skill - Optimal Solution.
If not attacked while in the Parry state, Normal Attack to exit the state and cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
.
Optimal Solution
Stagnate nearby targets and deal Fusion DMG, reducing the cooldown of Resonance Skill - Expectation Error by 2s.
Switching to another Resonator ends the Stagnation effect early.

Distributed Array
While in "Wide Field Observation Mode", Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill - Distributed Array.
Heal all nearby Resonators in the team and summon Hover Cannons to strike the target, dealing Fusion DMG.

texts.name: Mass-Energy Equivalence
texts.description:
Baseline Mode
While in her default Baseline Mode, Mornye gains "Rest Mass Energy".

Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift
When "Rest Mass Energy" reaches 100 points, Heavy Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift.
Cast Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift to deal Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG. Afterward, Mornye jumps into mid-air, consumes all "Rest Mass Energy" and enters "Wide Field Observation Mode".

Wide Field Observation Mode
Wide Field Observation Mode lasts for 30s.
- Upon entering Wide Field Observation Mode, Mornye generates a "Syntony Field".
- While in Wide Field Observation Mode, Mornye gains "Relative Momentum".
- If "Relative Momentum" is below 100 when holding Normal Attack, perform Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode Stage 1 to 3 in sequence. If "Relative Momentum" reaches 100 during this time, cast Heavy Attack - Inversion instead.
- While moving, Mornye continuously consumes STA. STA cannot be recovered while in Wide Field Observation Mode.
- When Dodging with directional input, Mornye starts to fly at speed, which lasts for up to 10s or until STA is depleted or until the Wide Field Observation Mode ends.
- When Mornye is hit or launched into mid-air, Dodge to immediately recover from the attack, which is considered a successful Dodge. This effect can be triggered up to 3 times, which resets when Wide Field Observation Mode ends.
- Jump and Mornye will slowly descend. Before she lands, Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode, Resonance Skill - Distributed Array, and Heavy Attack - Inversion are unavailable. If Jump is when Mornye runs out of STA, she will exit the Wide Field Observation Mode. She will leave the Wide Field Observation Mode also when she Dodges, Jumps, or performs Mid-air Attacks.
Additionally, performing environmental interactions, using Utilities, or switching to another Resonator ends Wide Field Observation Mode. The state also ends when Mornye is no longer airborne.

Syntony Field
- Syntony Field lasts for 25s.
- When the Syntony Field is generated, deal Fusion DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
- Continuously restores HP for nearby active Resonators in the team within the Syntony Field, triggered once every 3s.
- Increases the Off-Tune Buildup Rate of all nearby Resonators in the team within the Syntony Field by 50%.
- Enhances the resistance to interruption of nearby active Resonators in the team within the Syntony Field.

Heavy Attack - Inversion
- When "Relative Momentum" reaches 100 points, Heavy Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack - Inversion.
- Consume all "Relative Momentum" to cast Heavy Attack - Inversion, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
- Heavy Attack - Inversion inflicts "Observation Marker" upon the target on hit for 30s.

Observation Marker
When a Resonator in the team deals "Tune Break" DMG to a target inflicted with Observation Marker, Mornye inflicts an "Interfered Marker" on the target for 8s.

Interfered Marker
Targets affected by "Tune Rupture - Interfered" or "Tune Strain - Interfered" take increased DMG from all nearby Resonators in the team. For every 1% of Mornye's Energy Regen exceeding 100%, their DMG is increased by 0.25%, up to 40%.

Visual Field
When a Resonator in the team defeats a target inflicted with "Observation Marker" or "Interfered Marker", Mornye gains Visual Field for 3s. While in this state, Mornye inflicts "Observation Marker" on the target hit whenever any Resonator in the team deals damage.

Tune Rupture Response - Particle Jet
Mornye deals one instance of Fusion DMG to targets in the "Tune Rupture - Interfered" state within range, considered Tune Rupture DMG.

Rest Mass Energy
Mornye can hold up to 100 points of Rest Mass Energy.
While in "Baseline Mode", she gains Rest Mass Energy when performing Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Dodge Counter, or when Resonance Skill - Optimal Solution hits a target.

Relative Momentum
Mornye can hold up to 100 points of Relative Momentum.
While in "Wide Field Observation Mode", she gains Relative Momentum when Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode, Dodge Counter - Wide Field Observation Mode or Resonance Skill - Distributed Array hits the target.
Mornye cannot gain Relative Momentum during Heavy Attack - Inversion.

texts.name: Critical Protocol
texts.description:
Attack the targets within the effective range, dealing Fusion DMG.
For every 1% of Mornye's Energy Regen exceeding 100%, this skill gains an additional 0.5% Crit. Rate (up to 80%) and 1% Crit. DMG (up to 160%).
When casting this skill, if a "Syntony Field" is present, remove it and generate a "High Syntony Field".
Can be performed in mid-air.

High Syntony Field
- High Syntony Field lasts for 25s. 
- Increases the DEF of all nearby Resonators in the team within the High Syntony Field by 20%.
- Inherits the "Syntony Field"'s boost to resistance to interruption and Off-Tune Buildup Rate.
- Inherits the "Syntony Field"'s healing effect and increases the Healing Multiplier by 40%.

baseTexts.roleDescription: Aemeath is an Off-Tune, Fusion character who utlizes two forms simaltaneously in combat to deal incredible AoE Fusion DMG. While in her Mecha form, shes also capable of flight at high speeds, making her an exceptional exploration unit as well.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis: Aemeath is a Fusion, Sword Wielding Main Damage Dealer who utilizes Off-Tune effects to enhance her kit, and deals insane AoE Damage. She is capable of swapping and jointly attacking the enemy with her Mech, and then finishing them off with her incredible Rail Gun. She utilizes Resonance Liberation DMG to deal damage.
baseTexts.introductionDescription:
Use Aemeath's initial Resonance Liberation ONLY after an intro skill.

This will allow her to gain 2 stacks of her Response Rate when her Resonance Liberation is used.

Be sure that Aemeath has all buffs before unleashing her Finale finisher, as it is a huge portion of her overall damage.
baseTexts.introductionDetail:
Aemeath attacks in two distinct forms. Mech Form, and herself. Her Resonance Skill will allow her to swap between her Mech Form, and her Human Form.

She is able to attack in unison with both forms by casting her Resonance Skill during basic attack combos. Utlizing this joint combo will raise Aemeath's Resonance Rate.

Resonance Rate is Capped at 4, and as Aemeath raises her Forge Gauge by performing attacks, she unlocks the ability is able to cast her Enhanced Resonance Skill, Seraphic Duo.

Seraphic Duo is only castable after performing Basic Attack 4 in either Mech or Human form, and casting it depletes her forte.

The Enhanced Resonance Skill will grant Aemeath one stack of Response Rate. Casting Aemeath's Resonance Liberation will also grant one stack of Response Rate, and unlock the ability to cast her Enhanced Resonance Liberation.

If Aemeath performs an Intro Skill, her Resonance Liberation will give two stacks of Response Rate instead. Once she reaches 4 stacks, she enters a new state, enhancing her Resonance Skills.

Additionally, she is able to cast her Enhanced Heavy Attack dealing significant damage, and this unlocks her Finale attack, Heavenfall Edict: Finale, the most powerful move in her kit.

Unleashing this powerful attack deals a gigantic nuke of AoE fusion damage to every enemy present.

Seraphic Duo
When casting Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 4 or Basic Attack - Mech Stage 4, enter Seraphic Duo for 5s.

When Aemeath is in Seraphic Duo and the "Synchronization Rate" is no less than 100 points, Resonance Skill to cast Resonance Skill Seraphic Duet: Overture at the cost of 100 points of "Synchronization Rate", dealing Fusion DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.

Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Switch back to Aemeath and exit the Seraphic Duo state. Normal Attack shortly afterward to cast Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 2.

Resonance Mode
- In Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture, when Resonators in the team respond to "Tune Rupture - Interfered", inflict 10 of "Rupturous Trail" on the target for 30s, stacking up to 30 times.

- In Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, when Resonators in the team inflict "Fusion Burst", inflict 1 of "Fusion Trail" for 30s, stacking up to 30 times.
While in combat, when the "Fusion Burst" on targets near the active Resonator reaches 0 stacks, inflict 1 stack of "Fusion Burst". If the targets have more than 5 stacks of "Fusion Burst", trigger "Fusion Burst" based on their max stack limit and remove all of their stacks.

In Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture/Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, inflict "Tune Rupture - Shifting"/"Fusion Burst" when the following skills deal damage. The same skill can only trigger this effect on the same target once every 3s:
Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 3 & 4, Basic Attack - Mech Stage 3 & 4, Resonance Skill Sync Strike: Armament Merge, Resonance Skill Sync Strike: Call of Dawn, Intro Skill Songs Across the Universe, and Intro Skill Debut of Meteoric Radiance.

Resonance Skill "Seraphic Duet" gains the following enhancements based on Aemeath's Resonance Mode:
- When in Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture, Resonance Skill "Seraphic Duet" removes "Rupturous Trail" stacks on nearby targets and additionally deals 5 instances of Tune Rupture DMG, each time to a random target within range. For each stack of "Rupturous Trail" removed from a target, the DMG Multiplier of the additional instances of Tune Rupture DMG triggered by "Seraphic Duet" against the target is increased by 4%. This effect lasts for 1s. The target's Off-Tune Level does not affect the triggering of these instances of Tune Rupture DMG.
- When in Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, Resonance Skill "Seraphic Duet" removes the "Fusion Trail" stacks on targets if they are inflicted with "Fusion Trail", and trigger the "Fusion Burst" on the target based on its max stack limit without removing its stacks. Each stack of "Fusion Trail" removed from the target increases the DMG Multiplier of "Fusion Burst" on the main target by 10%.

When in Stardust Resonance, Resonance Skill "Seraphic Duet" gains the following enhancements based on Aemeath's Resonance Mode:
- In Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture, casting Resonance Skill "Seraphic Duet" additionally deal 10 instances of Tune Rupture DMG.
- In Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, the DMG Multiplier of "Fusion Burst" triggered by Resonance Skill "Seraphic Duet" on the main target is additionally increased by 200%. The DMG Multiplier increase effect is stackable with that provided by "Fusion Trail".

Tune Rupture Response - Starburst
Active in Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture. Deal Fusion DMG to targets within range that are affected by "Tune Rupture - Interfered", considered Tune Rupture DMG.

Starflux Thrust
When in the Mech form and "Starflux" is more than 200, use the Utility button to cast Starflux Thrust and soar in the air by continuously consuming "Starflux".

Synchronization Rate
Synchronization Rate is capped at 200 points.
- Dealing damage with Basic Attack - Aemeath, Mid-air Attack - Aemeath, Dodge Counter - Aemeath, Basic Attack - Mech, Mid-air Attack - Mech, Dodge Counter - Mech, Resonance Skill Sync Strike: Armament Merge, and Resonance Skill Sync Strike: Call of Dawn recovers Synchronization Rate.
- Casting Intro Skill Songs Across the Universe and Debut of Meteoric Radiance recovers 40 points of Synchronization Rate.
- Casting Resonance Liberation Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive recovers 30 points of Synchronization Rate.
- When in "Instant Response" and "Heavenfall Edict: Unbound" at the same time, casting Heavy Attack - Aemeath Charged II or Heavy Attack - Mech Charged II recovers 200 points of Synchronization Rate.

Resonance Rate
Resonance Rate is capped at 4 points.
- Casting Resonance Skill "Seraphic Duet" recovers 1 point of Resonance Rate.
- Casting Resonance Liberation Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive recovers 1 point of Resonance Rate.
- When in Starlume Acceleration, casting Resonance Liberation Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive additionally recovers 1 point of Resonance Rate.

Starflux
Starflux is capped at 600 points.
Starflux recovers naturally over time.

While in combat, when the "Fusion Burst" on targets near the active Resonator reaches 0 stacks, inflict 1 stack of "Fusion Burst". If the targets have more than 5 stacks of "Fusion Burst", trigger "Fusion Burst" based on their max stack limit and remove all of their stacks.

In Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture/Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, inflict "Tune Rupture - Shifting"/"Fusion Burst" when the following skills deal damage. The same skill can only trigger this effect on the same target once every 3s:
Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 3 & 4, Basic Attack - Mech Stage 3 & 4, Resonance Skill Sync Strike: Armament Merge, Resonance Skill Sync Strike: Call of Dawn, Intro Skill Songs Across the Universe, and Intro Skill Debut of Meteoric Radiance.

Resonance Skill "Seraphic Duet" gains the following enhancements based on Aemeath's Resonance Mode:
- When in Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture, Resonance Skill "Seraphic Duet" removes "Rupturous Trail" stacks on nearby targets and additionally deals 5 instances of Tune Rupture DMG, each time to a random target within range. For each stack of "Rupturous Trail" removed from a target, the DMG Multiplier of the additional instances of Tune Rupture DMG triggered by "Seraphic Duet" against the target is increased by 4%. This effect lasts for 1s. The target's Off-Tune Level does not affect the triggering of these instances of Tune Rupture DMG.
- When in Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, Resonance Skill "Seraphic Duet" removes the "Fusion Trail" stacks on targets if they are inflicted with "Fusion Trail", and trigger the "Fusion Burst" on the target based on its max stack limit without removing its stacks. Each stack of "Fusion Trail" removed from the target increases the DMG Multiplier of "Fusion Burst" on the main target by 10%.

When in Stardust Resonance, Resonance Skill "Seraphic Duet" gains the following enhancements based on Aemeath's Resonance Mode:
- In Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture, casting Resonance Skill "Seraphic Duet" additionally deal 10 instances of Tune Rupture DMG.
- In Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, the DMG Multiplier of "Fusion Burst" triggered by Resonance Skill "Seraphic Duet" on the main target is additionally increased by 200%. The DMG Multiplier increase effect is stackable with that provided by "Fusion Trail".

Tune Rupture Response - Starburst
Active in Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture. Deal Fusion DMG to targets within range that are affected by "Tune Rupture - Interfered", considered Tune Rupture DMG.

Starflux Thrust
When in the Mech form and "Starflux" is more than 200, use the Utility button to cast Starflux Thrust and soar in the air by continuously consuming "Starflux".

Synchronization Rate
Synchronization Rate is capped at 200 points.
- Dealing damage with Basic Attack - Aemeath, Mid-air Attack - Aemeath, Dodge Counter - Aemeath, Basic Attack - Mech, Mid-air Attack - Mech, Dodge Counter - Mech, Resonance Skill Sync Strike: Armament Merge, and Resonance Skill Sync Strike: Call of Dawn recovers Synchronization Rate.
- Casting Intro Skill Songs Across the Universe and Debut of Meteoric Radiance recovers 40 points of Synchronization Rate.
- Casting Resonance Liberation Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive recovers 30 points of Synchronization Rate.
- When in "Instant Response" and "Heavenfall Edict: Unbound" at the same time, casting Heavy Attack - Aemeath Charged II or Heavy Attack - Mech Charged II recovers 200 points of Synchronization Rate.

Resonance Rate
Resonance Rate is capped at 4 points.
- Casting Resonance Skill "Seraphic Duet" recovers 1 point of Resonance Rate.
- Casting Resonance Liberation Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive recovers 1 point of Resonance Rate.
- When in Starlume Acceleration, casting Resonance Liberation Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive additionally recovers 1 point of Resonance Rate.

Starflux
Starflux is capped at 600 points.
Starflux recovers naturally over time.

While in Sealed Trail - Tune Rupture or Sealed Trail - Fusion Burst, Aemeath records the highest stack count of "Rupturous Trail"/"Fusion Trail" among the targets defeated.
Her next skill that directly damages the target immediately inflicts the targets with the recorded stacks of "Rupturous Trail"/"Fusion Trail", up to the current max limit of "Rupturous Trail"/"Fusion Trail".
