1. Denia is a dual-system sub-DPS/support for Fusion Burst and Tune Strain, focusing on Resonance Liberation DMG.
2. In Fusion Burst mode, Denia can apply [Fusion Burst] to enemies, increase teamwide Fusion DMG, and her Outro Skill increases the [Fusion Burst] DMG taken by enemies around the on-field character.

Next, cast Stagecraft Form Resonance Liberation to switch into Breakdown Form. Use Basic Attacks and 2 enhanced Resonance Skills to build [Conformal Charge]. baseTexts.introductionDetail:
Team Comp:
Denia is a dual-system sub-DPS/support for Fusion Burst and Tune Strain, focusing on Resonance Liberation DMG. Prioritize pairing with Fusion Burst or Tune Strain main DPS.

Team Comp & Rotation:
In the following rotations: A = Basic Attack; H = Heavy Attack; E = Resonance Skill; R = Resonance Liberation; Q = Echo Skill.

Fusion Burst System
● Aemeath + Denia + Chisa.
Chisa increases the [Fusion Burst] limit cap for enemies, applies DEF reduction and DEF ignore effects, and provides healing and shielding for the entire team. Denia increases teamwide Fusion DMG, applies [Fusion Burst], and increases [Fusion Burst] vulnerability.
① Chisa starts with Q-R-E-A*n- Enhanced E - Hold A (Enhanced A + Ultimate A) to achieve full Concerto Energy;
② Denia enters with Intro Skill + A - E - R1 - AAAA - EE - R2 to achieve full Concerto Energy;
③ Aemeath enters with Intro Skill, uses AAE-R-AAAE-AAAE-H - Enhanced R to achieve full Concerto Energy;
④ Chisa enters with Intro Skill and repeats the previous rotation.

Tune Strain Team
● Luuk Herssen + Denia + Mornye.
Mornye improves the Off-Tune Buildup Rate and DMG for the entire team, and ensures the team's survival. Denia applies [Tune Strain - Shifting] and triggers [Tune Strain - Interfered], increasing teamwide Tune Break Boost, while also boosting Luuk Herssen's total DMG.
① Mornye starts with E-A*n- Enhanced H - Enhanced E - Enhanced A*n - Ultimate H-RQ to achieve full Concerto Energy;
② Denia enters with Intro Skill + A - E - R1 - AAAA - EE - R2 to achieve full Concerto Energy;
③ Luuk Herssen enters with Intro Skill + AAE-AAAAE-AAAAE-A-RQ to achieve full Concerto Energy;
④ Mornye enters with Intro Skill. Enhanced E - Enhanced A*n - Ultimate H-RQ to achieve full Concerto Energy;
⑤ Denia enters with Intro Skill and repeats the previous rotation.

roleResonanceTexts.recommendDescription:
● S1: Increases Crit. DMG. Stagecraft Form Resonance Skill, Breakdown Form's 2 enhanced Resonance Skill, A3, A4, and 3rd/4th hits of Mid-air Attack are immune to interruptions. Grants Entropy Shift on entering combat. Improves DMG, optimizes combat flow, and enhances off-field support.

● S2: In Fusion Burst mode, when teammates apply [Fusion Burst], their Fusion DMG is increased. When enemies near the on-field character trigger [Fusion Burst], Denia ignores a portion of Fusion RES. Effect ends early when switching modes. In Tune Strain mode, when teammates apply [Tune Strain - Shifting], their [Tune Break Boost] increases, and targets accumulate [Off-Tune Level] up to 100%. This effect can trigger once per target every 300s and ends early when switching modes. DMG of Breakdown Form's 2 enhanced Resonance Skill is increased. Greatly enhances team support while also improving personal DMG.

● S3: Increases Breakdown Form Resonance Liberation DMG. Increases [Dark Core] cap and gain efficiency. In Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form, increases [Void Particle] generation per second, and restores additional Concerto Energy when casting Breakdown Form Resonance Liberation. Entering combat fully restores [Dark Core] and [Void Particle]. When [Dark Core] is full, casting Stagecraft Form A4 or Resonance Skill consumes all [Dark Cores] to increase DMG. Enables instant setup on entry, shortens rotation, and boosts DMG.

● S6: During Entropy Shift, increases ATK and Fusion DMG. In Fusion Burst mode, DMG from the Erosion Field can trigger [Fusion Burst], increasing DMG to the main target without consuming stacks. Triggers once per target, and resets after the target takes DMG from Breakdown Form Resonance Liberation. In Tune Strain mode, when teammates deal Tune Break DMG to [Mistuned] targets with [Tune Strain - Shifting], 1 additional stack of [Tune Strain - Interfered] is applied, triggering once every 3s per target. Greatly increases personal DMG, enhances Fusion Burst effects, and speeds up Tune Strain stacking.
Denia's core Resonance Chains are S1, 2, 3, 6. If feasible, aim for S2 for the best value. For dedicated fans, S6 is worthwhile.

baseTexts.introductionDetail:
1. Resonance Skill
Summons [Thunder Wedge] that deals Electro DMG and creates a Thunder Field around Thunder Wedge. Thunder Wedge lasts 12 seconds. When Forte Circuit Rumbling Spark or Resonance Liberation is used, all existing [Thunder Wedges] will detonate, dealing Electro DMG (treated as Resonance Skill DMG).
● [Thunder Field]: While active character stands inside the Thunder Field, their attacks trigger Coordinated Attacks from the [Thunder Wedge] once every 1.2s (duration: 1.5s).
2. Forte Circuit
When [Readiness] is fully charged, hold E to consume all [Readiness] and cast Rumbling Spark, entering Lightning Infused. Additionally, if [Readiness] is full when casting the Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge, it will trigger Thunder Uprising.
In Lightning Infused:
● Resistance to interruption increases.
● Yuanwu’s ability to reduce enemy Vibration Strength is significantly enhanced.
● Within 3 seconds after a Heavy Attack or a successful Counterattack, tapping Basic Attack will trigger Thunderweaver, dealing Electro DMG (counts as Basic Attack DMG).
[Readiness]: Max cap is 100. ① Regenerates 6 points per second when a [Thunder Wedge] is present. This can work off-field. ② Each successful Coordinated Attack from the [Thunder Wedge] restores 5 points.
3. Resonance Liberation
Deal Electro DMG and grant Lightning Infused state to all team members for 10 seconds.
4. Normal Attack
● Basic Attack: up to 5-hit combo.
● Heavy Attack: Continuously consumes STA to attack.
● Mid-air Attack: Consumes STA to perform a Plunging Attack.
● Dodge Counter: Triggered by dodging and shortly tapping Basic Attack.
5. Intro Skill
Deals Electro DMG.
6. Outro Skill
Call down a lightning strike centered on the target, dealing significant Vibration Strength DMG to enemies hit.

Team Comp Analysis: Yuanwu’s frequent and reliable Coordinated Attacks make him ideal for building Jinhsi’s passive stacks.

Team Comp & Rotation:
In the following rotations: A = Basic Attack; H = Heavy Attack; E = Resonance Skill; R = Resonance Liberation; Q = Echo Skill.

● Jinhsi + Yuanwu + Verina/Shorekeeper/Baizhi
Yuanwu's Coordinated Attack accelerates Jinhsi’s passive stack. Verina, Shorekeeper, or Baizhi offer healing and DMG buffs.
① Jinhsi starts with E-A*4-E2-E3-A*4-E4 to trigger Unison;
② Yuanwu enters with Intro Skill + E;
③ Healer quickly fully charges Concerto Energy.
④ Jinhsi enters with Intro Skill + E2-Q-R-AAA-E3-A-E4;
⑤ Repeat.

Thunder Wedge

Yuanwu summons Thunder Wedge, dealing Electro DMG, and forms a Thunder Field centered on the Thunder Wedge. Thunder Wedge lasts for 12s.

Forte Circuit Rumbling Spark and Resonance Liberation Blazing Might will immediately detonate Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge on the field, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.



Thunder Field

Thunder Uprising

When "Readiness" is full, Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge will be replaced with Thunder Uprising, dealing Electro DMG.



Lightning Infused

The character in Lightning Infused state has a greatly increased resistance to interruption.

When Yuanwu is in this state:

-Basic Attacks: Hit targets in a larger range, reduce enemy Vibration Strength with increased efficiency.

-Heavy Attacks: Have increased attack speed, reduce enemy Vibration Strength with increased efficiency.

-Dodge Counters: Have increased attack speed, reduce enemy Vibration Strength with increased efficiency.

-Use Basic Attack within 3s after casting a Heavy Attack or a successful Counterattack to cast Thunderweaver, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Basic Attack DMG.

-Does not recover "Readiness".



Readiness

Yuanwu can hold up to 100 "Readiness".

When Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge is on the field, Yuanwu gains 6 "Readiness" every second, even when he is not the active character;

When Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge hits a target with a Coordinated Attack, Yuanwu gains 5 "Readiness".

baseTexts.roleDescription: Jinhsi is an Spectro character typically used as an on-field main DPS. Jinhsi specializes in Resonance Skill DMG. With a wide attack range, excellent targeting, and high burst potential, she boasts both high floor and high ceiling performance.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
Core Mechanics: Incandescence. Jinhsi Resonance Skill - Illuminous Epiphany (E4) consumes [Incandescence] to significantly boost DMG.
[Incandescence] Gain:
① Gains 1 [Incandescence] when allies inflict Attribute DMG. Triggered by DMG of the same Attribute for up to 1 time every 3s.
② Gains 2 [Incandescence] when allies damage the enemy with Coordinated Attacks. Triggered by Coordinated Attacks of the same Attribute for up to 1 time every 3s.
After using an Outro Skill, Incandescence’s CD is reduced to 1s for 20 seconds.
(Note: Each Attribute and method has an independent CD.)
baseTexts.introductionDescription: Team Comp Analysis: Jinhsi’s DMG primarily comes from Resonance Skill, while Coordinated Attacks help her accumulate [Incandescence]. She synergizes well with teammates who boost Resonance Skill DMG or offer Coordinated Attacks.
baseTexts.introductionDetail: Rotation: A-A-A-A/Intro Skill-E2-A-A-Q-E3-A-A-E4-R

Overflowing Radiance

Resonance Skill Overflowing Radiance inflicts Spectro DMG and sends Jinhsi into Incarnation.

texts.name: Luminal Synthesis
texts.description:
Incarnation

While in Incarnation:

- Alternative Basic Attack "Incarnation - Basic Attack" becomes available. Perform up to 4 consecutive strikes, dealing Spectro DMG considered as Resonance Skill DMG. The basic attack cycle of this will not be reset. Can be cast in mid-air.

- Alternative Resonance Skill "Crescent Divinity" becomes available. Deal Spectro DMG. Can be cast in mid-air.

- Alternative Heavy Attack "Incarnation - Heavy Attack" becomes available. Attack the target in mid-air at the cost of Stamina, dealing Spectro DMG.

- Alternative Dodge "Incarnation - Dodge" is available while in mid-air. Can be cast multiple times at the cost of Stamina.

- Alternative Dodge Counter "Incarnation - Dodge Counter" becomes available. Deal Spectro DMG.

Can be cast in mid-air.



Resonance Skill - Illuminous Epiphany

After Stage 4 of Incarnation - Basic Attack, Incarnation terminates and Jinhsi gains Ordination Glow. 

Can be cast in mid-air.

While Ordination Glow lasts:

- Basic Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack "Incarnation - Heavy Attack". Attack the target in mid-air at the cost of Stamina, dealing Spectro DMG.

- Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill "Illuminous Epiphany". Send out Solar Flare that detonates as Stella Glamor, dealing Spectro DMG after a short delay. Consume up to 50 Incandescence, with each point of Incandescence granting bonus DMG Multiplier percentage to Stella Glamor.

Can be cast in mid-air.

- After casting Resonance Skill Illuminous Epiphany, Jinhsi gains Unison. This can be triggered once every 25s.



Unison

While Jinhsi has Unison, switching to other Resonators will remove Jinhsi's Unison to trigger Jinhsi's Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator's Intro Skill. Unison will be consumed in priority in place of Concerto Energy when Concerto Energy is full.



Incandescence

Jinhsi can hold up to 50 Incandescence.

When Jinhsi is in the party, all nearby Resonators in the party gain Eras in Unity.

Eras in Unity provides 2 independent effects:

Jinhsi gains 1 Incandescence anytime Resonators in the party inflict Attribute DMG. This effect may be triggered by damage of the same Attribute for up to 1 time(s) every 3s. Additionally, Jinhsi gains 2 Incandescence when Resonators in the party damage the enemy with Coordinated Attacks. This effect may be triggered by Coordinated Attacks of the same Attribute for up to 1 time(s) every 3s.

baseTexts.roleDescription:
Augusta, the undefeated gladiator of the agon, sets forth red lightning, and bashes enemies with her Gryphon.

Augusta unleases quickpaced slashes, and zips through the battlefield like an active lightning bolt, only to stop time when her Resonance Liberation activates, before decimating her foes.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis: Augusta is an electro broadblade user, who specalizes in heavy attacks. Her gameplay consist of utilizing her teammates Outro Skill to unlock her Resonance Liberation, which unleashes insane damage while also stopping time for the enemy. She is able to consistently keep up a shield, so she is quite durable in combat as well.
baseTexts.introductionDescription: When Augusta uses her Outro Skill, you can use your teammates Outro Skills will quickly unlock Augusta's Resonance Liberation.
baseTexts.introductionDetail:
Augusta is a character that uses her liberation to deal significant damage while also utilizing her forte to unleash heavy attacks throughout her rotation. She has two Resonance Liberations. One functions as normal while the other is unlocked when she maxes out Manifest. Manifest is a completely separate gauge, and it is filled in a few ways.                                                                                

  1. Using her Forte Bar until her enhanced Resonance skill becomes available.                                              
  2. Using other characters Outro Skill when they are under the effect of Augusta's Outro SkillThe Manifest gauge is capped at 2, and once it maxes out, Augusta can cast her enhanced Resonance Liberation, to stop time, and deliver a flurry of slashes on the foe, before unleashing a thunderous strike to finish them off.  Her core gameplay consist of building her manifest thorugh her gameplay, or using your other characters Outro skill, and then swapping to Augusta to use her  enhanced Resonance Liberation on the enemy.

baseTexts.introductionSynopsis: Buling is a support character capable of healing the team and inflicting her debuff. baseTexts.introductionDetail: Buling is a powerful support resonator who assist the team with supplementary damage, buffing, and constant healing throughout her kit. She is capable of inflicting stacks of Electro Flare, a debuff that periodically deals damage. Buling must stack Trigrams to fuel her forte, and she gains Trigrams by using Basic Attack 2, and Basic Attack 4. You can hold up to 4 Trigrams. She can also follow up her Resonnace Skill With a Basic Attack to cast Basic Attack 4. By utilizing her heavy attacks, you will gain Minor Yin and Yang, which will put her into Yin-Yang Balance State, unlocking her Enhanced Resonance Liberation. Casting her Enhanced Resonance Liberation will provide buffs to her allies. This state increases the teams Resonace Skill DMG when they cast Intro Skills, and also inflicts stacks of Electro Flare every few seconds. Additionally, her Outro Skill Amplifies the teams DMG by 15%.

weaponTexts.recommendDescription:
Variation makes an excellent weapon for Buling, allowing her to quickly build her Forte and provides all of the Energy Regen she will need.

Cosmic ripples is a great secondary weapon, providing greater healing, and a decent amount of Energy Regen.

For those who want to fulling invest into Buling's damage, then Stringmaster is the best choice. Buling is better as a supportive character however.

baseTexts.roleDescription:
1. Rebecca is a sub-DPS who primarily deals Basic Attack DMG.
2. Rebecca is a Hack character within the Off-Tune mechanic. She can apply [Hack - Shifting] to enemies and trigger responses to [Hack - Interfered], dealing Hack DMG.
3. Rebecca has 2 combat modes, Pistol and Shotgun. After casting her Resonance Liberation, she can also use an HMG for automatic attacks, making her highly versatile and fun to play.
4. Rebecca can increase the entire team's ATK and boost teammates' Tune Break Boost when they apply [Hack - Shifting].
5. Rebecca's Outro Skill summons a turret that continuously attacks, while increasing the next character's DMG Amplification for all Attributes and Heavy Attack DMG.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
1. Tip: Enter via Intro Skill and build [Fervor]. Continue using Basic Attacks to gain more [Fervor]. Once full, hold Basic Attack to cast enhanced Heavy Attack, then cast Resonance Liberation. During Resonance Liberation, tap Basic Attack or Resonance Liberation to increase its power and firing speed. Stay on-field until BOOM! Fireworks! is automatically triggered, then swap out.                                                                    Rotation: Intro Skill - A*n - Enhanced H - R1 - AA - R2 - Outro Skill.
2. Team Comp: Rebecca works best with Hack main DPS (especially Lucy), or main DPS focused on Heavy Attack DMG. Her current best team is Lucy + Rebecca + Mornye.
3. Echo Set: [Shadow of Shattered Dreams] 1-pc + [Endless Vibrations] 2-pc + [Void Thunder] 2-pc.

baseTexts.introductionDetail:
Team Comp:
As a Hack character, Rebecca provides teamwide ATK buffs, increases allies' Tune Break Boost when they apply [Hack - Shifting], and further boosts teammates' DMG Amplification for all Attributes and Heavy Attack DMG. She is best paired with Hack main DPS or main DPS focused on Heavy Attack DMG.
 
Team Comp & Rotation:
In the following rotations: A = Basic Attack; H = Heavy Attack; E = Resonance Skill; R = Resonance Liberation; Q = Echo Skill.
 
● Lucy + Rebecca + Mornye.
Best Team Comp! Both Rebecca and Lucy belong to the Hack system. Rebecca provides teamwide ATK buffs, increases both her own and Lucy's Tune Break Boost, and further enhances Lucy's DMG Amplification for all Attributes and Heavy Attack DMG. Mornye provides DMG Amplification for all Attributes for the team, additional DMG buffs, and strong survivability.
① Mornye starts with E-A*n- Enhanced H - Enhanced E - Enhanced A*n - Ultimate H-RQ to achieve full Concerto Energy;
② Rebecca enters with Intro Skill + A*n - Enhanced H - R1 - AA - R2 to achieve full Concerto Energy;
③ Lucy enters with Intro Skill + E1E2 - A*n - Enhanced E - Enhanced A*n - Enhanced H2H3 - Enhanced R to achieve full Concerto Energy;
④ Mornye enters with Intro Skill. Enhanced E - Enhanced A*n - Ultimate H-RQ to achieve full Concerto Energy;
⑤ Rebecca enters with Intro Skill and repeats the previous rotation.
 
● Jiyan + Rebecca + Shorekeeper/Verina.
Rebecca provides teamwide ATK buffs while increasing Jiyan's DMG Amplification for all Attributes and Heavy Attack DMG. Shorekeeper/Verina provides additional DMG buffs and healing.
① Jiyan starts with EQ, not fully stacking Concerto Energy;
② Healer quickly fully charges Concerto Energy;
③ Rebecca enters with Intro Skill + A*n - Enhanced H - R1 - AA - R2 to achieve full Concerto Energy;
④ Jiyan takes the field with Intro Skill + R-E-A*n-E-A*n to achieve full Concerto Energy;
⑤ Healer enters with Intro Skill and repeats the previous rotation.

texts.name: Mix-'n'-Match
texts.description:
Basic Attack - Huntress
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack - Huntress
Hold Normal Attack to continuously fire at enemies at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
- Hold and then release Normal Attack while Rebecca is not casting Tactical Dodge - Huntress to cast Heavy Attack - Eat Lead!: Huntress

Heavy Attack - Eat Lead!: Huntress
Deal Electro DMG.

Comin' in Hot! - Huntress
Somersault in mid-air and land.
Keep holding Normal Attack after casting this skill to follow up with Heavy Attack - Huntress without consuming STA.

Mid-air Plunging Attack - Huntress
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter - Huntress
Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to strike the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Tactical Dodge - Huntress
Press Dodge to attack the target while dodging, dealing Electro DMG.
Can be cast during the following actions (while on the ground):
- Performing Basic Attack - Huntress.
- Performing Heavy Attack - Huntress.
- Performing Heavy Attack - Eat Lead!: Huntress
- Casting Comin' in Hot! - Huntress.
- Casting Tactical Dodge - Huntress.
- Casting Resonance Skill.
- Casting Intro Skill.
Additional Electro DMG is dealt upon a successful Dodge during Tactical Dodge - Huntress.
Keep holding Normal Attack after casting this skill to follow up with Heavy Attack - Huntress without consuming STA.

Basic Attack - Guts
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.
Casting Tactical Dodge - Guts does not reset Basic Attack - Huntress's attack cycle within a certain time.

Heavy Attack - Guts
Consume STA and attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Mid-air Plunging Attack - Guts
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter - Guts
Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to strike the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Tactical Dodge - Guts
Press Dodge and attack the target while dodging, dealing Electro DMG.
Can be cast during the following actions (while on the ground):
- Performing Basic Attack - Guts.
- Casting Tactical Dodge - Guts.
- Casting Resonance Skill.
- Casting Intro Skill.
Additional Electro DMG is dealt upon a successful Dodge during Tactical Dodge - Guts.

texts.name: Tactical Tweaks
texts.description:
Resonance Skill - It's Big Boomin' Time!
Resonance Skill when in the Huntress mode to close the distance and spray lead at enemies, then switch to the Guts mode to blast the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Resonance Skill - Come 'n' Get Me!
Resonance Skill when in the Guts mode to spray lead at the enemy, then use recoil from shooting the ground to close the distance and switch to Huntress mode to continue the barrage, dealing Electro DMG.
or hold Normal Attack when close to the ground shortly after casting this skill to follow up with Comin' in Hot! - Huntress.

texts.name: Gloves Are Comin' Off!
texts.description:
Switch Gears!
Upon casting Resonance Skill or Intro Skill, Rebecca can freely switch between the Huntress and Guts modes.
- The Huntress mode increases Rebecca's Crit. DMG by 30%.
- The Guts mode allows Rebecca to ignore 15% of the target's DEF.
By default, Rebecca starts in the Huntress mode.

Hack - Shifting
Rebecca inflicts Hack - Shifting upon dealing damage to the targets through the following skills. The same skill can trigger this effect once every 3s:
Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!, Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress, Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts, and Resonance Liberation - BOOM! Fireworks!.

Hack Response - Meltdown
Deal Electro DMG to all targets affected by Hack - Interfered within the range, considered Hack DMG.

Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress
At 120 points of Fervor, Heavy Attack - Huntress is replaced with Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress. Hold Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress, which consumes all Fervor to pull in nearby targets and deal Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
During Heavy Attack - Huntress, if Fervor is at 120 points and Rebecca is not in the action of Tactical Dodge - Huntress, release Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress.

Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts
At 120 points of Fervor, Heavy Attack - Guts is replaced with Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts. Hold Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts, which consumes all Fervor to pull in nearby targets and deal Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

Fervor
Rebecca can hold up to 120 points of Fervor.
Normal Attacks restore Fervor upon damaging the target.
Resonance Skill restores Fervor upon damaging the target.
When A Girl Gets What She Wants! is gained by casting Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time! or Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, Rebecca restores 50 of Fervor.

Hot Hand
Rebecca can hold up to 120 points of Hot Hand.
Regenerates over time at a rate of 10 per second.
Casting Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress or Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts restores 40 .

A Girl Gets What She Wants!
At 120 points of Hot Hand, casting Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!, Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, Resonance Skill - It's Big Boomin' Time!, or Resonance Skill - Come 'n' Get Me! grants the following effects for 12s:
Rebecca simultaneously gains the Stat Bonuses of both the Huntress and Guts modes, regardless of which mode she's currently in.
Hot Hand cannot be restored during this period and is consumed by 10 per second.

texts.name: Party 'til Dawn!
texts.description:
Switching to Mk. 31 HMG mode generates a field of Stagnation for 9.5s, in which:
Rebecca fires the Mk. 31 HMG automatically, dealing Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG, while accumulating Overload. or hold Normal Attack or Resonance Liberation at intervals after Rebecca starts firing to enhance her Mk. 31 HMG's firepower and accumulate Overload faster. This effect can be triggered up to 2 times.
- The machine gun will only auto-lock onto the enemy closest to the crosshair in the aim down sight.
- Rebecca is immobile when firing the Mk. 31 HMG and gains 50% DMG Reduction and Immunity to Interrruption.

Overload
Rebecca can hold up to 90 points of Overload.
Hitting targets with the standard firepower Mk. 31 HMG grants 2 points.
Hitting targets with the enhanced firepower Mk. 31 HMG grants 4 points.
Hitting targets with the twice-enhanced firepower Mk. 31 HMG grants 6 points.

BOOM! Fireworks!
After Mk. 31 HMG mode ends or when Overload is maxed, BOOM! Fireworks! is automatically cast, dealing Electro DMG. Casting BOOM! Fireworks! ends Mk. 31 HMG.
- Hold Resonance Liberation while in Mk. 31 HMG mode to immediatly cast BOOM! Fireworks!.
- Leaving the Mk. 31 HMG mode removes all Overload.

texts.name: My Turn!
texts.description:
Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!
When in the Huntress mode, upon casting Intro Skill, Rebecca approaches the enemy and sprays lead with Huntress, then switches to the Guts mode to blast the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!
When in the Guts mode, upon casting Intro Skill, Rebecca approaches the enemy using the recoil of Guts from shooting the ground and switches to the Huntress mode to spray lead at the enemy, dealing Electro DMG.
Press or hold Normal Attack when close to the ground shortly after casting this skill to follow up with Comin' in Hot! - Huntress.

Resonance Skill when in the Huntress mode to close the distance and spray lead at enemies, then switch to the Guts mode to blast the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Resonance Skill - Come 'n' Get Me!
Resonance Skill when in the Guts mode to spray lead at the enemy, then use recoil from shooting the ground to close the distance and switch to Huntress mode to continue the barrage, dealing Electro DMG.
or hold Normal Attack when close to the ground shortly after casting this skill to follow up with Comin' in Hot! - Huntress.

texts.name: My Turn!
texts.description:
Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!
When in the Huntress mode, upon casting Intro Skill, Rebecca approaches the enemy and sprays lead with Huntress, then switches to the Guts mode to blast the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!
When in the Guts mode, upon casting Intro Skill, Rebecca approaches the enemy using the recoil of Guts from shooting the ground and switches to the Huntress mode to spray lead at the enemy, dealing Electro DMG.
Press or hold Normal Attack when close to the ground shortly after casting this skill to follow up with Comin' in Hot! - Huntress.

texts.name: Try Not to Get in the Way!
texts.description:
The DMG Multipliers of the following skills are increased by 50%: 
- Basic Attack - Huntress, Heavy Attack - Huntress, Tactical Dodge - Huntress, and Dodge Counter - Huntress
- Basic Attack - Guts, Tactical Dodge - Guts, Dodge Counter - Guts.
When A Girl Gets What She Wants! is triggered, Rebecca gains 3 additional of Street Smarts for 12s. Upon performing Tactical Dodge - Huntress or Tactical Dodge - Guts, if Rebecca has sufficient Street Smarts stacks, 1 will be consumed to restore 20 STA.
Resonance Liberation BOOM! Fireworks! is immune to interruption.

texts.name: Oh, Hey Choom!
texts.description:
Casting Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!, Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, or Resonance Liberation - Party 'til Dawn! grants 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for all Resonators in the team for 30s.
When Resonators in the team inflict Hack - Shifting, they gain 15% All DMG Amplification for 30s.
Hot Hand regenerates twice as fast when Rebecca is out of combat.

texts.name: Don't Sweat Your Six!
texts.description:
Rebecca's Resonance Liberation - Party 'til Dawn!, and Resonance Liberation - BOOM! Fireworks! gain 60% DMG Multiplier increase.
Rebecca's Resonance Liberation - Party 'til Dawn! gains 30% more explosion range.
Casting Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time! or Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me! grants 120 points of Hot Hand.

texts.name: Got Ya Covered!

texts.name: Dreamin' on the Edge
texts.description: Rebecca gains 20% Basic Attack DMG Bonus for 8s when she inflicts Hack - Shifting.

texts.name: Maybe, Just Maybe...
texts.description:
Rebecca's Basic Attack DMG Bonus from every source is increased by 40%.
During Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress or Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts, Rebecca deals an additional instance of Electro DMG equal to 900% of her ATK, considered Basic Attack DMG.
Rebecca recovers an additional 20 points of Hot Hand when she is casting Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress or Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts.
When Rebecca takes a fatal blow, she does not fall to the damage and instead restores fixed 2077 HP for 5 times immediately. This effect is triggered once every 10 min.
When Rebecca stays out of combat for more than 4s, she restores 120 of Fervor. This effect is triggered once every 4s.

roleResonanceTexts.recommendDescription:
● S2: Casting Intro Skill or Resonance Liberation increases all Attribute DMG for teammates. When teammates apply [Hack - Shifting], they gain DMG Amplification for all Attributes. Out of combat, [Hot Hand] recovers twice as fast. Further improves support capabilities and accelerates setup speed.

● S3: Increases the DMG multipliers of Party 'til Dawn! and BOOM! Fireworks!. Increases the explosion radius of Party 'til Dawn!. Casting Intro Skill fully restores [Hot Hand]. Improves DMG and AoE of Party 'til Dawn! Rebecca can immediately gain full benefits from both combat modes upon entering the field, eliminating ramp-up time.

● S6: Increases Basic Attack DMG. During either enhanced Heavy Attack, an additional high-DMG hit is triggered and is treated as Basic Attack DMG. Casting either enhanced Heavy Attack additionally restores [Hot Hand]. After being out of combat for 4s, [Fervor] is fully restored. This effect can trigger once every 4s. Massively increases DMG, enables long-duration combat, allows instant startup when entering battle, and unlocks a main DPS playstyle.
Rebecca's core Resonance Chains are S2, 3, 6. S2 and S3 offer the best value. For dedicated fans, S6 is worthwhile.

Inflicting Hack - Shifting grants (12%/15%/18%/21%/24%) Basic Attack DMG Bonus to the wielder for (14/14/14/14/14)s, and increases the ATK of Resonators in the team by (24%/30%/36%/42%/48%) for (30/30/30/30/30)s. weaponTexts.recommendDescription:
Skull Thrasher > Static Mist > Solar Flame
● Skull Thrasher: Rebecca's signature weapon. Provides a large Crit. DMG bonus and a stable ATK increase. After casting Intro Skill, Basic Attack DMG is increased. Applying [Hack - Shifting] further increases Basic Attack DMG and boosts the team's ATK. It increases personal DMG while strengthening support capabilities, making it a perfect fit.

● Static Mist: Provides a large Crit. Rate bonus and stable Energy Regen, while also increasing teammates' ATK. Improves Rebecca's Resonance Liberation rotation and further enhances her support capabilities, making it highly compatible.

● Solar Flame: Provides a large Crit. Rate bonus. Dealing Basic Attack or Heavy Attack DMG grants stacks that increase ATK and Heavy Attack DMG, fitting the DPS profile well.

baseTexts.roleDescription: Jiyan is an Aero on-field main DPS with an easy-to-master playstyle, AoE coverage, high attack frequency, and strong parry.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
Core Mechanics:
① When Jiyan accumulates at least 30 [Resolve], he can consume it to enhance his Resonance Skill DMG or unleash a stronger Resonance Liberation.
[Resolve] Source: Hitting enemies with Basic Attack or an Intro Skill generates [Resolve] (max 60). If Jiyan fails to land an attack within 15 seconds, [Resolve] will gradually deplete.
② After casting his Resonance Liberation, Jiyan enters a 10s enhanced state where his Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, and Dodge Counter transform into a special Heavy Attack.
baseTexts.introductionDescription:
Team Comp & Rotation:

● Jiyan + Mortefi + Shorekeeper/Verina/Baizhi
Best team. Mortefi provides Heavy Attack DMG buffs for Jiyan, while Shorekeeper, Verina, or Baizhi offer healing and DMG boosts.
① Jiyan starts with E;
② Healer quickly fully charges Concerto Energy.
③ Jiyan takes the field with Intro Skill + EQ;
④ Switch to Mortefi AAAA ER AAAA EQ to achieve full Concerto Energy.
⑤ Jiyan takes the field with Intro Skill + Q.

● Jiyan + Aalto + Shorekeeper/Verina/Baizhi
Alternative team. Aalto provides Aero and Heavy Attack DMG bonuses for Jiyan, while Shorekeeper, Verina, or Baizhi handle healing and DMG boosts.
① Jiyan starts with E;
② Switch to Aalto EAAAAA, without fully charging Concerto Energy;
③ Healer quickly fully charges Concerto Energy and leaves.
④ Jiyan takes the field with Intro Skill + EQ;
⑤ Switch to Aalto to achieve full Concerto Energy;
⑥ Jiyan takes the field with Intro Skill + Q.
baseTexts.introductionDetail:
Rotation: EQ - Switch to allies to achieve full Concerto Energy - Intro Skill - R - 10s DPS - Achieve full Concerto Energy and swap out

Team Comp Analysis: Jiyan is an Aero main DPS who primarily relies on Heavy Attack DMG. Allies who can provide Heavy Attack DMG bonus and Aero DMG bonus are the best choices.

baseTexts.roleDescription: Jianxin is an Aero sub-DPS/Support with strong grouping capabilities, plus healing and shielding utility. Her Outro Skill buffs teammates' Resonance Liberation.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
Core Mechanics: [Chi].
When Jianxin’s [Chi] is full, hold Basic Attack to start [Zhoutian Progress]. While in [Zhoutian Progress], she gains resistance to interruption and DMG reduction. Based on the phase of Zhoutian, she grants different shields that persist and heal the on-field character.
When holding Basic Attack at full [Chi], the gauge splits into 3 segments with white markers. [Chi] depletes right to left, cycling through: [Minor Zhoutian], [Minor Zhoutian], [Major Zhoutian: Inner]. Once [Chi] is depleted, Jianxin enters [Major Zhoutian: Outer].
[Chi] Gain: Basic Attack/Resonance Skill/Intro Skill.

Rotation: Intro Skill + E-A-A-A-A + Held A to consume all [Chi] (Use Resonance Liberation if you can)
baseTexts.introductionDescription:
● Xiangli Yao + Jianxin + Shorekeeper/Verina/Baizhi
Jianxin shields, heals, and boosts Xiangli Yao’s Resonance Liberation DMG. Shorekeeper/Verina/Baizhi provide healing and additional DMG.
① Xiangli Yao starts with E;
② Healer quickly fully charges Concerto Energy.
③ Jianxin takes the field with Intro Skill + E-AAAA- held A-R to Achieve full Concerto Energy;
④ Xiangli Yao takes the field with Intro Skill + ER-EA-EAAAEEAAE to achieve full Concerto Energy;
⑤ Repeat.

● Havoc Rover + Jianxin + Shorekeeper/Verina/Baizhi
Jianxin boosts Havoc Rover’s Resonance Liberation DMG. Shorekeeper/Verina/Baizhi provide healing and additional DMG.
① Rover: Havoc starts with E;
② Healer quickly fully charges Concerto Energy.
③ Jianxin takes the field with Intro Skill + E-AAAA- held A-R to Achieve full Concerto Energy;
④ Havoc Rover enters with Intro Skill + EHA*5-E-A*5-R.
⑤ Repeat.

texts.name: Primordial Chi Spiral
texts.description:
Heavy Attack: Primordial Chi Spiral

When "Chi" reaches max stacks, hold Basic Attack to cast Primordial Chi Spiral and start Zhoutian Progress.



Zhoutian Progress

Jianxin's resistance to interruption is increased, and her the damage taken is reduced by 50%:

Jianxin continuously consumes "Chi" and casts Chi Strike to attack targets nearby, dealing Aero DMG.

As Zhoutian Progress accumulates, Jianxin reaches different Zhoutian and gains effects accordingly.

-Before Minor Zhoutian: Gain Zhoutian Progress 1 shield. When Zhoutian Progress is interrupted, cast Pushing Punch to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.

-Minor Zhoutian: Gain Zhoutian Progress 2 shield and cast Shock to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG. When Zhoutian Progress is interrupted, cast Yielding Pull to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.

-Major Zhoutian - Inner: Gain Zhoutian Progress 3 shield and cast Shock to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG. When Zhoutian Progress is interrupted, cast Yielding Pull to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.

-Major Zhoutian - Outer: Gain Zhoutian Progress 3 shield and cast Shock to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.

-When Basic Attack button is released, interrupt Zhoutian Progress and lose all "Chi";

-When all "Chi" is consumed, end Zhoutian Progress.



When Zhoutian Progress ends, regain a shield according to the Zhoutian Progress reached;

As the shield provided by Heavy Attack: Primordial Chi Spiral persists, the active character is healed once every 6s.



Chi

Jianxin can hold up to 120 Chi.

Chi is obtained when Normal Attack Fengyiquan hits the target.

Chi is obtained when the Resonance Skill Calming Air is cast.

Chi is obtained when the Resonance Skills Chi Counter or Chi Parry hits the target.

Chi is obtained when the Intro Skill Essence of Tao hits the target.

baseTexts.roleDescription:
1. Aero Rover is an Aero sub DPS, healer or Support, with a focus on Resonance Skill DMG.
2. Aero Rover's enhanced Mid-air Attack and Resonance Liberation provide team-wide healing.
3. As a core enabler of Aero Negative Status, Aero Rover’s Resonance Skill converts all non-Aero Negative Statuses into Aero.
4. Aero Rover's Outro Skill raises the target’s Aero Negative Status stack cap when allies attack.
5. Aero Rover has a 5-star signature weapon that boosts team-wide Aero DMG after triggering its passive.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
1. Tip: Charge [Windstrings] via Intro Skill/enhanced Mid-air Attacks/3rd–4th hits of Basic Attack, then unleash 2 stages of ultimate Resonance Skill to trigger weapon passive for teamwide Aero DMG boost. Follow with Resonance Liberation, then switch out at full Concerto Energy.
2. Rotation: EAA-EAA-EAA-EER.
3. Team Comp: The most suitable role is Support in Jiyan team. The team setup of Jiyan + Mortefi + Aero Rover works well. Please refer to the full guide for team rotation.

baseTexts.introductionDetail:
Skill Breakdown
1. Forte Circuit
      ● Enhanced Mid-air Attack – [Cloudburst Dance]. Triggered after ground Resonance Skill/Intro Skill/enhanced Heavy Attack. Tap Basic Attack to perform a 2-hit combo (counts as Resonance Skill DMG), healing the entire team. Hold Basic Attack after casting to transition into regular Mid-air Attack.
      ● Ultimate Resonance Skill – [Unbound Flow]. Can be cast when [Windstrings] are maxed. Triggers a 2-stage attack (both count as Resonance Skill DMG). Swap character after 1st hit to auto-release 2nd hit.
      ● [Windstrings]: Max cap is 120. Each stage of enhanced Mid-air Attack restores 25 [Windstrings] on hit. Casting Intro Skill restores 20 [Windstrings]. Hitting a target with 3rd/4th Basic Attack or Dodge Counter restores 10 [Windstrings].
2. Resonance Liberation
      Deals DMG and restores the entire team’s HP.
3. Resonance Skill
      ● Ground (tap): Launches you into the air and deals DMG.
      ● Aerial (tap): Deals DMG and converts all existing Negative Status stacks (except [Aero Erosion]) into [Aero Erosion] at a ratio of 1:1.
      ● The two inputs have no shared CD and can be chained together.
4. Normal Attack
      ● Basic Attack: 4-hit combo. 
      ● Heavy Attack: Consumes STA to charge and deal DMG. Pressing Basic Attack shortly after casts the third hit directly.
      ● Enhanced Heavy Attack: After the third Basic Attack, a Dodge Counter, or a Heavy Attack, hold to unleash a stronger strike. Consumes STA.
      ● Mid-air Attack: Consumes STA to Plunging Attack. If you press Basic Attack after landing, you'll go straight into the 4th hit. When [Windstrings] are maxed, landing with Basic Attack triggers the Resonance Skill [Unbound Flow].
      ● Dodge Counter: Basic Attack DMG after a successful dodge.
5. Intro Skill
      Deals Aero DMG.
6. Outro Skill
      When allies land attacks, increases the target’s [Aero Erosion] stack limit.

roleResonanceTexts.recommendDescription:
● S1: Casting enhanced Mid-air Attack grants resistance to interruption.
● S2: After ultimate Resonance Skill, heals on-field character over time. If the on-field character HP < 35%, immediately restores 10% missing HP (10s CD, not affected by Healing Bonus).
● S4: Boosts Resonance Skill DMG on enhanced Mid-air Attack. Buff also applies to ultimate Resonance Skill.
● S6: Ultimate Resonance Skill DMG multiplier increases.
Among Aero Rover's Resonance Chains, S1 improves uptime and stability. S2 enhances healing capabilities. S3, 4, 5, 6 focus on increasing DMG. Unlock progressively for full value.

Each stack of Searing Feather gives (4%/5%/6%/7%/8%) additional Resonance Skill DMG Bonus for up to 14 stacks. After reaching the max stacks, all stacks will be removed in (12/12/12/12/12)s.

weaponTexts.recommendDescription:
Priority: Bloodpact's Pledge > Others.
● Bloodpact's Pledge: Aero Rover’s 5-star signature weapon, obtainable for free and maxed to Rank 5 through the main story. It boosts Energy Regen, increases Resonance Skill DMG after healing, and enhances the whole team’s Aero DMG after Aero Rover's ultimate Resonance Skill—an excellent blend of support and self-scaling DMG.

Mid-air Attack - Cloudburst Dance

Perform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG (considered Resonance Skill DMG) and healing all nearby Resonators in the team. Cast through the following 3 ways:

- Normal Attack right after casting Resonance Skill Awakening Gale.

- Normal Attack right after casting Intro Skill.

- Normal Attack right after casting Heavy Attack Razor Wind.

When casting Mid-air Attack Cloudburst Dance, hold Normal Attack to perform Mid-air Attack.



Resonance Skill - Unbound Flow

At max Windstrings, Resonance Skill Awakening Gale becomes Resonance Skill Unbound Flow: Perform up to 2 consecutive attacks. Each attack consumes 60 Windstrings, dealing Aero DMG, considered Resonance Skill DMG.

Switching to another Resonator after Stage 1 automatically triggers Stage 2 of this skill. 



Windstring

Rover can hold up to 120 Windstrings.

Each stage of Mid-air Attack Cloudburst Dance restores 25 Windstrings on hit.

Casting Intro Skill restores 20 Windstrings.

Hitting a target with Basic Attack Stage 3 or 4 or Dodge Counter restores 10 Windstrings.

baseTexts.roleDescription:
1. Cartethyia is an Aero main DPS who scales with HP, focused on Basic Attack DMG and [Aero Erosion] DMG.
2. Cartethyia excels at both direct DMG and DoT, with large AoE and strong adaptability across environments.
3. Cartethyia can apply [Aero Erosion] herself. Some of her skills are treated as [Aero Erosion] DMG, can accelerate or instantly trigger its DMG, spread its stacks, and scale her DMG based on the number of [Aero Erosion] stacks on enemies. She's a core Aero Negative Status DPS.
4. Cartethyia has two forms: Cartethyia and Fleurdelys.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
1. Tip: In Cartethyia form, gather all 3 [Sword Shadows], then use a Plunging Attack to recover them and trigger buffs. Cast Resonance Liberation to transform into Fleurdelys, build up [Conviction], and unleash her enhanced Resonance Liberation.
2. Rotation: Intro Skill (gain Blue Sword) - 4A (gain Green Sword) - E (gain Purple Sword) - Jump + AA-Q-R1-5A*2-EE-R2.
3. Team Comp: As the core DPS in the Aero Negative Status comp, Cartethyia pairs best with Ciaccona for Support and Aero Rover for sustain. Recommended team: Cartethyia + Ciaccona + Aero Rover. Please refer to the full guide for team rotation.

baseTexts.introductionDetail:
Skill Breakdown
1. Forte Circuit
Normal Attack and Resonance Skill are replaced by Fleurdelys-form skills, all of which generate [Conviction], up to 120 points.
2. Resonance Liberation
Switches to Fleurdelys form, consumes HP, and enters [Manifest] state. Fleurdelys's A5, 2nd hit of Mid-air Attack, and E2 instantly trigger [Aero Erosion] 1 time (consumes [Aero Erosion] stacks).
When Fleurdelys is in [Manifest] state and holds different [Sword Shadows], various effects are triggered.
● Purple Sword + [Manifest]: Increases Fleurdelys' resistance to interruption. A4 summons a force field that slows enemies within range.
● Green Sword + [Manifest]: Reduces the interval between [Aero Erosion] trigger and increases [Aero Erosion] DMG.
● Blue Sword + [Manifest]: After using E2 and dealing DMG, Fleurdelys' A5, 2nd hit of Mid-air Attack, and enhanced Heavy Attack will spread the highest Aero Negative Status stack from a target to all enemies within the area.
Fleurdelys generates [Conviction] upon hitting enemies.
At 120 [Conviction], tapping Resonance Liberation casts R2. The casting consumes all [Conviction], removes [Manifest], restores HP, and deals Aero DMG. The DMG scales with the target's Aero Negative Status stacks (up to 5 stacks) and clears the Aero Negative Status stacks afterward.
If under 120 [Conviction], tapping Resonance Liberation will revert back to Cartethyia form and pause the [Manifest] duration timer. While [Manifest] is active, Cartethyia's R1 has no Resonance Cost.
3. Resonance Skill
Deals Aero DMG (counts as Basic Attack DMG), applies 2 stacks of Aero Negative Status, and summons [Sword of Virtue's Shadow] (Purple).
4. Normal Attack
● Basic Attack - Cartethyia: A 4-hit combo (A1–A4). A4 applies 1 stack of Aero Negative Status and summons [Sword of Divinity's Shadow] (Green).
● Heavy Attack - Cartethyia: Consumes STA to attack, counts as Basic Attack DMG, and summons [Sword of Discord's Shadow] (Blue).
● Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia: Consumes STA, executes a Plunging Attack that deals Aero DMG (also treated as [Aero Erosion]). Collects all [Sword Shadows] and grants buffs based on their types.
● Dodge Counter - Cartethyia: Triggers a Basic Attack after a successful dodge.
5. Intro Skill
● Cartethyia: Deals Aero DMG, applies 2 stacks of Aero Negative Status, and summons [Sword of Discord's Shadow] (Blue). This DMG is treated as [Aero Erosion] DMG.
● Fleurdelys: Deals Aero DMG and generates [Conviction].
6. Outro Skill
Increases Aero DMG dealt by allies to enemies affected by [Negative Status].
 
Team Comp Analysis:
Cartethyia is an Aero character focused on Basic Attack DMG and [Aero Erosion] DMG. She pairs best with teammates that enhance Basic Attack DMG or apply Aero Negative Status consistently.
 
Team Comp & Rotation:
In the following rotations: A = Basic Attack; H = Heavy Attack; E = Resonance Skill; R = Resonance Liberation; Q = Echo Skill.
 
● Cartethyia + Ciaccona + Aero Rover.
Top-tier comp in the current meta. Cartethyia increases resistance to interruption and healing, helping Aero Rover generate more Forte Gauge. Ciaccona applies off-field [Aero Erosion], amplifies [Aero Erosion] DMG and team Aero DMG. Aero Rover increases the max stacks of [Aero Erosion] on enemies. Aero Rover's signature weapon further boosts team Aero DMG.
① Aero Rover EAA*3- Ultimate EE-QR to achieve full Concerto Energy;
② Ciaccona enters with Intro Skill + 2A - Dodge - 4A - E - Enhanced H - R to Achieve full Concerto Energy and swap out;
③ Cartethyia enters with Intro Skill + 4A-E- Jump AA-Q-R1-5A*2-EE-R2.
 
● Cartethyia + Phoebe + Aero Rover.
Phoebe applies [Spectro Frazzle]. Aero Rover converts it into [Aero Erosion]. Rover also increases the [Aero Erosion] stack cap, boosts team Aero DMG, and provides healing.
① Phoebe starts with held E - QR, without achieving full Concerto Energy;
② Aero Rover EE-EAA*3- Ultimate EE-QR and achieve full Concerto Energy and swap out;
③ Cartethyia enters with Intro Skill + 4A-E- Jump AA-Q-R1-5A-EE, not achieving full Conviction + R (switch to Cartethyia);
④ Phoebe enters with 3AH*2 to fully charge Concerto Energy and leaves.
⑤ Aero Rover enters with Intro Skill + EE, without achieving full Concerto Energy;
⑥ Switch to Cartethyia + R-EE-R2.
 
● Cartethyia + Sanhua + Aero Rover.
Best team for beginners. Sanhua enhances Cartethyia's Basic Attack DMG, while Aero Rover increases the max stacks of [Aero Erosion] on enemies, boosts Aero DMG, and heals the team.
① Aero Rover EAA*3- Ultimate EE-QR to achieve full Concerto Energy;
② Sanhua enters with Intro Skill + E-R-H-A to achieve full Concerto Energy and swap out;
③ Cartethyia enters with Intro Skill + 4A-E- Jump AA-Q-R1-5A*2-EE-R2.

texts.name: Sword to Carve My Forms
texts.description:
Basic Attack - Cartethyia

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.

Following Basic Attack - Cartethyia Stage 4, inflict 1 stack of Aero Erosion on targets hit and summon Sword of Divinity's Shadow.

Up to 1 Sword of Divinity's Shadow may exist at the same time, lasting for 20s.



Heavy Attack - Cartethyia 

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG and summoning Sword of Discord's Shadow. Can be performed in mid-air.

Up to 1 Sword of Discord's Shadow may exist at the same time, lasting for 20s.

This instance of DMG is considered Basic Attack DMG.



Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia

Release Normal Attack button while airborne to perform Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing Aero DMG, also considered Aero Erosion DMG.

Normal Attack shortly after the Plunging Attack to perform Basic Attack - Cartethyia Stage 2.

Casting Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia recalls all Sword Shadows. Based on the types and number of Sword Shadows recalled, perform different forms of Plunging Attack and obtain the corresponding Heart of Virtue, Mandate of Divinity, and Power of Discord.

texts.name: Tempest
texts.description:
Cartethyia unlocks new moves when she transforms into Fleurdelys:



Basic Attack - Fleurdelys 

Basic Attack - Cartethyia is replaced by Basic Attack - Fleurdelys.

Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG and restoring Conviction on hit.



Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys 

Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia is replaced by Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys.

Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks in the air at the cost of STA, dealing Aero DMG and restoring Conviction on hit.

While airborne, hold Normal Attack to cast Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 3.

Follow up with Basic Attack shortly afterward to cast Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 3.

While airborne, casting Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call and Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides resets the cycle of Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys.



Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys

Heavy Attack - Cartethyia is replaced by Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys.

Thrust forward to deliver a focused strike, dealing Aero DMG and restoring Conviction on hit. This instance of DMG is considered Basic Attack DMG.



Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys

While casting Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys, Normal Attack again to cast Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys: fall back and blast the area in a straight line in front, dealing Aero DMG and restoring Conviction on hit. This instance of DMG is considered Basic Attack DMG.

Follow up with Basic Attack shortly after casting Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys to cast Upward Cut - Fleurdelys.



Upward Cut - Fleurdelys

While Fleurdelys is on the ground, Jump to cast this skill, dealing Aero DMG and restoring Conviction on hit.



Dodge Counter - Fleurdelys 

Dodge Counter - Cartethyia is replaced by Dodge Counter - Fleurdelys.

Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG and restoring Conviction on hit.

Follow up with Basic Attack shortly afterward to cast Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 4 .



Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call 

Resonance Skill - Cartethyia is replaced by Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call.

Summon a force field near the target's location to continuously pull in nearby targets, dealing Aero DMG and restoring Conviction on hit.

Can be cast in mid-air.



Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides

Following Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call, Resonance Skill again to call down a giant Sword Shadow to crush an area around the target, creating a force field to pull in nearby targets, dealing Aero DMG to ground targets, and restoring Conviction on hit.

Follow up with Basic Attack shortly afterward to cast Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 3.

The Resonance Skill enters cooldown if Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides is not cast within a certain period or when switching to another Resonator. 

Can be cast in mid-air.

texts.name: A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers
texts.description:
Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers

By reducing HP to 50% of the Max HP, Cartethyia transforms into Fleurdelys, unlocking new moves and entering the Manifest state for 12s.

Can be performed in mid-air.

Entering Manifest clears all Conviction.

As Fleurdelys, Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5, Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2, and Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides instantly trigger 1 instance of Aero Erosion DMG and reduce the Aero Erosion stack on the target hit by 1.

- Ending the state will not clear Resonance Energy.

- No HP cost when HP is below 50%.



Fleurdelys's attacks restore Conviction on hit. When Conviction reaches 120 points, Resonance Liberation to cast Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall.



When Conviction is below 120 points, Resonance Liberation to transform back into Cartethyia. When in Manifest, casting Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers as Cartethyia consumes no Resonance Energy.



When Fleurdelys has Heart of Virtue in Manifest:

- Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 4 will generate a force field to Stagnate the targets within the range.

- Fleurdelys's resistance to interruption increases. 

Heart of Virtue is removed when Manifest ends.



When Fleurdelys has Mandate of Divinity in Manifest: 

Aero Erosion DMG is Amplified by 50% and the damage interval is decreased by 50% for enemies within a certain distance from Fleurdelys.

Mandate of Divinity is removed when Manifest ends.



When Fleurdelys has Power of Discord in Manifest:

When casting Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5, Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2 and Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys or after Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides deals damage, raise the Aero Erosion stacks on all nearby targets to the highest count among the targets.

Power of Discord is removed when Manifest ends.



Fleurdelys will transform back to Cartethyia during quest dialogues, environmental interaction animations, or using Utilities.

Fleurdelys can walk on water. Doing so on deep waters continuously consumes STA. When in walking state, Fleurdelys can step out of a high place and walk in mid-air by continuously consuming STA.



Avatar - Cartethyia

As Fleurdelys, when Conviction is below 120 points, Resonance Liberation to perform Basic Attack - Cartethyia Stage 2 and temporarily transform back to Cartethyia, which pauses the timer on Manifest.

Can be cast in mid-air. Casting the skill in mid-air performs Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia.



Avatar - Fleurdelys

When in Manifest, casting Resonance Liberation as Cartethyia performs Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2 without consuming Resonance Energy and transforms her back to Fleurdelys, which resumes the timer on Manifest.

Can be cast in mid-air. Casting this skill in mid-air performs Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 1.



Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall

When Fleurdelys has 120 points of Conviction, Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers is replaced by Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall.

Casting Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall removes all Conviction, ends Manifest, restores 50% of Max HP, and then deals Aero DMG to all targets in an area along a straight line in front. Upon hitting the target, remove all stacks of Aero Erosion on the target. Each stack removed Amplifies the DMG taken by the targets by 20%, up to 5 stacks.

Can be cast in mid-air.

Follow up with Basic Attack shortly after casting Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys to cast Upward Cut - Fleurdelys.



Upward Cut - Fleurdelys

While Fleurdelys is on the ground, Jump to cast this skill, dealing Aero DMG and restoring Conviction on hit.



Dodge Counter - Fleurdelys 

Dodge Counter - Cartethyia is replaced by Dodge Counter - Fleurdelys.

Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG and restoring Conviction on hit.

Follow up with Basic Attack shortly afterward to cast Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 4 .



Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call 

Resonance Skill - Cartethyia is replaced by Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call.

Summon a force field near the target's location to continuously pull in nearby targets, dealing Aero DMG and restoring Conviction on hit.

Can be cast in mid-air.



Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides

Following Resonance Skill - Sword to Answer Waves' Call, Resonance Skill again to call down a giant Sword Shadow to crush an area around the target, creating a force field to pull in nearby targets, dealing Aero DMG to ground targets, and restoring Conviction on hit.

Follow up with Basic Attack shortly afterward to cast Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 3.

The Resonance Skill enters cooldown if Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides is not cast within a certain period or when switching to another Resonator. 

Can be cast in mid-air.

texts.name: A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers
texts.description:
Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers

By reducing HP to 50% of the Max HP, Cartethyia transforms into Fleurdelys, unlocking new moves and entering the Manifest state for 12s.

Can be performed in mid-air.

Entering Manifest clears all Conviction.

As Fleurdelys, Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5, Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2, and Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides instantly trigger 1 instance of Aero Erosion DMG and reduce the Aero Erosion stack on the target hit by 1.

- Ending the state will not clear Resonance Energy.

- No HP cost when HP is below 50%.



Fleurdelys's attacks restore Conviction on hit. When Conviction reaches 120 points, Resonance Liberation to cast Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall.



When Conviction is below 120 points, Resonance Liberation to transform back into Cartethyia. When in Manifest, casting Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers as Cartethyia consumes no Resonance Energy.



When Fleurdelys has Heart of Virtue in Manifest:

- Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 4 will generate a force field to Stagnate the targets within the range.

- Fleurdelys's resistance to interruption increases. 

Heart of Virtue is removed when Manifest ends.



When Fleurdelys has Mandate of Divinity in Manifest: 

Aero Erosion DMG is Amplified by 50% and the damage interval is decreased by 50% for enemies within a certain distance from Fleurdelys.

Mandate of Divinity is removed when Manifest ends.



When Fleurdelys has Power of Discord in Manifest:

When casting Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5, Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2 and Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys or after Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides deals damage, raise the Aero Erosion stacks on all nearby targets to the highest count among the targets.

Power of Discord is removed when Manifest ends.



Fleurdelys will transform back to Cartethyia during quest dialogues, environmental interaction animations, or using Utilities.

Fleurdelys can walk on water. Doing so on deep waters continuously consumes STA. When in walking state, Fleurdelys can step out of a high place and walk in mid-air by continuously consuming STA.



Avatar - Cartethyia

As Fleurdelys, when Conviction is below 120 points, Resonance Liberation to perform Basic Attack - Cartethyia Stage 2 and temporarily transform back to Cartethyia, which pauses the timer on Manifest.

Can be cast in mid-air. Casting the skill in mid-air performs Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia.



Avatar - Fleurdelys

When in Manifest, casting Resonance Liberation as Cartethyia performs Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2 without consuming Resonance Energy and transforms her back to Fleurdelys, which resumes the timer on Manifest.

Can be cast in mid-air. Casting this skill in mid-air performs Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 1.



Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall

When Fleurdelys has 120 points of Conviction, Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers is replaced by Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall.

Casting Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall removes all Conviction, ends Manifest, restores 50% of Max HP, and then deals Aero DMG to all targets in an area along a straight line in front. Upon hitting the target, remove all stacks of Aero Erosion on the target. Each stack removed Amplifies the DMG taken by the targets by 20%, up to 5 stacks.

Can be cast in mid-air.

texts.name: Sword to Bear Their Names
texts.description:
Resonance Skill - Cartethyia

Attack the target, launch nearby enemies, and then plunge them to the ground, dealing Aero DMG and inflicting 2 stacks of Aero Erosion on the targets hit. This instance of DMG is considered Basic Attack DMG. Can be performed in mid-air.

Following Cartethyia - Resonance Skill, summon Sword of Virtue's Shadow.

Up to 1 Sword of Virtue's Shadow may exist at the same time, lasting for 20s.

texts.description:

Following Basic Attack - Cartethyia Stage 4, inflict 1 stack of Aero Erosion on targets hit and summon Sword of Divinity's Shadow.

Up to 1 Sword of Divinity's Shadow may exist at the same time, lasting for 20s.



Heavy Attack - Cartethyia 

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG and summoning Sword of Discord's Shadow. Can be performed in mid-air.

Up to 1 Sword of Discord's Shadow may exist at the same time, lasting for 20s.

This instance of DMG is considered Basic Attack DMG.



Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia

Release Normal Attack button while airborne to perform Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing Aero DMG, also considered Aero Erosion DMG.

Normal Attack shortly after the Plunging Attack to perform Basic Attack - Cartethyia Stage 2.

Casting Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia recalls all Sword Shadows. Based on the types and number of Sword Shadows recalled, perform different forms of Plunging Attack and obtain the corresponding Heart of Virtue, Mandate of Divinity, and Power of Discord.



Dodge Counter - Cartethyia

Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.

texts.name: Sword to Mark Tide's Trace
texts.description:
Cartethyia - Sword to Mark Tide's Trace

Deal Aero DMG and inflict 2 stacks of Aero Erosion on targets hit. Summon Sword of Discord's Shadow.

Up to 1 Sword of Discord's Shadow may exist at the same time, lasting 20s.

Normal Attack shortly after Cartethyia - Sword to Mark Tide's Trace to perform Basic Attack - Cartethyia Stage 2.



Fleurdelys - Sword to Call for Freedom

Thrust forward to impale the target, dealing Aero DMG and restoring Conviction.

Normal Attack shortly after Fleurdelys - Sword to Call for Freedom to cast Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2.

texts.name: Crown Destined by Fate
texts.description:
Gain Zeal that lasts for 10s when Cartethyia's or Fleurdelys's attacks directly damage and defeat targets inflicted with Aero Erosion.

In the Zeal state, upon defeating enemies, the next move that directly damages targets raises the Aero Erosion stacks on the targets to the highest count among the targets defeated. This will not exceed the current max Aero Erosion stack limit. Zeal is removed afterward and enters a 1s cooldown.

When Fleurdelys's Conviction hits 30/60/90/120, Fleurdelys's Crit. DMG is increased by 25% for 15s, up to 4 stacks. The duration of this effect does not reset upon gaining new stacks. After casting Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall, the increased Crit. DMG is removed.

texts.name: Blade Broken by Tempest
texts.description:
Casting Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers increases the max stack limit of Aero Erosion on targets within a certain range by 3 . The next attack that directly damages the target inflicts 3 of Aero Erosion on all targets within a certain range and immediately triggers the Aero Erosion DMG on the targets hit once without consuming the Aero Erosion stacks.

The DMG Multipliers of Cartethyia's Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Dodge Counter, and Intro Skill are increased by 50% and the DMG Multiplier of her Mid-air Attack is increased by 200%.

After casting Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia, every 1 type of Sword Shadow recalled reduces the cooldown of Resonance Skill - Cartethyia by 1s.

texts.name: Prisoner Hanged in the Tower
texts.description:
Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5, Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2, Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys, and Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides now inflict 2 of Aero Erosion on the targets hit.

The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill - Blade of Howling Squall is increased by 100%.

texts.name: Sacrifice Made for Salvation
texts.description: After Resonators in the team inflict Havoc Bane, Fusion Burst, Spectro Frazzle , Electro Flare, Glacio Chafe, orAero Erosion, all Resonators in the team gain 20% DMG Bonus for all Attributes for 20s.

texts.name: Hope Reshaped in Storms
texts.description:

The HP cost for casting Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers is reduced to 25% of Max HP.

texts.name: Freedom Found in Storm's Wake
texts.description:
After casting Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall, raise the Aero Erosion stacks on the target hit to max. Casting Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall no longer removes the Aero Erosion stacks on the target.

Within 30s after casting Intro Skill - Sword to Mark Tide's Trace, Intro Skill - Sword to Call for Freedom, Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers, and Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall, when any Resonator in the team inflicts Aero Erosion on the targets with max stacks of Aero Erosion, immediately trigger the Aero Erosion DMG once.

The targets take 40% more DMG from Fleurdelys.

roleResonanceTexts.recommendDescription:
● S2: After activating Resonance Liberation, increases Aero Negative Status limit on nearby enemies. The next hit applies 3 stacks of Aero Negative Status and instantly triggers a DMG without consuming stacks. Also boosts some of Cartethyia's attack multipliers and reduces Resonance Skill CD when retrieving [Sword Shadows].
 
● S3: Enhances Fleurdelys' Aero Negative Status application and increases enhanced Resonance Liberation multiplier.
 
● S6: Enhanced Resonance Liberation instantly maxes out Aero Negative Status stacks on hit and does not remove them. Some skill triggers cause teammates to instantly trigger Aero Negative Status stacks on targets at stack cap. Targets hit by Fleurdelys take significantly increased DMG.
Cartethyia's core Resonance Chains are S2, 3, 6. For F2P players, S0 works fine, while players with resources should aim for S3. For high spenders and dedicated fans, S6 is worthwhile.

weaponTexts.recommendDescription:
Priority: Defier's Thorn > Red Spring > Unflickering Valor > Guardian Sword.
● Defier's Thorn: Cartethyia's 5-star signature weapon. Provides high HP bonus, DEF penetration, and DMG buffs, perfectly matches Cartethyia's mechanics.
● Red Spring: Offers Crit. Rate bonus and Basic Attack DMG bonus, highly compatible with Cartethyia since Basic Attack accounts for a major portion of her DMG.
● Unflickering Valor: Provides excellent Energy Regen to smooth out Resonance Liberation rotations, along with Crit. Rate and Basic Attack DMG bonuses. A well-rounded option.
● Guardian Sword: Increases HP, synergizing with Cartethyia's HP-based DMG.

baseTexts.roleDescription: Iuno, the Priestess of Septimont, lets loose a gale of arrows under the moon. She flies across the battlefield raining down a volley of arrows from every angle onto her enemies.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis: Iuno is an aero gauntlet user, who specializes in buffing heavy attackers, and dealing Resonance Liberation Damage. She excels at dealing quick damage, and buffing all teammates inside her domain, as well as healing her team. She provides herself shielding during her on field presence, and quickly weave in and out of combat thanks to her smooth rotation.
baseTexts.introductionDescription:
Iuno is more than just a buffer. She can also be a main carry.

Iuno's enhanced heavy attack does not cancel her Outro Skill's damage.
baseTexts.introductionDetail:
Iuno is a character that moves between two modes in her Lunar Cycle, Half Moon and New Moon. When she cast her liberation, the lunar cycle begins. She builds her forte gauge, or Sentience, in the Half Moon mode and when its full, you can activate her New Moon mode, which will put Iuno in the air, to begin dealing massive Aero Damage. Once her concerto is full, Iuno's enhanced heavy attack becomes available. When used, she will grant the entire team the "Full Moon" domain, which will restore allies HP and STA periodically. Additionally, allies who gain a shield in this domain will also gain all DMG amplification.

Iuno's rotation consist of the following: using her liberation which activates her Lunar Cycle, building her forte in Half Moon mode, and when it is full, she will swap to her New Moon mode, and spend her Forte gauge by using Resonance Skill and Basic Attacks. When her concerto is full, she will trigger a heavy attack, and swap to the next character to provide a substantial damage amplification based on the shielding gained by allies.

Closing Refrain

When not in "Lunar Cycle", casting Moonring - Basic Attack Stage 3, Intro Skill, or Pulse of Origins replaces Iuno's Resonance Skill with Closing Refrain for 5s.

Casting Closing Refrain unleashes a flurry of strikes, dealing Aero DMG, and activates the Lunar Cycle.



Unfinished Refrain

When in Lunar Cycle - Half Moon, Iuno's Resonance Skill is replaced with Unfinished Refrain.

Casting Unfinished Refrain unleashes a flurry of strikes, dealing Aero DMG.

Unfinished Refrain shares the same Cooldown as Closing Refrain.



Arc Beyond the Edge

When Iuno is in Lunar Cycle - New Moon, her Resonance Skill is replaced with Arc Beyond the Edge, which has 2 initial charges.

Casting Arc Beyond the Edge causes Iuno to shift position and deal Aero DMG, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.

- Directional input can be used to extend the travel distance. If Iuno is hit or launched into mid-air, casting Arc Beyond the Edge immediately makes her recover from the attack.

Can be cast in mid-air.

texts.name: Ebb and Flow
texts.description:
Lunar Cycle

Iuno can activate the Lunar Cycle by casting Resonance Skill - Closing Refrain or Resonance Liberation.

Lunar Cycle has two states: Half Moon and New Moon. By default, Iuno enters the Half Moon state when activating Lunar Cycle and can switch between the two states by casting Heavy Attack - Flux.

When in Lunar Cycle:

- Iuno's Jump is replaced with Heavy Attack - Flux. STA won't recover when Iuno is in mid-air. 

- Iuno's movement becomes Meandering, which consumes STA continuously in mid-air to move in a unique manner.

- Performing environmental interactions, using Utilities, or holding Jump will end the Lunar Cycle.



Lunar Cycle - Half Moon

Iuno attacks using the Moonring, restoring "Sentience" on hit.

She can use Flux - Moonbow to deal Aero DMG (considered as Resonance Liberation DMG) and switch to Lunar Cycle - New Moon.

Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonbow can be cast in mid-air.



Lunar Cycle - New Moon

Iuno attacks using the Moonbow. While in this state, casting Moonbow - Basic Attack, Resonance Skill - Arc Beyond the Edge, or Moonbow - Dodge Counter consumes Sentience to increase the skill's DMG Multiplier, restore additional Concerto Energy, and heal nearby Resonators in the team.

Iuno can use Flux - Moonring to deal Aero DMG (considered as Resonance Liberation DMG) and switch to Lunar Cycle - Half Moon.

Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonring can be cast in mid-air.



Heavy Attack - Absolute Fullness

When Iuno's Concerto Energy is full, her Heavy Attack is replaced with Absolute Fullness.

Casting Absolute Fullness ends the Lunar Cycle, provides healing for nearby Resonators in the team, deals Aero DMG to nearby targets (considered as Resonance Liberation DMG), and conjures a Full Moon domain at her location. This effect can be triggered once every 25s.

Can be cast in mid-air.



Full Moon Domain

Resonators inside the domain periodically restore HP and STA.

Gaining a Shield inside the domain grants 1 stack of Blessing of the Wan Light. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.



Blessing of the Wan Light

The receiving Resonator gains 4% all DMG Amplification for 10s, stacking up to 10 times. Gaining new stacks resets the duration. This effect ends early if the receiving Resonator is switched off the field.



Sentience

Iuno can hold up to 100 points of Sentience.

Casting Intro Skill restores 40 points of Sentience.

Casting Resonance Liberation restores 60 points of Sentience.

Casting Closing Refrain or Unfinished Refrain restores 25 points of Sentience.

When Iuno is in Lunar Cycle, Moonring - Basic Attack, Moonring - Dodge Counter, and Mid-air Attack restore Sentience on hit.

baseTexts.roleDescription: Qiuyuan, a blind swordsman capable of seeing the enemies before they see him. He springs into combat from the Bamboo forest generated from his forte, while painting the world black to match his vision of the world.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis: Qiuyuan, an Aero Sword user, is a powerful Sub DPS character, who will enhance the teams Echo Skill DMG, while also providing SUB DPS damage. His quick concerto generation combined with his buffing capabilities turns this blind swordsman into a powerful support.
baseTexts.introductionDescription: Qiuyuan's Resonance Skill is a deadly counter, so skilled players can use it to negate all damage taken, stagnate the enemy, and follow up with free damage. When outside of combat, he is able to quickly move through the world by holding down his Resonance Skill.
baseTexts.introductionDetail:
Qiuyuan is a powerful buffer for Echo Skill DMG users, thanks to his outro skill which buffs Echo Skill DMG by 50%. Additionally, he is able to quickly generate Forte, in order to easily trigger his outro skill. He specalizes in Heavy Attack DMG, and many portions of his kit has a unique interaction depending on how filled his Forte Gauge is.

Qiuyuan's Resonance Liberation deals significant Aero Damage, and also buffs the entire team granting them up to 30% Crit DMG. This buff is determined by the excess Crit Rate Qiuyan has over 50%, so its important to have at least 70% Crit Rate on him to max out this buff.

Qiuyuan's rotation is quite simple, when he triggers his Intro Skill, he is able to generate 2/3 gauges of his forte. Once his forte gauge is filled, he will enter "Inkspash of Mind" state.  Which allows him to trigger his Thus Spoke The Blade combo, which is 3 consecutive heavy attacks, all considered both Heavy ATK, and Echo Skill DMG.

His rotation consist of Intro Skill > Resonance Liberation > Building one gauge of Forte from basic attacks > Thus Spoke the Blade combo > Outro Skill.
