baseTexts.roleDescription: Sigrika, a Startorch Academy student Preparatory Program, and master of the unique and strange anomolies called Runes.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis: Sigrika is an Aero, Gauntlet wielding, main damage dealing character who specalizes in Echo Skill Damage and the manipulation of runes.
baseTexts.introductionDescription:
Sigrika excels with other Echo Skill users in her team, such as Quiyuan, Phrolova, and Cantarella. 

Quickly Fill Sigrika's gauge by using Sigrika's Intro skill, and completing her Basic Attack Combo and Enhanced Heavy attack, then follow up with her Resonance Liberation, and do the same again. 

There are 3 types of Enhanced Heavy Attacks, for 3 different situations. Two Trust Runes will cause the enemy to be stagnated, which is great for bosses. 
Two Answer Runes will cause nearbyy enemies to be pulled in, which is great for crowd control. 

Opposite Runes will deal high damage, making it the ideal choice when the other two options are not required.
baseTexts.introductionDetail:
Sigrika is a main damage dealing character who empowers herself through her teammates' Echo Skills, allowing her to stagnate enemies while increasing her own damage. Most of her damage is considered Echo Skill Damage.

Sigrika can gain runes by using her Enhanced Heavy Attack after she enters Decipher State. She enters Decipher State after performing Basic Attack Stage 4. During Decipher, her next action generates a Rune slot. When Sigrika has two Rune slots, she can hold Basic Attack to cast an Enhanced Heavy Attack, consuming the Rune slots.

Sigrika is capable of obtaining two different types of runes, Trust and Answer, and each rune is obtained depending on which attack is used in Decipher State. The Trust Rune is gained when she casts her Basic Attack or Dodge Counter during Decipher State. The Answer Rune is gained when she casts her Resonance Skill during Decipher State.

After casting her Enhanced Heavy Attack, she gains 50 points of Full Stop, which caps at 100. After reaching 50 Full Stop, Sigrika's Basic Attack chain begins at Stage 2, allowing her to reach Decipher faster.

In order to speed up this process, Sigrika has two States she can enter, Divergent, which is gained by casting her Resonance Liberation, and Convergent, which is gained by casting her Intro Skill. Convergent takes priority over Divergent. If both are active, Convergent will trigger first. Divergent grants Sigrika an additional OPPOSITE Rune when she obtains a Rune. Convergent grants her the additional SAME type of Rune instead.

When Sigrika's Forte is maxed, she is able to cast her Forte Finisher, "Learn My True Name", dealing Significant Echo Skill Damage.

Sigrika's ideal rotation is to use your other characters first to fully buff the team, then Intro Skill into Sigrika, use her Resonance Liberation, and follow up with her Basic Attack 4 to gain Decipher. You will then either cast a Basic Attack, Dodge Counter, or Resonance Skill to gain your desired Rune, and finish up with her Enhanced Heavy Attack to gain two of the same runes, and gaining 50/100 Full Stop. You can then cast her Basic Attack 4 once more, granting Decipher again, gain your desired rune, and use her Enhanced Heavy Attack to gain your final rune. This will generate 100 points of Full Stop, and she can then casts her Finisher Enhanced Resonance Skill to finish off her rotation.

When Sigrika casts her Outro Skill, she deals huge Aero DMG and gains 2 stacks Encapsulated. When teammates cast an Echo Skill, one Encapsulated stack is consumed and nearby enemies become Stagnated.

S1: Provides immunity to interruptions during her Basic Attack Combo, greatly simplifying rotation requirements. Additionally increases the DMG Multipliers of Her Enhanced Basic Attack, Dodge Counter, and Resonance Skills. Grants 1 Additional Stack of Encapsulation, allowing for easy Boss CC. Very powerful Sequence for Sigrika, greatly improving her gameplay and overall power.

S2: Greatly increases the DMG multiplier of Sigrika's most powerful move, her forte Finisher, "Learn My True Name" and grants Sigrika Divergent when shes not in combat for 4 seconds. Exceptional Sequence, allowing Sigrika to begin her rotation whenever she wants, and increases her most powerful move.

S6: Very powerful DMG increase to every part of Sigrika's Kit, additionally, providing DMG amplifications for her forte finisher, and allows her Enhanced Heavy Attack to ignore up a significant portion of enemy defenese. This Sequence Greatly increases Sigrika's overall DMG, allowing her to deal astromonical numbers to any Enemy.

weaponTexts.recommendDescription:
Sigrika's Signature Weapon, Solsworn Ciphers, is an amazing option for her and by far her best weapon choice.

This weapon greatly outperforms all of her other weapon options, so I would highly recommend you pick it up.

Sigrika can also use any 5 star weapon that grants Crit Rate or Crit DMG, but Blazing Justice is superior to the other options because it grants 12% ATK, and 8% Defence Ignore by simply casting a Basic Attack.

Abyss Surges serves as a decent option to powerup Sigrika's Basic Attacks, and also grants additional Energy Regen to meet the requirements.

Activate the Echo Skill to summon a fraction of the Fallacy of No Return's power and deal a blast to the surrounding area, inflicting Spectro DMG equal to 15.86% of max HP, after which the Resonator gains 10% bonus Energy Regen and all team members 10% bonus ATK for 20s.

Hold Echo Skill to unleash a series of flurry assaults at the cost of STA, each dealing Spectro DMG equal to 1.58% of max HP; Release to end the assail in a powerful blow, dealing Spectro DMG equal to 19.82% of max HP.

CD: 20s

texts.name: Rejuvenating Glow
texts.description: Increases the ATK of all party members by 15% for 30s upon healing allies.

texts.name: Rover: Spectro
texts.skillDisplay: Basic Combo：Intro Skill → Enhanced Resonance Skill → Basic Attack*2 → Echo Skill → Resonance Liberation → Heavy Attack → Enhanced Resonance Skill → Basic Attack*2 → Outro Skill

baseTexts.roleDescription: Spectro Rover is a Spectro DPS specializing in Resonance Skill DMG and rapid buildup of [Spectro Frazzle] stacks.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
Core Mechanics: [Diminutive Sound]. When [Diminutive Sound] exceeds 50, Spectro Rover can cast an enhanced Resonance Skill that applies a non-decaying [Spectro Frazzle].
[Diminutive Sound] Gain: Basic Attack/Heavy Attack/Intro Skill

Rotation: E-A-H-A-A-E-A-R
baseTexts.introductionDescription:
● Spectro Rover + Phoebe + Shorekeeper/Verina/Baizhi
Phoebe is main DPS. Spectro Rover provides DPS and stacks [Spectro Frazzle] for Phoebe. Shorekeeper/Verina/Baizhi provides healing and DMG buffs.
① Start with Phoebe using E.
② Healer quickly fully charges Concerto Energy.
③ Spectro Rover enters with Intro Skill + EA-HAAEA-R to max out Concerto Energy.
④ Phoebe enters with H-E-R-3AH*4 to fully charge Concerto Energy and leaves.
⑤ Repeat.
baseTexts.introductionDetail:
Team Comp Analysis: Spectro Rover’s best synergy is currently with Phoebe. Here’s how the team functions:

Team Comp & Rotation:
In the following rotations: A = Basic Attack; H = Heavy Attack; E = Resonance Skill; R = Resonance Liberation; Q = Echo Skill.

texts.name: Nightmare: Mourning Aix
texts.skillDescription:
Summon a Nightmare: Mourning Aix to attack surrounding enemies, dealing 273.60% Spectro DMG. DMG dealt to enemies inflicted by Spectro Frazzle is increased by 100.00%.

The Resonator with this Echo equipped in their main slot gains 12.00% Spectro DMG Bonus.

CD: 25s.

texts.name: Eternal Radiance
texts.description: Inflicting Spectro Frazzle on enemies increases Crit. Rate by 20% for 15s. Attacking enemies inflicted with 10 stacks of Spectro Frazzle grants 15% Spectro DMG Bonus for 15s.

texts.name: Eternal Radiance
texts.description: Spectro DMG + 10%

texts.name: Mourning Aix
texts.skillDescription:
Transform into Mourning Aix and perform 2 consecutive claw attacks, each attack dealing 157.44% and 236.16% Spectro DMG respectively.



After the transformation, increase current character's Spectro DMG by 12.00% and Resonance Liberation DMG by 12.00% for 15s



CD: 20s

texts.name: Celestial Light
texts.description: Spectro DMG + 30% for 15s after releasing Intro Skill.

texts.name: Celestial Light
texts.description: Spectro DMG + 10%.

echoTexts.recommendDescription: Crit. Rate/Crit. DMG > ATK% > Resonance Skill DMG Bonus > Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus

texts.name: Reticence
texts.description: DMG dealt by Rover's Basic Attack Resonating Echoes is increased by 60%.

texts.name: Silent Listener
texts.description: Rover gains 15% ATK increase for 5s upon casting Heavy Attack Resonance.

texts.name: Instant
texts.description: Generate an area of stasis centered around the incoming Resonator, lasting for 3s.

texts.name: Instant
texts.description: Generate an area of stasis centered around the incoming Resonator, lasting for 3s.

texts.name: Tune Break: Sword
texts.description: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast "Tune Break" on the target.

texts.name: Vibration Manifestation
texts.description:
Basic Attack

Rover performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG.



Heavy Attack

Rover consumes STA to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.



Heavy Attack: Resonance

After Basic Attack 3 or Heavy Attack, press the Basic Attack button at the right time to perform Heavy Attack Resonance, dealing Spectro DMG.



Heavy Attack: Aftertune

After Heavy Attack Resonance or Dodge Counter hits a target, press the Basic Attack button to perform Heavy Attack Aftertune, dealing Spectro DMG.



Mid-air Attack

Rover consumes STA to perform a Mid-Air Plunging Attack, dealing Spectro DMG.



Dodge Counter

Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.

texts.name: Resonating Slashes
texts.description: Rover launches an attack forward, dealing Spectro DMG.

texts.name: World in a Grain of Sand
texts.description:
Resonance Skill: Resonating Spin

If "Diminutive Sound" exceeds 50 when Resonance Skill is used, Rover consumes 50 "Diminutive Sound" to cast Resonating Spin, dealing Spectro DMG, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.



Basic Attack: Resonating Echoes

After Resonance Skill Resonating Spin ends, Rover performs Resonating Echoes upon using Basic Attack button.

Launch attacks forward, dealing Spectro DMG, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.



Diminutive Sound

Rover can hold up to 100 "Diminutive Sounds".

Rover obtains "Diminutive Sound" for every Normal Attack Vibration Manifestation on hit.

Rover obtains "Diminutive Sound" for every Heavy Attack Aftertune on hit.

Rover obtains "Diminutive Sound" upon casting Intro Skill Waveshock.

texts.name: Echoing Orchestra
texts.description: Rover converges Spectro energy to assail the target area, detonating it after a short delay and dealing Spectro DMG.

texts.name: Waveshock
texts.description: Rover attacks the target, dealing Spectro DMG.

texts.description: Rover attacks the target, dealing Spectro DMG.

texts.name: Odyssey of Beginnings
texts.description: Rover's Crit. Rate is increased by 15% for 7s when casting Resonance Skill Resonating Slashes or Resonance Skill Resonating Spin.

texts.name: Microcosmic Murmurs
texts.description: Rover's Spectro DMG Bonus is increased by 20%.

texts.name: Visages of Dust
texts.description: Rover's Energy Regen is increased by 20%.

texts.name: Resonating Lamella
texts.description: When casting Resonance Liberation Echoing Resonance, Rover continuously restores HP for all team members: HP equal to 20% of Rover's ATK will be restored every second for 5s.

texts.name: Temporal Virtuoso
texts.description: Rover's Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus is increased by 40%.

texts.name: Echoes of Wanderlust
texts.description: Resonance Skill Resonating Slashes and Resonance Skill Resonating Spin reduces the target's Spectro RES by 10% on hit for 20s.

roleResonanceTexts.recommendDescription:
● S1: Boosts Crit. Rate for increased overall DMG.
● S2: Directly increases Spectro DMG.
● S5: Enhances Resonance Liberation DMG.
● S6: Reduces enemy Spectro RES upon Resonance Skill hit, significantly raising damage potential.
Spectro Rover’s core Resonance Chains are S1, 2, 5, 6. If you’re playing Spectro Rover, it’s highly recommended to unlock S6 as soon as possible.

texts.name: Blazing Brilliance
texts.effectDescription: ATK increased by (12%/15%/18%/21%/24%). The wielder gains 1 stack of Searing Feather upon dealing damage, which can be triggered once every 0.5s, and gains 5 stacks of the same effect upon casting Resonance Skill. Each stack of Searing Feather gives (4%/5%/6%/7%/8%) additional Resonance Skill DMG Bonus for up to 14 stacks. After reaching the max stacks, all stacks will be removed in (12/12/12/12/12)s.

texts.name: Emerald of Genesis
texts.effectDescription: Increases Energy Regen by (12.8%/16%/19.2%/22.4%/25.6%). When Resonance Skill is cast, increases ATK by (6%/7.5%/9%/10.5%/12%), stacking up to (2/2/2/2/2) time(s). This effect lasts for (10/10/10/10/10)s.

texts.name: Fables of Wisdom
texts.effectDescription: Dealing DMG to enemies with Negative Statuses increases the wielder's ATK by (4%/5%/6%/7%/8%) for (10/10/10/10/10)s. This effect can be triggered 1 time per second, stackable up to (4/4/4/4/4) times.

texts.name: Lumingloss
texts.effectDescription: When Resonance Skill is cast, increases Basic Attack DMG Bonus and Heavy Attack DMG Bonus by (20%/31%/42%/53%/64%), stacking up to (1/1/1/1/1) time(s). This effect lasts for (10/10/10/10/10)s and can be triggered (1/1/1/1/1) time(s) every (1/1/1/1/1)s.

weaponTexts.recommendDescription:
● Blazing Brilliance: Spectro Rover's BIS 5-star weapon. Comes with a Crit. DMG substat and a passive that boosts ATK. Stacking the passive through DMG dealt and Resonance Skill greatly enhances Resonance Skill DMG, making it the perfect fit for Spectro Rover's kit.
● Emerald of Genesis: Provides Crit. Rate and boosts Energy Regen. Stacking its passive with Resonance Skill grants increased ATK, synergizing well with Spectro Rover’s playstyle.
● Fables of Wisdom: Offers ATK as a substat. When attacking enemies with [Negative Status], stacks ATK bonuses—easy to maintain since Spectro Rover can apply Negative Status naturally.
● Lumingloss: Grants ATK and increases Basic Attack and Heavy Attack DMG after using a Resonance Skill. Simple to trigger for Spectro Rover, with great uptime and useful stats all around.

texts.name: Phoebe
texts.skillDisplay:
Basic Combo：
Support Combo：Hold - Resonance Skill → Basic Attack*3 → Heavy Attack → Basic Attack*3 → Heavy Attack → Resonance Liberation → Echo Skill → Outro Skill
DPS Combo：Hold - Basic Attack → Basic Attack*3 → Heavy Attack → Basic Attack*3 → Heavy Attack → Basic Attack*3 → Heavy Attack → Basic Attack*3 → Heavy Attack → Resonance Liberation → Echo Skill → Outro Skill

texts.name: Luminous Hymn
texts.effectDescription: Increase ATK by (12%/15%/18%/21%/24%). Dealing DMG to targets with Spectro Frazzle grants the wielder (14%/17.5%/21%/24.5%/28%) Basic Attack DMG Bonus and (14%/17.5%/21%/24.5%/28%) Heavy Attack DMG Bonus, stacking up to (3/3/3/3/3) {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=2} for (6/6/6/6/6)s. Casting Outro Skill Amplifies the Spectro Frazzle DMG on targets around the active Resonator by (30%/37.5%/45%/52.5%/60%) for (30/30/30/30/30)s. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked.

texts.skillDisplay: Basic Attack*5 → Resonance Skill → Jump → Basic Attack *3 → Echo Skill → Resonance Liberation → Outro Skill

texts.name: Baizhi
texts.skillDisplay: Basic Combo：Intro Skill → Resonance Liberation → Basic Attack*4 → Resonance Skill → Outro Skill

texts.name: Stellar Symphony
texts.effectDescription: Increase HP by (12%/15%/18%/21%/24%). Restore (8/10/12/14/16) Concerto Energy when casting Resonance Liberation. This effect can be triggered (1/1/1/1/1) time(s) every (20/20/20/20/20)s. When casting Resonance Skill that heals, increase nearby party members' ATK by (14%/17.5%/21%/24.5%/28%) for (30/30/30/30/30)s. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked.

baseTexts.roleDescription: Verina is a Spectro healer with incredibly fast Concerto Energy generation, powerful DMG buffs, and even a revival mechanic.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
Core Mechanics: Photosynthesis Energy. Verina consumes 1 stack of [Photosynthesis Energy] when using Heavy Attack or Mid-air Attack, restoring Concerto Energy and healing the entire team.
[Photosynthesis Energy] Gain: Verina gains 1 stack of [Photosynthesis Energy] from 5th Basic Attack hit, using a Resonance Skill or Intro Skill.

Rotation: AAA-E-Q-R-Jump A-A-A.
baseTexts.introductionDescription:
● Changli + Brant + Verina
Brant provides Fusion and Resonance Skill DMG buffs for Changli, while Verina offers healing and additional DMG buffs.
① Changli starts with EA, not fully stacking Concerto Energy.
② Switch to Verina AAAEQR + Jump AAA to fully charge Concerto Energy and swap out.
③ Brant enters with Intro Skill, uses R-H-H, then enhanced E to achieve full Concerto Energy and leave the field.
④ Changli re-enters with Intro Skill, A-EA-EA, H (4 Enflamement stacks) + R + H (4 Enflamement stacks), achieve full Concerto Energy, swap out.
⑤ Repeat.

● Jinhsi + Zhezhi + Verina/Shorekeeper/Baizhi
Zhezhi boosts Jinhsi’s Resonance Skill DMG and provides Coordinated Attacks from off-field. Verina provides Coordinated Attacks, healing and DMG buffs.
① Zhezhi starts with AAAR;
② Switch to Verina AAAEQR + Jump AAA to fully charge Concerto Energy and swap out.
③ Jinhsi enters with Intro Skill + E2-Q-R-A-A-E3-A-A-E4 and trigger Unison;
③ Zhezhi enters with Intro Skill + E-H-E2-E2-E3-Q to achieve full Concerto Energy;
④ Jinhsi enters with Intro Skill + E2-Q-Dodge-A-A-E3-A-A-E4;
⑤ Repeat.

● Phoebe + Spectro Rover + Shorekeeper/Verina/Baizhi
Spectro Rover provides DPS and stacks [Spectro Frazzle]. Verina provides healing and DMG buffs.
① Start with Phoebe using E.
② Switch to Verina AAAEQR + Jump AAA to fully charge Concerto Energy and swap out.
③ Spectro Rover enters with Intro Skill. Use E-HAAEA-R to max out Concerto Energy.
④ Phoebe enters with H-E-R-3AH*4 to fully charge Concerto Energy and leaves.
⑤ Repeat.
baseTexts.introductionDetail:
Team Comp Analysis: Verina's mechanics are exceptionally strong, providing consistent healing and universal DMG buffs for all allies. She fits seamlessly into any team comp.

Team Comp & Rotation:
In the following rotations: A = Basic Attack; H = Heavy Attack; E = Resonance Skill; R = Resonance Liberation; Q = Echo Skill.

Photosynthesis Energy

Verina obtains 1 stack of "Photosynthesis Energy" for every Intro Skill Verdant Growth on hit.

roleResonanceTexts.recommendDescription:
● S2: Grants additional [Photosynthesis Energy] and Concerto Energy after using a Resonance Skill, reducing Verina's on-field time.
● S3: Directly increases Resonance Liberation healing.
● S5: Enhances Verina's healing for allies below 50% HP.
● S6: Increases DMG and unlocks extra Coordinated Attacks and healing methods.
Verina's core Resonance Chains are S2, 3, 5, 6. However, S1 and S4 are worthwhile as they also provide solid upgrades.

weaponTexts.recommendDescription:
● Variation: Increases Energy Regen as substats and restores Concerto Energy with passive, perfectly fitting Verina’s needs. At higher levels, it allows Verina to reach full Concerto energy with fewer Basic Attacks.
● Call of the Abyss: Boosts Energy Regen as substats and increases healing after using Resonance Liberation, synergizing well with Verina’s kit.
● Cosmic Ripples: A standard 5-star weapon with ATK as a substat, improving Verina’s healing. Its effect further enhances Energy Regen, enabling faster Resonance Liberation activation.
● Fusion Accretion: Provides ATK as a substat, restores Resonance Energy when using a Resonance Skill, and grants a long-lasting ATK bonus, making it an effective choice for Verina.

baseTexts.roleDescription: Lumi deals Electro DMG and focuses on Basic Attack DMG, with two viable roles: main DPS and sub-DPS. She also boosts the Resonance Skill DMG of the next character.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
Core Mechanic: Lumi switches between Yellow Light and Red Light attack modes via her Resonance or Enhanced Resonance Skills. Both Yellow Light and Red Light modes can trigger Enhanced Resonance Skills when their Forte Circuit is full. This switches to the opposite mode while dealing DMG, counted as Basic Attack DMG.
Forte Gauge Recovery: Use Basic Attacks in the corresponding mode to replenish Forte Gauge.
baseTexts.introductionDescription: Team Comp Analysis: Lumi’s Basic Attacks contribute significantly to her DMG. Pair her with characters that boost Basic Attack Bonus. As a sub-DPS, Lumi supports characters who rely on Resonance Skills for their primary DMG output. However, Lumi’s slower Concerto Energy rate can make her gameplay more complex, with a steeper learning curve.

texts.name: Searchlight Service
texts.description:
Pounce

When in Yellow Light Mode, use Resonance Skill to perform Pounce, which consumes STA to pounce on the target before switching to Red Light Mode.

Lumi will perform a Pounce without STA cost when switched onto the field.



Rebound

When in Red Light Mode, use Resonance Skill to perform Rebound, which consumes STA to leap backward and attack the target before switching to Yellow Light Mode.



Yellow Light Mode

Perform ranged attacks when in Yellow Light Mode.



Red Light Mode

texts.name: Signal Light
texts.description:
Energized Pounce

When Yellow Light Spark is fully recovered, replace Resonance Skill with Resonance Skill Energized Pounce that deals Electro DMG and enter Red Spotlight Mode. The DMG dealt is considered Basic Attack DMG.

When in Red Spotlight Mode, the DMG Multiplier of Red Light: Basic Attack and Red Light: Heavy Attack is increased, with an extra amount of Sparks recovered.

Red Spotlight Mode ends after performing altogether 4 Basic Attacks and/or Heavy Attacks.



Energized Rebound

When Red Light Spark is fully recovered, replace Resonance Skill with Resonance Skill Energized Rebound that deals Electro DMG and enter Yellow Spotlight Mode. The DMG dealt is considered Basic Attack DMG.

When in Yellow Spotlight Mode, Glitter is replaced by Glare, with an increased DMG Multiplier and an extra amount of Sparks recovered.

Yellow Spotlight Mode ends after shooting 6 Glares.



Laser

Casting Outro Skill consumes all Sparks obtained in the current mode.

Laser can be cast when the amount of consumed Sparks is greater than or equal to 25, dealing Electro DMG. The DMG dealt is considered Basic Attack DMG. 

Every 25 Sparks consumed generates 1 extra Laser beam, up to 4 Laser beams.



Yellow Light Spark

Lumi can hold up to 100 Yellow Light Sparks.

Lumi obtains Yellow Light Spark under the following conditions: 

When Yellow Light: Basic Attack hits the target;

When Glitter hits the target;

When Glare hits the target;

When Resonance Skill Energized Rebound hits the target;

When casting Intro Skill Special Delivery.



Red Light Spark

Lumi can hold up to 100 Red Light Sparks.

Lumi obtains Red Light Spark under the following conditions:

When Normal Attack Navigation Support hits the target in Red Light Mode or Red Spotlight Mode.

baseTexts.roleDescription:
The Shorekeeper is the Best Universal Support in the game that can fit into any team thanks to her team wide 12.5% crit rate & 25% crit damage buff. She also has really good healing in her kit and her outro Amplifies the damage of all of your characters.

 She can also save you from a fatal blow.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis: Her first rotation is a bit longer but it gets shorter after her first intro. For her Rotation you start with a 4 hit Basic attack combo followed by her heavy attack you do this combo two times to fill her concerto bar and then you use her skill>Echo>Liberation and outro to your sub dps. You then do your Sub Dpses Rotation to get their outro to your main Dps so that you can get The Shorekeeper's full Liberation damage buff and change the color of it to yellow. The second Rotation is a lot easier thanks to you having access to her intro. So Intro>4x Basic atk + Heavy atk>Skill>Echo>Liberation>Outro and repeat!

texts.name: Origin Calculus
texts.description:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG. Each hit generates 1 Collapsed Core.



Heavy Attack

Hold the Normal Attack Button to enter Unbound Form, which consumes STA continuously. While in this form, Shorekeeper will:

- Generate a segment of Deductive Data every second;

- Automatically collect nearby plant collectibles.

Using up all STA or actions such as casting Basic Attack will end the Unbound Form and deal Spectro DMG to the target. Each accumulated segment of Deductive Data will convert into a segment of Empirical Data and generate a Collapsed Core.



Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack. Each hit generates 1 Collapsed Core. Quickly Press the Normal Attack Button after the Plunging Attack to perform Basic Attack Stage 2.



Dodge Counter

Press the Normal Attack Button after a successful Dodge to attack a target, dealing Spectro DMG.

texts.name: Chaos Theory
texts.description:
Restore HP for all nearby party members and summon 5 Dim Star Butterflies, which automatically track and attack a target, dealing Spectro DMG. Follow up with Basic Attack in time to start the Basic Attack cycle from Stage 2.

Can be performed in mid-air.

texts.name: Astral Chord
texts.description:
Flare Star Butterfly

Hitting a target with a Normal Attack generates a Collapsed Core, which transforms into a Flare Star Butterfly after 6s. Flare Star Butterflies automatically track and attack a target, dealing Spectro DMG. If there are already 5 Collapsed Cores, Shorekeeper's next Basic Attack hit will instantly convert a Collapsed Core into a Flare Star Butterfly.



Illation

When Shorekeeper has 5 segments of Empirical Data, casting Heavy Attack will consume all segments to pull in nearby targets, dealing Spectro DMG. Meanwhile, all generated Collapsed Cores will instantly transform into Flare Star Butterflies.



Transmutation

When Shorekeeper has 5 segments of Empirical Data, casting Mid-air Attack will consume all segments to deal Spectro DMG. Meanwhile, all generated Collapsed Cores will instantly transform into Flare Star Butterflies. Quickly press the Normal Attack Button afterward to perform Basic Attack Stage 2.



Empirical Data

Shorekeeper can hold up to 5 segments of Empirical Data.

- Obtain 1 segment of Empirical Data when Basic Attack Stage 1, 2, or 4 hits a target.

- Obtain 2 segments of Empirical Data when Basic Attack Stage 3 hits a target.

- Obtain 1 segment of Empirical Data when Mid-air Attack hits a target.

- Obtain 1 segment of Empirical Data when Dodge Counter hits a target.

texts.name: End Loop
texts.description:
Outer Stellarealm

Generate the Outer Stellarealm to restore HP for all party members within its effective range continuously. This effect can be triggered once every 3s.



Inner Stellarealm

When a party member uses Intro Skill within the Outer Stellarealm, it evolves into the Inner Stellarealm. Within the effective range of the Inner Stellarealm, for every 0.2% of Shorekeeper's Energy Regen, all party members gain a 0.01% increase of Crit. Rate, up to 12.5%. 

Inner Stellarealm has all the effects of the Outer Stellarealm.



Supernal Stellarealm

When a party member uses Intro Skill within the Inner Stellarealm, it evolves into the Supernal Stellarealm. Within the effective range of the Supernal Stellarealm, for every 0.1% of Shorekeeper's Energy Regen, all party members gain a 0.01% increase of Crit. DMG, up to 25%. 

Supernal Stellarealm has all the effects of the Inner Stellarealm.

texts.name: Proof of Existence
texts.description:
Enlightenment

Shorekeeper appears to restore HP for all nearby party members and summon 5 Dim Star Butterflies, which automatically track and attack a target, dealing Spectro DMG. This is considered Resonance Skill DMG.



Discernment

When a Supernal Stellarealm is generated, Shorekeeper's first Intro Skill triggered in its duration will be replaced with Intro Skill Discernment. Casting Discernment ends the current Stellarealm, restores HP for all nearby party members, and deals Spectro DMG to the targets. This attack is guaranteed to be a Critical Hit dealing Resonance Liberation DMG. The Intro Skill Discernment can only be triggered once each time a Supernal Stellarealm is generated.

Variation: Really Great option and it just gets better with more copies thanks to the Concerto it gives. The Energy Regen helps you hit her Energy requirements too. You can't go wrong with this weapon, it works well on all healers.
Stellar Symphony: Her Best Support weapon, makes Building her alot easier with 77% Energy Regen, Hp helps with her healing + damage, The concerto when you cast her Resonance Liberation lowers her field time and it also boosts the entire teams attack when you use The Shorekeepers skill.
Rectifier#25: Easily accessible to all by Crafting. The Energy Regen helps you hit her Energy requirements but it does not give you any extra concerto so you will have to spend more time on field.
Rectifier of Voyager: Good Placeholder until you get her other weapon options.

DPS Combo：Hold - Basic Attack → Basic Attack*3 → Heavy Attack → Basic Attack*3 → Heavy Attack → Basic Attack*3 → Heavy Attack → Basic Attack*3 → Heavy Attack → Resonance Liberation → Echo Skill → Outro Skill

baseTexts.roleDescription: Phoebe is a Spectro character with dual roles: Main DPS and Support. Regardless of the role, her playstyle revolves around Heavy Attack DMG.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis: Core Mechanic: Forte Circuit Phoebe can switch states by maxing out [Prayer]. When [Prayer] is full, her Basic Attack and Resonance Skill icons glow. Hold Basic Attack: Enters Absolution (Main DPS mode). Hold Resonance Skill: Enters Confession (Support mode). Both modes cannot coexist.
baseTexts.introductionDescription:
Main DPS (Absolution): [Prayer] full - Hold Basic Attack - (3 Basic Attacks/Dodge Counter - Enhanced Heavy Attack)*4 - Achieve full Concerto Energy and swap out
Support Mode (Confession): [Prayer] full - Hold Resonance Skill - (3 Basic Attacks/Dodge Counter - Enhanced Heavy Attack)*2 - Achieve full Concerto Energy and swap out
baseTexts.introductionDetail:
[Prayer]: Auto regenerates over time, up to 120 points. It replenishes at 5 points per second, refilling in 24 seconds. Cannot switch states while Forte Gauge [Divine Voice] is not depleted, even if [Prayer] is full. You won't also auto exit the state when the [Divine Voice] is depleted.
Divine Voice fully replenishes upon entering Absolution (Main DPS mode) or Confession (Support mode) and is consumed when using enhanced Heavy Attacks.

Basic Attack

Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks of Holy Light, dealing Spectro DMG.



Heavy Attack

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.



Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to ride the staff and dive down from mid-air to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.

texts.name: To Where Light Shines
texts.description:
Summon a Ring of Mirrors at the target location, making the target hit stagnate for 2s and dealing Spectro DMG. The stagnation effect can be applied to 12 targets max for each Ring of Mirrors. Using Resonance Skill again shortly after the summoning teleports Phoebe to the Ring of Mirrors' location, dealing Spectro DMG.

Unable to teleport if Phoebe is too far from the Ring of Mirrors.



Ring of Mirrors

- Ring of Mirrors lasts for 30s. When Phoebe summons a new Ring of Mirrors, the existing Ring of Mirrors disappears.

- When Phoebe is outside of the Ring of Mirrors, a Basic Attack or Dodge Counter that hits the Ring of Mirrors will refract Holy Light, which deals Spectro DMG to targets inside the Ring of Mirrors and pulls the targets hit to the center of the ring. The DMG dealt is considered Basic Attack DMG. Can be triggered once every 0.5s.

- When Phoebe is inside the Ring of Mirrors, Basic Attack becomes Basic Attack Chamuel's Star, which performs up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

texts.name: Radiant Invocation
texts.description:
When Phoebe's Prayer is full, consume all Prayer to cast one of the following skills:

- Hold Basic Attack to cast Heavy Attack Absolution Litany, dealing Spectro DMG and applying 1 of Spectro Frazzle to the targets hit. Phoebe enters Absolution status, which allows her to deal more DMG.

- Hold Resonance Skill to cast Resonance Skill Utter Confession, dealing Spectro DMG and applying 1 of Spectro Frazzle to the targets hit. Phoebe enters Confession status, which allows her to better exploit Spectro Frazzle.

- Absolution and Confession cannot coexist. Entering into one will end the other.

- When Divine Voice is not exhausted, Phoebe is unable to cast Heavy Attack Absolution Litany and Resonance Skill Utter Confession.

- When Divine Voice is exhausted, Phoebe will not exit the Absolution or Confession status.



Heavy Attack: Starflash

When Phoebe has Divine Voice, casting Basic Attack Stage 3 or Dodge Counter replaces the next Heavy Attack with Heavy Attack: Starflash, which deals Spectro DMG at the cost of 30 Divine Voice.

- Absolution Enhancement: Reduce the cost of Divine Voice by 15. When the targets hit have Spectro Frazzle, the skill gains 256% DMG Amplification.

- Confession Enhancement: Apply 5 of Spectro Frazzle to the targets hit.



Prayer 

Phoebe can hold up to 120 Prayer.

Phoebe automatically gains 5 Prayer every second.



Divine Voice

Phoebe can hold up to 60 Divine Voice.

Casting Heavy Attack Absolution Litany or Resonance Skill Utter Confession restores 60 Divine Voice.

weaponTexts.recommendDescription:
Main DPS: Luminous Hymn > Stringmaster > Cosmic Ripples > Ocean's Gift
Support: Luminous Hymn > Stringmaster > Ocean's Gift > Cosmic Ripples

● Luminous Hymn: Phoebe's BIS 5-star weapon. It provides Crit. Rate and ATK bonuses, both highly beneficial as Phoebe's kit relies heavily on direct DMG. Additionally, it boosts Basic Attack and Heavy Attack DMG against enemies affected by [Spectro Frazzle], which Phoebe can apply herself. Her Heavy Attack DMG-focused playstyle allows her to fully utilize this effect. The Outro Skill increases [Spectro Frazzle] DMG taken by nearby enemies, making it excellent for both DPS and support roles.
● Stringmaster: The best alternative if signature weapon is unavailable. It grants Crit. Rate and Attribute DMG bonuses while boosting ATK when dealing Resonance Skill DMG (up to 2 stacks). Since Phoebe's Resonance Skill deals two stages of DMG, it instantly maxes out the weapon’s effect.
● Cosmic Ripples: A standard 5-star weapon It provides ATK, Energy Regen, and Basic Attack DMG bonuses, all of which benefit Phoebe.
● Ocean's Gift: The best 4-star option. It boosts Spectro DMG against enemies with [Spectro Frazzle], making it an excellent fit for Phoebe.

baseTexts.roleDescription:
1. Zani is a Spectro main DPS and the core of Spectro Frazzle teams, dealing primarily Heavy Attack DMG and Spectro DMG.
2. Zani can instantly trigger the team's [Spectro Frazzle] and convert it into her own energy, enabling a stable combat cycle.
3. Some of Zani's skills stagnate enemies. Most of her skills offer Block/DMG Reduction, creating a safe window for sustained DPS and boosting her survivability.
4. Zani comes with a strong [Spectro Frazzle] DMG bonus, significantly enhancing her DMG potential.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
1. Tip: Apply [Spectro Frazzle] via teammates to convert into [Blaze]. Build up [Redundant Energy] with Basic Attacks. Use enhanced Resonance Skill to further charge [Blaze]. Activate Resonance Liberation and chain Basic Attacks to consume Blaze, then finish with enhanced Resonance Liberation before switching out.
2. Rotation: Intro Skill + 5A- Enhanced E-R1-3A*2-R2
3. Team Comp: When Zani is main DPS, the most suitable sub-DPS is Phoebe. The team setup of Zani + Phoebe + Shorekeeper works well. Please refer to the full guide for team rotation.

baseTexts.introductionDetail:
Skill Breakdown
1. Forte Circuit
     With Zani in the team, whenever an allied unit applies [Spectro Frazzle] to an enemy, it immediately triggers DMG and converts the stacks into equal amount of [Heliacal Ember] (up to 60 stacks), enabling the set bonus from [Eternal Radiance]. At the same time, Zani gains Forte Gauge [Blaze].
     While in the Inferno Mode, Zani unlocks Heavy Slash skills, treated as both Heavy Attack DMG and [Spectro Frazzle] DMG. Using these skills will consume [Blaze].
     ● [Blaze]: Up to 100 outside Inferno Mode. Up to 150 during Inferno Mode. Cast Targeted Action/Forcible Riposte to obtain 10 points. 5 points per stack when [Spectro Frazzle] converts into [Heliacal Ember]. 50 points upon using Resonance Liberation - Rekindle.
     ● [Redundant Energy]: Max cap is 100. Gain: Hit with Basic Attack/Intro Skill/Pinpoint Strike. Cast standard Resonance Skill. Cannot gain [Redundant Energy] while in Inferno Mode.
2. Resonance Liberation
     Deals Spectro DMG and enters Inferno Mode.
     ● Inferno Mode: Basic Attack multiplier increases. When [Blaze] drops below 30 or Inferno Mode lasts for 8 seconds, the Resonance Liberation will upgrade to an enhanced version. Casting the enhanced version exits Inferno Mode.
3. Resonance Skill
     ● Standard Defense Protocol: Attack and enter block state. Afterward, press Basic Attack briefly to chain into the 3rd hit, capable of stagnating enemies. Taking DMG during the block reduces incoming DMG, stagnates nearby enemies, triggers a Pinpoint Strike.
     ● Crisis Response Protocol: Available when [Redundant Energy] is full and Zani is not in Inferno Mode. Performed by holding the Resonance Skill to block. During the block, releasing the skill or when the duration ends, she will consume all [Redundant Energy] to perform Targeted Action. If attacked during the block, Zani will reduce DMG, stagnate nearby enemies, and consume all [Redundant Energy] to perform Forcible Riposte.
4. Normal Attack
     ● Basic Attack: 4-hit combo + one [Breakthrough]. A1-A2-A3-A (Breakthrough) - A4. In Inferno Mode, A3 can stagnate enemies.
     ● Heavy Attack: Consumes STA to deal Spectro DMG, followed by 3rd hit of Basic Attack.
     ● Mid-air Attack: Consumes STA to perform a Plunging Attack, followed by 3rd hit of Basic Attack.
     ● Dodge Counter: After a successful dodge, perform a Basic Attack, followed by 3rd hit of Basic Attack.
5. Intro Skill
     Attacks the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
6. Outro Skill
     Attacks the target, dealing Spectro DMG. All [Heliacal Ember] stacks are cleared, and the DMG is increased based on the number of [Heliacal Ember] stacks (considered as Spectro Frazzle DMG). Teammates deal increased Spectro DMG for 20 seconds to enemies with [Heliacal Ember].

Team Comp Analysis: Zani can instantly trigger [Spectro Frazzle] DMG and convert stack count into her startup energy, making her the core of Spectro Negative Status comps. She pairs best with characters who can reliably apply [Spectro Frazzle].

Team Comp & Rotation:
In the following rotations: A = Basic Attack; H = Heavy Attack; E = Resonance Skill; R = Resonance Liberation; Q = Echo Skill.

● Zani + Phoebe + Shorekeeper
Phoebe maintains Confession mode (Support mode) at all times, efficiently stacking [Spectro Frazzle] on enemies. Her Outro Skill reduces Spectro RES. Shorekeeper boosts Crit. Rate & Crit. DMG and provides healing.
① Shorekeeper 4AH*2-ERQ. Achieve full Concerto Energy and swap out;
② Phoebe takes the field with Intro Skill + Held E-3AH*2-RQ. Achieve full Concerto Energy and swap out;
③ Zani takes the field with Intro Skill + 5A - Held E -R1-3A*2-R2. Achieve full Concerto Energy and swap out;
④ Shorekeeper enters with Intro Skill and repeats the previous rotation.

● Zani + Phoebe + Spectro Rover
Both Phoebe and Spectro Rover apply [Spectro Frazzle]. Phoebe's Outro Skill reduces Spectro RES, and Spectro Rover gains additional Spectro RES reduction at S6.
① Spectro Rover HAA-EA-RQ-HAA without achieving full Concerto Energy;
② Phoebe Held E-3AH*2-EE-3A*2-Q. Achieve full Concerto Energy and swap out;
③ Zani takes the field with Intro Skill + 5A - Held E -R1-3A. Achieve full Concerto Energy and swap out;
④ Phoebe R;
⑤ Spectro Rover EA;
⑥ Zani 3A*2-R2. Achieve full Concerto Energy and swap out.

● Zani + Spectro Rover + Shorekeeper/Verina/Baizhi
Spectro Rover applies [Spectro Frazzle] and gains additional Spectro RES reduction at S6, with the survival role providing healing or DMG bonus.
① Healer quickly fully charges Concerto Energy;
③ Spectro Rover enters with Intro Skill + EA-HAA-EA-RQ. Achieve full Concerto Energy and swap out;
③ Zani takes the field with Intro Skill + 5A - Held E -R1-3A*2-R2. Achieve full Concerto Energy and swap out;
④ Healer enters with Intro Skill and repeats the previous rotation.

● Zani + Ciaccona + Shorekeeper/Verina
Ciaccona applies Spectro Frazzle from the off-field, while the sustain unit offers healing and buffs.
① Ciaccona starts with 4A - Dodge - 4A - R - Tap yellow button without achieving full Concerto Energy;
② Healer fully charges Concerto Energy and leaves.
③ Zani takes the field with Intro Skill + 5A-E without achieving full Concerto Energy;
④ Ciaccona enters with 4A-E- Enhanced H to fully charge Concerto Energy and leaves;
⑤ Zani takes the field with Intro Skill + R1-3A*2-R2. Achieve full Concerto Energy and swap out;

texts.name: Routine Negotiation
texts.description:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks to deal Spectro DMG.

After performing Basic Attack Stage 3, Normal Attack at the right time to perform Basic Attack Breakthrough, which can be followed by Basic Attack Stage 4 by Normal Attack again.



Heavy Attack

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG. Normal Attack within a certain time to perform Basic Attack Stage 3.



Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform a plunging attack, dealing Spectro DMG. Normal Attack within a certain time to perform Basic Attack Stage 3.



Dodge Counter

Normal Attack within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG. Then Normal Attack at the right time to cast Basic Attack Breakthrough.

texts.name: Restless Watch
texts.description:
Standard Defense Protocol

Attack the target to deal Spectro DMG and enter a block stance. This state ends early if Zani is switched off the field. Normal Attack within a certain time to perform Basic Attack Stage 3, recovering 10 points of Redundant Energy and Stagnating the target on hit.

When attacked by an enemy while in block stance, reduce this instance of damage by 100% and Stagnate nearby targets, then cast Pinpoint Strike, dealing Spectro DMG and further reducing their Vibration Strength by 5%. DMG taken by Zani is reduced by 30% within the next 2s.



Crisis Response Protocol

When Zani is not in Inferno Mode and has full Redundant Energy, her Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill Crisis Response Protocol.

Hold Resonance Skill to enter Ready Stance. While in Ready Stance, Zani is immune to interruption. This state ends early if Zani is switched off the field. After releasing Resonance Skill button or when the stance duration ends, consume all Redundant Energy to cast Targeted Action, dealing Spectro DMG, which is also considered Spectro Frazzle DMG.

When attacked by an enemy in while in Ready Stance, reduce this instance of damage by 100% and consume all Redundant Energy to cast Forcible Riposte, dealing Spectro DMG (also considered Spectro Frazzle DMG), Stagnating the target, and further reducing their Vibration Strength by 5%. DMG taken by Zani is reduced by 30% within the next 2s.

Casting Targeted Action or Forcible Riposte sends Zani into Sunburst mode and inflicts a stack of Heliacal Ember upon the target on hit. The last stage of the attack recovers Blaze.



Sunburst

The Spectro Frazzle DMG dealt by Zani to the target is Amplified by 20%.

texts.name: There Will Be A Light
texts.description:
Heliacal Ember

When Zani is in the team and a nearby Resonator inflicts Spectro Frazzle upon a target, immediately consume all Spectro Frazzle stacks and trigger the corresponding DMG, then convert Spectro Frazzle into an equal number of Heliacal Embers. Every time the conversion happens, Zani obtains Blaze based on the stacks of Heliacal Ember inflicted. Heliacal Ember is capped at 60 stacks, with each stack lasting for 6s. Heliacal Ember stacks are counted toward the Spectro Frazzle stacks for the Eternal Radiance Sonata Effect.



Scorching Light

When Zani is in Inferno Mode, Heavy Slash - Daybreak, Heavy Slash - Dawning, Heavy Slash - Nightfall, and Heavy Slash - Lightsmash become available, which deal Spectro DMG that is considered both Heavy Attack DMG and Spectro Frazzle DMG.

When Blaze is no less than 30, Resonance Skill Standard Defense Protocol is replaced with Resonance Skill Scorching Light.

Hold Resonance Skill to enter Ready Stance, during which Zani is immune to interruption. This state ends early when Zani is switched off the field. While in Ready Stance, release Resonance Skill button within a certain time to consume Blaze and perform Heavy Slash - Daybreak.

When attacked in a certain time after entering Ready Stance, reduce this instance of damage by 100% and Stagnate nearby targets, then perform Heavy Slash - Lightsmash, consuming Blazes and further reducing their Vibration Strength by 10%. Zani's DMG taken within the next 2s is reduced by 30%.

After casting Heavy Slash - Lightsmash, Basic Attack is replaced with Heavy Slash - Nightfall, consuming up to 40 Blazes on hit, with each Blaze increasing the DMG Multiplier of Heavy Slash - Nightfall. If Heavy Slash - Nightfall Stage 1 is interrupted, Basic Attack again to cast Heavy Slash - Nightfall Stage 2.

Upon releasing the button after a certain time or when Ready Stance ends, immediately perform Heavy Slash - Nightfall.

When Blaze is no less than 30, Basic Attack is replaced with Heavy Slash - Daybreak. After entering Inferno Mode, casting Basic Attack immediately replaces the current Basic Attack with Resonance Skill Scorching Light. Hold Basic Attack to enter Ready Stance.

After performing Heavy Slash - Daybreak, Basic Attack immediately to perform Heavy Slash - Dawning at the cost of Blaze.

After performing Heavy Slash - Dawning, Basic Attack is replaced with Heavy Slash - Nightfall.

If Basic Attack is not replaced with Heavy Slash - Nightfall after a successful Dodge and Zani has no less than 30 Blazes, Normal Attack within a certain time to perform Heavy Slash - Lightsmash at the cost of Blazes.



Redundant Energy

Zani can hold up to 100 Redundant Energy.

Obtain Redundant Energy when Normal Attacks hit a target.

Obtain Redundant Energy when casting Intro Skill Immediate Execution.

Obtain Redundant Energy when casting Resonance Skill Standard Defense Protocol.

Obtain Redundant Energy when casting Pinpoint Strike.

Cannot obtain Redundant Energy while in Inferno Mode.



Blaze

Blaze is capped at 100 when not in Inferno Mode.

Blaze is capped at 150 in Inferno Mode.

Casting Targeted Action or Forcible Riposte grants 10 Blazes.

Every stack of Heliacal Ember converted from Spectro Frazzle grants 5 Blazes.

Casting Resonance Liberation Rekindle grants 50 Blazes.

The Last Stand

When in Inferno Mode, Resonance Liberation The Last Stand becomes available when Blaze is lower than 30 or after 8s in Inferno Mode.

Casting Resonance Liberation The Last Stand deals Spectro DMG and ends the Inferno Mode.

roleResonanceTexts.recommendDescription:
● S1: Increased Spectro DMG can cover most core skill outputs, significantly improving DMG. Core attacks can't be interrupted., optimizing the output environment.
● S2: Increases Crit. Rate, boosts Targeted Action/Forcible Riposte multipliers, heavily increasing overall output.
● S3: While in Inferno Mode, the DMG multiplier of the last stage of enhanced Resonance Liberation can be increased based on the amount of [Blaze] consumed.
● S6: Huge boost to core attack DMG. Enables a full extra rotation while granting undying state for 8s in enhanced state.
Zani's core Resonance Chains are S1, 2, 3, and 6, all providing solid improvements. If feasible, aim for S3 for the best value. For high spenders and dedicated fans, S6 is worthwhile.

texts.name: Celestial Spiral
texts.effectDescription: Casting the Resonance Skill grants (6/7/8/9/10) Resonance Energy and increases ATK by (10%/12.5%/15%/17.5%/20%), lasting for (16/16/16/16/16)s. This effect can be triggered once every (20/20/20/20/20)s.

weaponTexts.recommendDescription:
Blazing Justice > Tragicomedy > Legend of Drunken Hero > Celestial Spiral

● Blazing Justice: Offers Crit. DMG and ATK, ignores some enemy DEF after Basic Attacks, and boosts [Spectro Frazzle] DMG. Buff uptime is nearly 100%, perfectly suited for Zani's output pattern.
● Tragicomedy: Provides Crit. Rate and ATK. Triggers a Heavy Attack DMG boost when using Basic Attacks or entering via Intro Skill. During her burst rotation, Zani's Basic Attacks count as Heavy Attacks, letting her fully utilize the weapon's buff.
● Legend of Drunken Hero: Boosts ATK, with stacking buffs triggered when Zani damages enemies with Negative Status effects, offering decent synergy.
● Celestial Spiral: Also provides an ATK boost. Restores Resonance Energy and increases ATK when casting Resonance Skills, making it moderately compatible with Zani.

baseTexts.roleDescription: Chisa, is a conscienntious, level-headed student from Startorch Academy. She sees the weaknesses in structures in the form of threads, and with her scissors, she will sever those weak points.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis: Chisa is a Havoc Broadblade user who specializes in inflicting Havoc Bane, and enhancing the team's Negative Status infliction and damage. Her gameplay consists of inflicting the Unseen Snare buff, to allow all party members who inflict or deal Negative Status damage to ignore the enemy's defense. She is also able to heal thanks to her liberation, making her a great unit to buff the party.
baseTexts.introductionDescription:
Chisa can use ATK echoes to provide more healing, while offering competetive damage. It's important to use her liberation before she begins to attack, as it amplifies all of her Sawring DMG.

You can hold Chisa's enhanced Resonance Skill to additionally pull in enemies and deal a bit of damage. Chisa can hover and move midair on her scissors, which is pretty cool...
baseTexts.introductionDetail:
Chisa is a character who will be a great asset to team's who inflict Negative Statuses. Not only is she able to fully buff the team, heal, and deal damage, but she is also able to fully stack and utilize Havoc Bane, another Negative Status, on her own. Havoc Bane decreases the target's defense by 2% per stack up to 6 stacks(12%), additionally.

 Chisa can inflict "Unseen Snare" on enemies via multiple methods. When the target marked by Unseen Snare is hit, Chisa will inflict 1 stack of Havoc Bane onto them. Chisa's Outro Skill grants a significant buff to the team. She increases the max stack of every Negative Status by 3 for 15 seconds, and every party member who inflicts or deals Negative Status DMG will be granted "Thread of Bane" which allows the user to ignore 18% of the target's defense.

Chisa excels at buffing the party and allowing the entire team to ignore enemy defense, while also stacking their Negative Status, regardless of the type.

Basic Attack

Rending Lunge
Deal Havoc DMG.
Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill on the ground to cast Death Snip.
Use Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill in mid-air to cast Hanging Finality.

Death Snip
Open the scissors, dealing Havoc DMG. After a while, the scissors snip, dealing Havoc DMG and restoring HP for all nearby Resonators in the team.
Use Normal Attack during this skill to deal additional Havoc DMG. Use Normal Attack again to immediately snip the target.
The skill DMG is considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
Normal Attack shortly after casting Death Snip to cast Thread Withdrawn.

Thread Withdrawn
Deal Havoc DMG. 
Can trigger successful Dodges within a certain time after being cast.

Heavy Attack
Leap into the air and consume STA to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
This skill cannot be cast while in Chainsaw Mode.
Perform the following actions within a certain time after casting this skill to cast Hanging Finality:
- Normal Attack;
- Cast Lifethread - Glide and Normal Attack before landing.
Hold Normal Attack before landing after casting Heavy Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Severed Facet.

Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Havoc DMG. 
While not in Chainsaw Mode, Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Heavy Attack - Severed Facet
Deal Havoc DMG. 
Use Normal Attack within a certain time after casting Heavy Attack - Severed Facet to cast Hanging Finality.
If interrupted, Heavy Attack - Severed Facet can be cast again by holding Normal Attack before landing. This effect can be triggered once only before landing.

Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Havoc DMG. 
Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill on the ground to cast Death Snip.

Dodge Counter
Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Rending Lunge.

Hold Dodge after a successful Dodge on the ground to cast Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction to attack and Stagnate the target, dealing Havoc DMG.

texts.description:
Unseen Snare
Chisa inflicts Unseen Snare on the target for 30s in the following 4 ways:
- Hitting a target with Resonance Skill.
- Hitting a target within a certain period of time after casting Serrated Loop.
- Hitting a target with Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction.
- Locking on to a target.
When targets marked by Unseen Snare take direct damage from Resonators, Chisa inflicts 1 of "Havoc Bane" on them. This effect can be triggered up to once every 2s.

Thread of Bane
When dealing damage to targets affected by "Unseen Snare", ingore 18% of their DEF.

Chainsaw Mode
While in Chainsaw Mode, Chisa unlocks Sawring - Blitz, Sawring - Eradication, Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter.
Sawring - Blitz and Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter consume "Ring of Chainsaw" on hit.

Sawring - Blitz
Sawring - Blitz chains up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG. 
Normal Attack to start the combo from Sawring - Blitz Stage 1. Hold Normal Attack to start from Sawring - Blitz Stage 2.
Hold Normal Attack while casting Sawring - Blitz Stage 2 to continuously attack the target. Sawring - Blitz Stage 2 is automatically followed by Sawring - Blitz Stage 3.
While casting Sawring - Blitz Stage 2, release the Normal Attack button or Dodge without directional input to automatically cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance, dealing Havoc DMG. Shortly after casting Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance, successful Dodges can be triggered.
Normal Attack shortly after casting Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 3.
While casting Sawring - Blitz Stage 3, hold Normal Attack to continuously attack the target. Sawring - Blitz Stage 3 is automatically followed by Sawring - Eradication.
Release Normal Attack during Sawring - Blitz Stage 3 to automatically cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone, dealing Havoc DMG.
Sawring - Blitz DMG is considered Resonance Liberation DMG.

Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter
While in Chainsaw Mode, Normal Attack following a successful Dodge to cast Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter, dealing Havoc DMG.
Normal Attack following Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 3.
Hold Normal Attack while casting Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter to sustain the attack. When Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter ends, cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 3 automatically.
Release the Normal Attack button or Dodge backwards while casting Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance automatically.
Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter deals Resonance Liberation DMG.

Sawring - Eradication
While in Chainsaw Mode, Chisa casts Sawring - Eradication in the following 2 ways:
- Normal Attack after casting Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone.
- Normal Attack after consuming all "Ring of Chainsaw" with Sawring - Blitz or Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter.
Attacking targets with Sawring - Eradication deals Havoc DMG and grants Shields to all nearby Resonators in the team for 30s.
The skill DMG is considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
Every 1 point of "Ring of Chainsaw" consumed by Sawring - Blitz and Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter increases the DMG Multiplier of the next Sawring - Eradication. Up to 100 points will be counted toward this effect.
Casting this skill consumes all "Ring of Chainsaw" and ends Chainsaw Mode.

Chainsaw Fever
While in Chainsaw Mode, "Lifethread - Jetstream" is replaced with Chainsaw Fever.
Chainsaw Fever is at 100% by default.
When Chisa goes on for a period without dealing any damage, Chainsaw Fever will rapidly deplete. Once it reaches 0, Chisa enters the Burnout State and exits Chainsaw Mode.
While in Chainsaw Mode, Chisa resets Chainsaw Fever when dealing damage or when casting Resonance Liberation Moment of Nihility, Intro Skill Reverberance - Return and Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone.
While in the Burnout State, "Ring of Chainsaw" will rapidly deplete. Once it reaches 0, Chisa exits the Burnout State.
When in Burnout State, Chisa exits the state upon dealing damage, or casting Resonance Liberation Moment of Nihility and Intro Skill Reverberance - Return.

Lifethread - Glide
When Chisa is not in Chainsaw Mode and has more than 10 points of "Lifethread - Jetstream", she can consume 50 points of "Lifethread - Jetstream" to cast Lifethread - Glide in the following 5 ways:
- Dodge in mid-air before landing after casting Heavy Attack.
- While in mid-air, Dodge before landing after casting Resonance Skill Eye of Unraveling or Rending Lunge.
- Dodge forward shortly after casting Thread Withdrawn.
- Dodge before landing when launched into mid-air.
- Dodge before landing after casting Lifethread - Glide.
Casting this skill can pull in nearby enemies marked by "Unseen Snare".
During the skill, hold Dodge to glide a short distance on the weapon.
Can trigger successful Dodges within a certain time after casting this skill.

Ring of Chainsaw
Chisa can hold up to 100 points of Ring of Chainsaw.
Hitting a target with Normal Attack and Resonance Skill Eye of Unraveling grants Ring of Chainsaw.
Casting Resonance Liberation Moment of Nihility grants 40 points of Ring of Chainsaw.
Casting Intro Skill Reverberance - Return grants 20 points of Ring of Chainsaw.

Lifethread - Jetstream
Chisa can hold up to 100 points of Lifethread - Jetstream. 
Chisa continuously obtains Lifethread - Jetstream over time.
Chisa obtains 100 points of Lifethread - Jetstream upon defeating a target. 
Exiting Chainsaw Mode resets Lifethread - Jetstream to the max limit.
Chisa cannot obtain Lifethread - Jetstream passively for a short period of time after casting Lifethread - Glide.

texts.name: Moment of Nihility
texts.description:
Deal Havoc DMG and recover HP for all nearby Resonators in the team. 
Casting this skill sends Chisa into "Woven Myriad - Convergence" for 15s.
While not in Chainsaw Mode, Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

Woven Myriad - Convergence
The DMG Multipliers of Sawring - Blitz, Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter, and Sawring - Eradication are increased by 120%.
The bonus DMG Multiplier for Sawring - Eradication granted by Sawring- Blitz and Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter when "Ring of Chainsaw" is consumed additionally increases by 120%.
Casting Sawring - Eradication ends Woven Myriad - Convergence.

texts.description:

While not in Chainsaw Mode, Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
While in Chainsaw Mode, use Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

texts.description:
Basic Attack
Perform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG.
Normal Attack shortly after casting Basic Attack Stage 2 to cast Rending Lunge. 

Rending Lunge
Deal Havoc DMG.
Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill on the ground to cast Death Snip.
Use Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill in mid-air to cast Hanging Finality.

Death Snip
Open the scissors, dealing Havoc DMG. After a while, the scissors snip, dealing Havoc DMG and restoring HP for all nearby Resonators in the team.
Use Normal Attack during this skill to deal additional Havoc DMG. Use Normal Attack again to immediately snip the target.
The skill DMG is considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
Normal Attack shortly after casting Death Snip to cast Thread Withdrawn.

Thread Withdrawn
Deal Havoc DMG. 
Can trigger successful Dodges within a certain time after being cast.

Heavy Attack
Leap into the air and consume STA to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
This skill cannot be cast while in Chainsaw Mode.
Perform the following actions within a certain time after casting this skill to cast Hanging Finality:
- Normal Attack;
- Cast Lifethread - Glide and Normal Attack before landing.
Hold Normal Attack before landing after casting Heavy Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Severed Facet.

Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Havoc DMG. 
While not in Chainsaw Mode, Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Heavy Attack - Severed Facet
Deal Havoc DMG. 
Use Normal Attack within a certain time after casting Heavy Attack - Severed Facet to cast Hanging Finality.
If interrupted, Heavy Attack - Severed Facet can be cast again by holding Normal Attack before landing. This effect can be triggered once only before landing.

Hanging Finality
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Havoc DMG. 
Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill on the ground to cast Death Snip.

Dodge Counter
Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Rending Lunge.

Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction
Hold Dodge after a successful Dodge on the ground to cast Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction to attack and Stagnate the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
- While not in Chainsaw Mode, after casting this skill, Normal Attack on the ground or use Normal Attack in mid-air to cast Rending Lunge. This effect is removed when Chisa enters Chainsaw Mode.
- While in Chainsaw Mode, Normal Attack to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 3.

- While in Chainsaw Mode and on the ground, Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 2.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Serrated Loop
While on the ground and "Ring of Chainsaw" is full, Resonance Skill is replaced with Serrated Loop.
Stagnate targets, and deal Havoc DMG and pull in nearby targets.
Casting this skill sends Chisa into Chainsaw Mode and replaces Resonance Skill with Eye of Unraveling.
Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 2.
Hold Resonance Skill while casting this skill to continuously attack and pull in nearby targets. Release the Resonance Skill button in the duration or keep holding it for a certain period of time to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 1.

Chisa is immune to interruption during Sawring - Blitz, Sawring - Eradication, and Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter

Inflicting "Unseen Snare" grants the following additional effects:
- Chisa's ATK is increased by 30% for 15s.
- Deal fixed 61803 points of Havoc DMG. The target's HP can be reduced to 61.80% at most and each target can take this damage only once. This instance of damage is considered Basic Attack DMG that does not bear any effect from damage bonuses.

Ignore 10% of the target's Havoc RES when dealing damage.
Nearby Resonators in the team with "Thread of Bane" gain 50% All-Attribute DMG Bonus.

texts.description:
Resonance Liberation Moment of Nihility gains 100% DMG Bonus.
Lifethread - Glide costs 50% less "Lifethread - Jetstream".

texts.name: Thus, Hope is Rekindled with the Rising Dawn
texts.description:
When Chisa takes a fatal blow during Sawring - Blitz, Sawring - Eradication, and Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter, she will remain standing with at least 1 HP.

"Unseen Snare" becomes Unseen Snare - Finality, which has the following effects:
- Unseen Snare - Finality has all the effects of Unseen Snare.
- Targets affected by Unseen Snare - Finality takes 30% Amplified DMG from Negative Statuses.
- Targets affected by Unseen Snare - Finality takes 40% increased DMG from Chisa.

roleResonanceTexts.recommendDescription:
S1: Grants an instance of fixed Havoc DMG whenever Chisa inflicts Unseen Snare, as well as an ATK buff. This instance of DMG is really powerful in modes featuring multiple waves of enemies, such as Whimpering Waste. Each new enemy can be inflicted by this instance of damage to quickly clear out multiple waves of weaker enemies. Additionally, increases makes Chisa immune to interruptions during certain portions of her kit.

S2: Into the Web of Endless Bonds: Very powerful boost to any character that inflicts or deals Negative Status DMG, boosting their attribute damage by 50%

S3: Immense boost to Chisa's personal damage, greatly enhancing the DMG of her Forte Circuit.

texts.effectDescription:
ATK is increased by (12%/15%/18%/21%/24%). When the wielder casts Intro Skill or inflicts Negative Statuses, they gain (8%/10%/12%/14%/16%) Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus, stacking up to (3/3/3/3/3) times for (15/15/15/15/15)s.
At max stacks, when Resonators in the team inflict Negative Statuses, they gain (24%/30%/36%/42%/48%) All-Attribute DMG Bonus for (15/15/15/15/15)s. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked.

texts.name: Wildfire Mark
texts.effectDescription: Increases ATK by (12%/15%/18%/21%/24%). Performing Intro Skill or Resonance Liberation increases Resonance Liberation DMG by (24%/30%/36%/42%/48%) for (6/6/6/6/6)s. Dealing Heavy Attack DMG extends this effect by (4/4/4/4/4)s, up to (1/1/1/1/1) time. Each successful extension gives (24%/30%/36%/42%/48%) Fusion DMG Bonus to all Resonators in the team for (30/30/30/30/30)s. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked.

texts.name: Lustrous Razor
texts.effectDescription: Increases Energy Regen by (12.8%/16%/19.2%/22.4%/25.6%). When Resonance Skill is cast, Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus is increased by (7%/8.75%/10.5%/12.25%/14%), stacking up to (3/3/3/3/3) times. This effect lasts for (12/12/12/12/12)s.

weaponTexts.recommendDescription:
Kumokiri: Chisa's signature weapon. Grants an incredible buff to Chisa when she triggers an intro skill, or inflicts a negative status, stacking up to 3 times, and buffs each Resonator in the team that inflicts a Negative Status when she is at max stacks.

Wildfire Mark: Great secondary option for Chisa, granting her Resonance Liberation damage bonus. Chisa is able to extend the effect by triggering heavy attacks during her rotation.

Lustrous Razor: Great standard option for Chisa, granting some Energy Regen, and a Resonance Liberation Buff when she casts her Resonance Skill. She is not able to utilize the passive perfectly, but it is a decent option.

baseTexts.roleDescription: Lynae is an eccentric character with Spray Bottles, and a ton of color to add to life. She uses her motorbike in combat along with paint to decimate her enemies, while also buffing her friends.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis: Lynae is a Spectro Gun Wielding character who specializes in SubDPS damage, and utilizing her Tune Shifting abilities, while also buffing her incoming allies. She utilizes in Basic Attack DMG to deal damage.
baseTexts.introductionDescription:
Lyane is a great Sub-DPS damage dealer, and can buff Resonance Liberation damage users.

She has fast forte generation, and doesn't need to be on field for long.

She offers a ton of buffs, and its important to activate each of her buffs during her rotation.
baseTexts.introductionDetail:
Lynae has two states, Default State, and Roller Skating Mode. Lynae also has a couple of unique energy mechanic with her forte, called Overflow, and Lumiflow. Overflow is used in default state, and Lumiflow is used in Roller Skating state.


In her default state, Lynae can use a heavy attack to charge up her energy, and releasing it causes her to dash forward, deal damage, and enter into Roller Skater Mode. In Roller Skater mode, she can hold down the normal attack to spam basic attacks while gliding around the enemy, which builds up Lumiflow.

At max Lumiflow, Lynae can cast Polychrome Leap, which will use 1/3 of her Lumiflow per jump, maxing out at 3. Each Jump will grant Lynae a stack of True Color, and when she reached max stacks, she can follow up her Polychrome Leap with her Enhanced Roller Skate Plunge Attack, which grants a Tune Break Boost to all allies, and inflicts either of the Tune Shifting effects on the enemy. 

Finally, her outro skill Amplifies Liberation and All Type DMG of for the incoming character.

CD: 20s.

Long press to stay as Impermanence Heron and continuously spit flames, each attack dealing 55.73% Havoc DMG.



Once the initial attack lands on any enemy, the current character regains 10 Resonance Energy. If the current character uses their Outro Skill within the next 15s, the next character's damage dealt will be boosted by 12% for 15s.



CD: 20s

echoTexts.recommendDescription: Energy Regen (at least 120%) > Crit Rate/ Crit DMG > ATK > Basic Attack DMMG

texts.name: Colors Never Fade!
texts.description:
After casting Basic Attack - Visual Impact, Lynae leaves "Spray Paint" on the ground and continuously inflicts "Photochromic Flux" on targets within the "Spray Paint" for 5s, triggered once every 2s. When "Spray Paint" is on the ground, switching to another Resonance Mode doesn't affect the "Photochromic Flux" effects inflicted by the "Spray Paint".

With Lynae in the team, the expedition motorbike's Energy Tank expands by 600 points. Lynae enters "Kaleidoscopic Parade" automatically while on the expedition motorbike and restores 20% of "Lumiflow" per second.

texts.name: "Adaptive Optics: Everyday Applications"
texts.description:
Casting Intro Skill - Time to Show Some Colors! increases Lynae's Spectro DMG Bonus by 25% for 9s. 

During "Kaleidoscopic Parade", if Lynae isn't in combat, dodging without directional input grants her Optic Camo for 15s, which will be removed when Lynae casts any skill other than dodging or is switched off the field. Performing environmental, gameplay or functional interactions, or entering combat, removes the Optic Camo. With Optic Camo, Lynae may enter the enemy's aggro range without triggering combat.

texts.name: Let's Hit the Road!

texts.name: Spectral Analysis
texts.description:
Lynae can inflict "Tune Rupture - Shifting" or "Tune Strain - Shifting" on targets.
Lynae can respond to "Tune Rupture - Interfered" and "Tune Strain - Interfered".
- Responding to "Tune Rupture - Interfered": When any Resonator in the team deals "Tune Break" DMG and inflicts the "Tune Rupture - Interfered" state, Lynae casts Tune Rupture Response - Spectral Analysis. Each target can be damaged by this skill up to once every 8s.
- Responding to "Tune Strain - Interfered": For each stack of "Tune Strain - Interfered" on the target, each point of Lynae's Tune Break Boost increases her total DMG against that target by 0.12%. When Lynae is in the team, the target's max stack limit of "Tune Strain - Interfered" is increased by 1.
When the target's Off-Tuning Level is full, Lynae can cast "Tune Break" on the target.

Normal Attack within a certain time after this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

texts.name: Chromaticity Modeling
texts.description:
Optical Sampling Stage
Lynae is in "Optical Sampling Stage" by default. While in this state, "Overflow" recovers during certain skills.

Kaleidoscopic Parade
Casting Basic Attack - Spark Collision sends Lynae into "Kaleidoscopic Parade". In this state, Lynae continuously recovers "Lumiflow" while moving on the ground or during certain periods of certain skills. Lynae will not Walk during this state, and her Running and Sprinting will be replaced by the faster Free Skating and Speed Skating.

Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap
While in "Kaleidoscopic Parade", with at least 1/3 of the max "Lumiflow", Jump is replaced by Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap.
Consume 1/3 of the max "Lumiflow" to deal Spectro DMG. Inflict "Photochromic Flux" on targets hit. Successful Dodges can be triggered within a certain time during this skill. While airborne, Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap chains up to 3 stages. Switching to another Resonator resets the combo.
While in combat, each stage of Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap cast recovers 1 point of "True Color".
Within a certain time after Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap Stage 1 Normal Attack on the ground to cast Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2.
Casting Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap Stage 2 also pulls in nearby targets.

Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash
During "Kaleidoscopic Parade", when Lynae is in mid-air with 3 points of "True Color", and Basic Attack - Visual Impact is on cooldown, Normal Attack or Resonance Skill to deal Spectro DMG and inflict "Photochromic Flux" on targets hit.
This skill consumes 3 points of "True Color".
Normal Attack within a certain time during this skill to cast Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2.

Basic Attack - Visual Impact
During "Kaleidoscopic Parade", when Lynae is in mid-air with 3 points of "True Color", and this skill is not on cooldown, Normal Attack or Resonance Skill to deal Spectro DMG and inflict "Photochromic Flux" on targets hit.
This skill consumes 3 points of "True Color" and grants all nearby Resonators in the team 40 points of Tune Break Boost for 30s.
Normal Attack within a certain time during this skill to cast Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2. 

Resonance Mode
Inflict "Photochromic Flux" when hitting a target with Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap, Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash, Basic Attack - Visual Impact and Intro Skill - Time to Show Some Colors!.
Lynae can switch between Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture and Resonance Mode - Tune Strain:
- When in Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture, "Photochromic Flux" inflicts "Tune Rupture - Shifting" on targets for 25s.
- When in Resonance Mode - Tune Strain, "Photochromic Flux" inflicts "Tune Strain - Shifting" on targets for 25s.

Tune Rupture Response - Spectral Analysis
Deal an instance of Spectro DMG, considered Tune Rupture DMG, to targets within range affected by "Tune Rupture - Interfered".

Overflow
Lynae can hold up to 120 points of Overflow.
While in "Optical Sampling Stage", "Overflow" recovers during Basic Attack, Lynae-Style Palettes, Mid-air Attack, and Dodge Counter, or when Intro Skill is cast.
When "Overflow" is full, Basic Attack - Spark Collision becomes available.
Casting Basic Attack - Spark Collision removes all "Overflow".

Lumiflow
Lynae can hold up to 120 points of Lumiflow.
During "Kaleidoscopic Parade":
- Restore 20% of Lumiflow per second when Lynae is moving on the ground/climbing, or performs a successful Dodge on the ground, or within a certain time during Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack, Kaleidoscopic Parade - Ground Heavy Attack, Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack, Kaleidoscopic Parade - Dodge Counter, Additive Color, ground Dodge, Intro Skill, or Basic Attack - To a Vivid Tomorrow!.
- Lumiflow starts to deplete by 20% per second while Lynae is staying still on the ground/climbing/swimming or off the field, or after a certain time following the use of the skills listed above.
- "Lumiflow" does not change while Lynae is not in any of the states described above.
Exiting "Kaleidoscopic Parade" removes all "Lumiflow".
With 120 points of "Lumiflow", Lynae's roller skating speed further increases. Speed Skating consumes STA over time.

True Color
Lynae can hold up to 3 points of True Color.
During combat, each time Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap is cast, gain 1 point of "True Color". With 3 points of "True Color", Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash and Basic Attack - Visual Impact become available.
Exiting "Kaleidoscopic Parade" removes all "True Color".

texts.description:

The duration of "Spray Paint" is increased by 100%. Targets within the range of "Spray Paint" are pulled in towards the center every 6s.
Lynae is now immune to interruptions during Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap and Basic Attack - Visual Impact.
During "Optical Sampling Stage", after staying in a non-combat state for 2s, restore 120 points of "Overflow" every 2s.

texts.description:
Gain 25% All DMG Amplification.
Outro Skill gains the following effect:

texts.description:
The DMG Multiplier of Basic Attack - Visual Impact and Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash is increased by 90%.
While Lynae is in combat, when "Lumiflow" is at least 120 points, gain 1 stack of Premixed Hue every 1s, up to 25 stacks. Each stack of Premixed Hue increases the Spectro DMG Bonus of Additive Color by 55%. No Premixed Hue is gained while casting Additive Color. When Additive Color ends, remove all stacks of Premixed Hue. Lynae loses a stack of Premixed Hue every 0.5s when "Lumiflow" is below 120 points.
While Lynae is out of combat, with at least 120 points of "Lumiflow", gain 1 stack of Premixed Hue every 0.5s; when "Lumiflow" is below 120 points, lose 1 stack of Premixed Hue every 1s.

texts.description: ATK is increased by 20%.

Each stack of Color of Soul increases the DMG the target takes from Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash and Basic Attack - Visual Impact by 30%. After casting Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash or Basic Attack - Visual Impact, all stacks of Color of Soul are removed.
Casting Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap resets the charges of Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack.
Lynae is immune to interruptions, and DMG taken is reduced by 30% during Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack.
Lynae now stays in "Kaleidoscopic Parade" after casting Outro Skill - Let's Hit the Road!.
The "Lumiflow" upper limit is increased from 120 to 360. At the max limit, Lynae's roller skating speed further increases.
If Intro Skill is cast during "Kaleidoscopic Parade", restore 120 points of "Lumiflow".

roleResonanceTexts.recommendDescription:
S1:Huge Damage increase to Lynae's Forte Circuit, Polychrome Leap, almost doubling its damage output. Also grants immunity to interruptions during this attack.

S2: Grants a substantial boost to Lynae's outro buff, granting an additional 25% All-DMG Amplification. S6: Vastly alters Lynae's gameplay adding many addition effects to her forte Circuit, amouning to crazy damage increases.

texts.effectDescription: Increases ATK by (12%/15%/18%/21%/24%). Casting Intro Skill or dealing Basic Attack DMG to targets increases the wielder's Basic Attack DMG Bonus by (36%/45%/54%/63%/72%) for (4/4/4/4/4)s. Each time the wielder inflicts Tune Rupture - Shifting or Tune Strain - Shifting during Basic Attacks, all DMG dealt by Resonators in the team is increased by (8%/10%/12%/14%/16%) for (30/30/30/30/30)s, up to (3/3/3/3/3) stacks. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked.
