texts.effectDescription: Increases Energy Regen by (12.8%/16%/19.2%/22.4%/25.6%). Incoming Resonator's ATK is increased by (10%/12.5%/15%/17.5%/20%) for (14/14/14/14/14)s, stackable for up to (1/1/1/1/1) times after the wielder casts Outro Skill.

weaponTexts.recommendDescription:
Spectrum Blaster: Excellent weapon for both Lynae and her teammates, as this weapon buffs the teams DMG up to 24 % every time Lynae performs a Tune Shifting effect. Great weapon for dealing significant dmg and buffing allies.

Phasic Homogenizer: Exceptional Standard Weapon for buffing Lynae's Personal dmg. Shes very easily capable of using the passive, which is 20 % DMG AMP when she performs a tune break. Very good secondary weapon choice.

Static Mist: Great Standard Gun for Buffing allies. Really good go to option if you lack other weapon choices.

baseTexts.introductionName: The Nurse of Death: Luuk Herssen
baseTexts.roleDescription:
Luuk, a Startorch Academy student in the nursing department who specializes in pure damage, rather than healing.

Luuk offers Tune Strain - Interfered effects to allow himself and his allies to increases his personal damage.

His aerial combat leaves him gliding through battle and weaving between enemies to deliver precise strikes, and finally finishing them off with his powered up Resonance Liberation.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
Luuk is a spectro gauntlet character who acts as a premier Tune Strain Interfered main damage dealer.

His entire kit is considered Basic Attack Damage.

He gains his forte from his teammates outro skills, and powers up his Resonance Liberation significantly by utilizing his Enhanced Resonance Skill.
baseTexts.introductionDescription:
Always cast Luuks Resonance Liberation after utilizing his full Forte Circuit and Enhanced Resonance Skills for the most damage output.

Golden Reflux can be used to immediately gain a stack of Tune Strain - Interfered. It can be used in Mid-Air by casting Luuks Resonance Skill. Luuk can cast a Heavy Attack to jump into the air, dealing Spectro DMG.
baseTexts.introductionDetail:
Luuk gains his Forte, Ichor Flow, when Normal Attack and Resonance Skill hit the target. Additionally, when any of Luuks teammates trigger their outro skills and swap to Luuk, he will gain 200 Ichor Flow. Upon casting Intro Skill, Luuk will gains 100 Ichor Flow. Ichor Flow caps at 300, and allow 3 cast of his Enhanced Resonance Skills.

When his Forte is filled, Luuk enters Aureate Judge State, allowing him to cast one of three Enhanced Resonance Skills. The Enhanced Resonance Skill becomes available after Basic Attack 4, or Aerial Basic Attack 3. Upon casting the Enhanced Resonance Skill 3 times, Luuk can follow up with an aerial slam to detonate the final Ichor Attack.

Each of these Resonance Skill cast grants Luuk a stack of Endnote on the Endgame, and each stack increases the damage multiplier of Luuks Resonance Liberation by 25%, up to 75%. It is very important to use Luuk's Forte Circuit and Enhanced Resonance Skills before casting his Resonance Liberation as a finisher.

Finally, Luuk's Outro Skill is a powerful attack, dealing significant Spectro Dmg.

Luuk triggers Tune Strain - Interfered by many methods. By inflicting and responding to Tune Strain - Interfered, Luuk Herssen deals more Total DMG.


By utilizing the Tune Break Boost provided by other Resonators in the team, Luuk Herssen gains substantial DMG Amplification.

texts.name: Twin Nova: Nebulous Cannon
texts.skillDescription:
Transform into a Twin Nova: Nebulous Cannon to slash enemies twice, with each attack dealing 80.51% Spectro DMG.

The Resonator with this Echo equipped in the main slot gains 12.00% Spectro DMG Bonus and 12.00% Basic Attack DMG Bonus.

CD: 8s.

If Twin Nova: Collapsar Blade is equipped in another slot on the Resonator:
- Casting Echo Skill unleashes both Nebulous Cannon and Collapsar Blade skills in quick succession, but the DMG Bonus from the Echo in the main slot remains unchanged.
- DMG dealt by Twin Nova: Collapsar Blade becomes Spectro DMG.
- Casting Basic Attacks grants 1 of Dyad Origins. Casting Resonance Skill grants 3 of Dyad Origins. Dyad Origins can stack up to 6 times and lasts for 8s. Each stack increases Echo Skill DMG by 10%, and all stacks are cleared after this Echo Skill ends.
-This skill is capped at 2 uses. Initially, this skill can be used 2 times, with 1 use added every 8s.

【续写白昼】效果最多可叠加{0}层。

texts.name: Silent Debate of Light
texts.description:
Luuk Herssen can inflict "Tune Strain - Shifting" on targets.
Luuk Herssen can respond to "Tune Strain - Interfered".
When responding to "Tune Strain - Interfered": For each stack of "Tune Strain - Interfered" on the target, each point of Luuk Herssen's Tune Break Boost increases his total DMG against the target by 0.12%. While Luuk Herssen is in the team, the max stack limit of "Tune Strain - Interfered" on a target is increased by 1.
When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, Luuk Herssen can cast "Tune Break" on the target.

texts.name: Such is Light
texts.description:
Basic Attack
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG.
Hurl out a whirling blade on Stage 3, which disappears when Luuk Herssen casts other skills that can deal damage or leaves the field.

Heavy Attack
Consume STA to jump into the air, dealing Spectro DMG.

Mid-air Attack
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks in mid-air, dealing Spectro DMG. Stage 4 is a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA.
Normal Attack or Jump to perform Basic Attack Stage 2 and 3 in mid-air.
Luuk Herssen attacks with Scythe: Dissection when the input is Normal Attack.
Luuk Herssen attacks with Scythe: Resection when the input is Jump. He also inflicts "Tune Strain - Shifting" on the target hit for 25s and reduces DMG taken by 15% for 1s.
As the active Resonator, while in mid-air, this skill's cycle will not be reset.
While in mid-air, hold Normal Attack to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA.

Dodge Counter
Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge on the ground to deal Spectro DMG. Normal Attack right after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.
Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge in mid-air to flash toward the target, dealing Spectro DMG.

texts.name: Reunion of All the Fallen
texts.description:
Golden Reflux
Flash toward the target and deal Spectro DMG. Inflict "Tune Strain - Shifting" on the target hit for 25s.
Golden Reflux has 2 charges.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Aureole of Execution
Casting Basic Attack Stage 4 or Mid-air Attack Stage 3 replaces Resonance Skill with Aureole of Execution, which deals Basic Attack DMG and inflicts "Tune Strain - Shifting" on the target hit for 25s.
Aureole of Execution has 3 forms, including Aureole of Execution: Ring, Aureole of Execution: Breach, and Aureole of Execution: Glare.
Casting any form of Aureole of Execution grants 1 of "Endnotes on the Endgame" and switches Aureole of Execution to the next form in sequence.
Switching to another Resonator resets the cycle of Aureole of Execution and Resonance Skill is reset to Golden Reflux.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Aureole of Execution: Ring
Deal Spectro DMG, and reset the Mid-air Attack cycle to Stage 1.
The next Normal Attack triggers Basic Attack - Golden Impale.
Basic Attack - Golden Impale is no longer available if Dodge Counter is cast in mid-air or Luuk Herssen is switched out in the duration.

Aureole of Execution: Breach
Spin and dash forward, dealing Spectro DMG to enemies along the path and resetting the Mid-air Attack cycle to Stage 1. Then, hurl out an "Ichor Blade".
The next Normal Attack triggers Basic Attack - Golden Impale.
Basic Attack - Golden Impale is no longer available if Dodge Counter is cast in air or Luuk Herssen is switched out in the duration.

Aureole of Execution: Glare
Hurl out Solid-State Ichor, dealing Spectro DMG and forming an Ichor Deposit on the ground.

Basic Attack - Golden Impale
Flash toward the target and deal Spectro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

Ichor Deposit
Ichor Deposit detonates automatically after 5s, dealing Spectro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

Endnotes on the Endgame
Increase the DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Rewritten in Winter's Margins by 25%, stacking up to 3 times. Casting Rewritten in Winter's Margins or switching to another Resonator removes all stacks.

texts.name: Spark from the Frost
texts.description:
Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker
When the Solid-State Ichor of Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution: Glare is hurled out, Normal Attack in mid-air to cast Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker.
Slam down from the air to detonate the "Ichor Deposit", dealing Spectro DMG (considered Basic Attack DMG) and recovering all STA.
Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker is no longer available when Resonance Liberation Rewritten in Winter's Margins is cast or Luuk Herssen is switched off the field.

Aureate Judge
With full "Ichor Flow", enter the Aureate Judge state. In this state, Luuk Herssen gains the following effects:
- "Ichor Flow" does not restore. The DMG Multipliers of all forms of Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution increase by 110%.
- Casting Aureole of Execution: Glare increases the DMG Multiplier of the next Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker and "Ichor Deposit" DMG by 110%.
- 100 points of "Ichor Flow" is consumed each time Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution is cast.
- Aureate Judge ends when "Ichor Flow" depletes.

Golden Rule
When Luuk Herssen is in the team, all other Resonators in the team gain Golden Rule. When Resonators with Golden Rule cast Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator is Luuk Herssen, remove all Golden Rules on Resonators in the team and grant Luuk Herssen 200 points of "Ichor Flow" and 12 points of Concerto Energy. Resonators in the team gain Golden Rule again after 24s. This effect does not apply in Co-op Mode.

Dawnlit Keep
Luuk Herssen gains 1 of Dawnlit Keep when he stays out of combat for over 4s or casts Intro Skill Before Injection of Dawn.
Dawnlit Keep is capped at 1 stack. When damaged, consume 1 of Dawnlit Keep to reduce the DMG taken by 60% and gain immunity to interruptions for 1s. This effect can be triggered once per second.

Radiant Reave
When Luuk Herssen performs Dodge in mid-air, he briefly stays airborne and hurls out an "Ichor Blade".
Luuk Herssen consumes STA continuously while airborne.
If Luuk Herssen is launched into mid-air, Dodge before landing to trigger this effect, up to 3 times. When he is on the ground or switched out for more than 3s, the trigger count is reset.

Ichor Blade
Deal fixed Spectro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG that is not affected by any DMG Bonus.
Only one Ichor Blade can exist at a time. It cannot trigger Counterattack.
Ichor Blade cannot be launched without a nearby target.
Ichor Blade disappears when Luuk Herssen casts other skills that deal damage or leaves the field.

Ichor Flow
Luuk Herssen holds up to 300 points of Ichor Flow.
Normal Attacks, Resonance Skill Golden Reflux, Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution, Basic Attack - Golden Impale, and Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker restore Ichor Flow on hit.
Casting Intro Skill Before Injection of Dawn restores 100 points of Ichor Flow.

texts.description:
The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Rewritten in Winter's Margins is increased by 60%. This DMG Multiplier increase effect is stackable with that of "Endnotes on the Endgame".
Inherent Skill Uncaused Diagnosis is enhanced:
When Luuk Herssen deals damage to targets inflicted with "Tune Strain - Interfered", every 10 points of Tune Break Boost he has now Amplify this instance of damage by 10%. This effect increases the DMG Amplification from 30% up to 60%.

texts.description:
The DMG Multipliers of all forms of Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution and Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker are increased by 136% in the Aureate Judge state. Casting Aureole of Execution: Glare increases the DMG Multipliers of the next Mid-Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker and "Ichor Deposit" by 136%.
Inherent Skill Pulses Under the Snow is enhanced:
Perpetuating Daytime now stacks up to 4 times.

texts.name: Pulse Thrumming Under Rime
texts.description: After a Resonator in the team deals "Tune Break" DMG, all Resonators in the team deal 20% more DMG for 20s. This effect is unstackable.

texts.name: Through the Stillness of Snowstorm
texts.description:
Intro Skill Before Injection of Dawn and Outro Skill Bow to the Last Light gain 80% DMG Bonus.
Resonance Skill Golden Reflux has its DMG Multiplier increased by 50% and Cooldown reduced by 2s, and gains 1 more charge.

texts.name: Dawn Unfurling over Frostlands
texts.description:
When Resonators in the nearby team deal "Tune Break" DMG, all forms of Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution, "Ichor Deposit", and Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker deal 30% more DMG to the target for 25s.
Each stack of "Endnotes on the Endgame" additionally grants Resonance Liberation Rewritten in Winter's Margins 40% DMG Bonus, up to 120%.
When Luuk Herssen deals damage to targets inflicted with"Tune Strain - Interfered", the stack count of "Tune Strain - Interfered" on the target is increased by 2. This effect ignores the max stack limit.

roleResonanceTexts.recommendDescription:
S2: Increases the DMG multipliers of Luuk's Resonnace Liberation, as well as the damage done by Tune Strain - Interfered effects. This is a substantial boost to his overall damage in the rotation.

S3: increase the DMG Multipliers of Luuk's Resonance Skill greatly enhancing his combat prowess. Additionally grants extra stacks of Luuk's Inherit skill, greatly increases his overall damage.

S6: Substantial boost to each part of Luuk's kit, additionally granting extreme damage boost by stacking Tune Strain - Interfered effect by 2, ignoring the stack limit.

weaponTexts.recommendDescription:
Luuk has exceptional weapon options, and is not reliant on his signature weapon. With that being said, his signature weapon is indeed his most powerful option, offering defense ignore, and Basic Attack amplificiation.

Pulsation Bracer is an exceptional option, and is easily accessible since it is a standard weapon. This weapon grants a Basic Attack Bonus from triggering Tune Strain Interfered, which is Luuk's specality.

Lastly, Abyss Surges is a decent option until you are able to upgrade to the either of the other two weapon.

baseTexts.roleDescription:
1. Lucy is a main DPS focused on Heavy Attack DMG.
2. Lucy is a Hack character within the Off-Tune mechanic. She can apply [Hack - Shifting] to enemies and trigger responses to [Hack - Interfered], dealing Hack DMG.
3. Lucy has multiple enhanced abilities and solid DPS. Her design stays highly faithful to her character concept and features a variety of unique mechanics. In particular, her Resonance Liberation hack-in offers 7 selectable effects, making her highly enjoyable to play.
4. Lucy's Outro Skill increases the next character's Basic Attack DMG, provides DMG reduction for teammates, and if that teammate can apply [Hack - Shifting], they also gain DMG Amplification for all Attributes.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
1. Tip: Enter via Intro Skill, cast 2 stages of Resonance Skill, then use Basic Attacks. Build up [TCP], then cast the enhanced Resonance Skill to enter [Algorithm Compaction]. Follow up with an enhanced Basic Attack or enhanced Heavy Attack 1, build up [Root Access], then cast enhanced Heavy Attack 2 and enhanced Heavy Attack 3. Finally, use the enhanced Resonance Liberation (select all available options before executing it).
Rotation: Intro Skill - E1E2 - A*n - Enhanced E - Enhanced A*n - Enhanced H2H3 - Enhanced R - Outro Skill.
2. Team Comp: Lucy works best with Hack characters or allies that increase Heavy Attack DMG. Her current best team is Lucy + Rebecca + Mornye.
3. Echo Set: [Shadow of Shattered Dreams] 1-pc + any 2 of the following 2-pc sets: [Rite of Gilded Revelation] / [Pact of Neonlight Leap] / [Eternal Radiance] / [Celestial Light].

baseTexts.introductionDetail:
Team Comp:
As a Hack character, Lucy focuses on Heavy Attack DMG and should prioritize allies from the Hack archetype or allies that enhance Heavy Attack DMG.
 
Team Comp & Rotation:
In the following rotations: A = Basic Attack; H = Heavy Attack; E = Resonance Skill; R = Resonance Liberation; Q = Echo Skill.
 
● Lucy + Rebecca + Mornye.
Best Team Comp! Rebecca can be obtained for free and is Lucy's best teammate!
Rebecca is also a Hack character. She provides an ATK buff for the team, increases both her own and Lucy's Tune Break Boost, and boosts Lucy's overall DMG and Heavy Attack DMG. Mornye provides DMG Amplification for all Attributes for the team, additional DMG buffs, and strong survivability.
① Mornye starts with E-A*n- Enhanced H - Enhanced E - Enhanced A*n - Ultimate H-RQ to achieve full Concerto Energy;
② Rebecca enters with Intro Skill + A*n - Enhanced H - R1 - AA - R2 to achieve full Concerto Energy;
③ Lucy enters with Intro Skill + E1E2 - A*n - Enhanced E - Enhanced A*n - Enhanced H2H3 - Enhanced R to achieve full Concerto Energy;
④ Mornye enters with Intro Skill. Enhanced E - Enhanced A*n - Ultimate H-RQ to achieve full Concerto Energy;
⑤ Rebecca enters with Intro Skill and repeats the previous rotation.
 
● Lucy + Iuno + Shorekeeper
Iuno boosts Lucy's Heavy Attack DMG and provides healing and STA regeneration through Full Moon Domain. Shorekeeper provides healing and DMG Bonus.
① Shorekeeper 4AH*2-E-RQ. Achieve full Concerto Energy and swap out;
② Iuno enters with Intro Skill + RQ- Jump -AAA-EE- Enhanced H, swap out with Outro Skill;
③ Lucy enters with Intro Skill + E1E2 - A*n - Enhanced E - Enhanced A*n - Enhanced H2H3 - Enhanced R to achieve full Concerto Energy;
④ Shorekeeper enters with Intro Skill and repeats the previous rotation.
 
● Lucy + Mortefi + Shorekeeper/Verina
Mortefi supports Lucy with Heavy Attack DMG buffs, while Shorekeeper/Verina provide healing and DMG buffs.
① Healer quickly fully charges Concerto Energy;
② Mortefi enters with Intro Skill + E - Enhanced E - 4A - Enhanced E - RQ to achieve full Concerto Energy;
③ Lucy enters with Intro Skill + E1E2 - A*n - Enhanced E - Enhanced A*n - Enhanced H2H3 - Enhanced R to achieve full Concerto Energy;
④ Healer enters with Intro Skill and repeats the previous rotation.

texts.name: Reminiscence - Nightmare: Adam Smasher
texts.skillDescription:
Cast Echo Skill to deal 16 instances of Physical DMG equal to 10.26% of ATK to the enemies within the range.
When Lucy or Rebecca has this Echo equipped in the main slot, their Crit. Rate is increased by 15% and they unlock special Echo Skills.

If equipped by Lucy:
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the Echo Skill button to deal Spectro DMG equal to 273.60% of ATK to nearby enemies.
- Hold the Echo Skill button to deal Spectro DMG equal to 273.60% of ATK to nearby enemies and enter a special moving state, increasing Lucy's movement speed while slowing nearby enemies.

If equipped by Rebecca:
- Cast Echo Skill to fire missiles, dealing 16 instances of Electro DMG equal to 17.10% of ATK to the enemies.
CD: 20s

texts.name: Ghost Cyberware
texts.description:
When Lucy is the active Resonator in the team, if she takes no damage for 8s, she gains 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} of Optical Illusion. Max 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} by default.
Optical Illusion: When attacked, reduce this instance of DMG by 100%. If Lucy is hit or launched from the attack, she immediately recovers and triggers a successful Dodge if she's on the ground. After this effect is triggered, remove 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=4} of Optical Illusion. This effect can be triggered up to 1 {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=6} every 0.5s.

texts.name: Function Cracking
texts.description:
When Resonance Skill - Payload, Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference, or Resonance Skill - Deadlock damages an Overlord Class or Calamity Class enemy, Lucy applies Botnet Mark on them for 2 min. While Botnet Mark is active, when a Resonator in the team defeats that target with direct damage, Lucy gains the Network Backdoor effect. If Rebecca is in the team, she gains the same effect.

Network Backdoor
Grants 10% All DMG Amplification and 10% additional Hack DMG Multiplier. This effect lasts for 2 min and stacks up to 2 times. At 2 stacks, additionally increases All DMG Amplification by 5% and Hack DMG Multiplier by 5%. When Lucy is downed, she can no longer gain Network Backdoor, and any existing Network Backdoor effects become invalid.

texts.name: Countermeasure Program
texts.description:
The incoming Resonator gains 25% Basic Attack DMG Amplification for 14s or until they are switched out.
Grants all Resonators in the team Countermeasure Program for 25s.
While the effect is active, when an active Resonator in the team other than Lucy inflicts Hack - Shifting, that Resonator gains 20% All DMG Amplification.
While the effect is active, when a Resonator in the team other than Lucy is attacked, Lucy grants them 30% DMG Reduction for 3s and Stagnates their attacker for 1s. This effect can only trigger up to 1 time while Countermeasure Program is active. Obtaining Countermeasure Program again resets the effective charge. 
When the All DMG Amplification is effective, switching to another Resonator ends the Countermeasure Program early.

texts.name: Data Crash
texts.description:
When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, Lucy can cast Tune Break on the target.
Responding to Hack - Interfered: when Resonators in the team trigger Tune Break on the target and cause them to be affected by Hack - Interfered, Lucy applies Hack Response - Data Crash on the target. Each target can be inflicted with this effect up to 1 every 8s.

texts.name: Locked Thread
texts.description:
Basic Attack
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG.
Hold Normal Attack right after Basic Attack Stage 1 to continuously attack the targets, dealing Spectro DMG. Hold this skill for a certain amount of time to cast Heavy Attack Stage 1.
Hold Normal Attack shortly after Basic Attack Stage 3 lands to cast Heavy Attack Stage 2.

Heavy Attack
Consume STA to lash out against the enemies with Monowire, dealing Spectro DMG.
Hold Normal Attack after Heavy Attack Stage 1 lands to cast Heavy Attack Stage 2, dealing Spectro DMG.
Normal Attack shortly after casting Heavy Attack Stage 1 to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Spectro DMG.
Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Dodge Counter
Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 4.
Hold Normal Attack shortly after this skill lands to cast Heavy Attack Stage 2.

Basic Attack - Thread Shredding
When in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy's Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack - Thread Shredding.
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.

Heavy Attack - Single Threading
When in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy's Heavy Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack - Single Threading.
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill while airborne to cast Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction.
Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill while on the ground to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.

Heavy Attack - Dual Threading
When in Algorithm Compaction and Root Access reaches 100 points, Heavy Attack - Single Threading is replaced with Heavy Attack - Dual Threading.
Consume STA and all Root Access to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill while airborne to cast Heavy Attack - Multi-threading.
Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill while on the ground to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.

Heavy Attack - Multi-threading
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG and inflicting Hack - Shifting on the target. SQL can be consumed for a 270% increase in this attack's DMG Multiplier.
Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.

Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction
When in Algorithm Compaction, Mid-air Attack is replaced with Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction.
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Spectro DMG.
Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.

Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction
When in Algorithm Compaction, Dodge Counter is replaced with Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction.
Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 3.

texts.name: Protocol Breach
texts.description:
Resonance Skill - Payload
Cast Resonance Skill - Payload to charge forward, dealing Spectro DMG and inflicting Hack - Shifting. Upon hitting the target, a follow-up attack is automatically triggered, dealing Spectro DMG and activating Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference. If no target is hit during the charge, reduce the skill CD by 70%. If the charge is interrupted or not successfully cast, the skill CD is not reduced.
Normal Attack shortly after the follow-up attack to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
Hold Normal Attack shortly after follow-up attack lands to cast Heavy Attack Stage 2.

Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference
Cast Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference to cut through the target, dealing Spectro DMG and briefly Stagnating the target, before granting Digital Handshake. 
Digital Handshake: When Lucy is not in Algorithm Compaction and is the active Resonator in the team, she gains TCP every second. This effect is removed when TCP reaches 100 points or when Resonance Liberation - Netrunner or Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive is cast.
Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Resonance Skill - Deadlock
When TCP reaches 100 points or Lucy is in Algorithm Compaction, Resonance Skill - Payload and Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference are replaced with Resonance Skill - Deadlock.
Cast Resonance Skill - Deadlock to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG and inflicting Hack - Shifting, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.
Reset the CD of Resonance Skill - Deadlock after casting Resonance Liberation - Netrunner or Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive.

texts.name: Depths of Blackwall
texts.description:
Cloud Portal
When not in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy gains TCP upon hitting a target. At 100 points of TCP, Resonance Skill - Payload and Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference are replaced with Resonance Skill - Deadlock.
Casting Resonance Liberation - Netrunner or Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive clears all TCP.

Algorithm Compaction
After casting Resonance Skill - Deadlock, Lucy enters Algorithm Compaction and gains 1 of SQL. Her Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack - Thread Shredding, and Heavy Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack - Single Threading. Lucy's Spectro DMG Bonus is increased by 65% for 8s.
While in Algorithm Compaction, casting Resonance Skill - Deadlock again will not grant SQL and Spectro DMG Bonus repetitively.
When in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy gains Root Access upon hitting a target with attacks including Basic Attack - Thread Shredding and Heavy Attack - Single Threading. Reaching 100 points of Root Access replaces Heavy Attack - Single Threading with Heavy Attack - Dual Threading. or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting Heavy Attack - Dual Threading to cast Heavy Attack - Multi-threading.
When casting Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, if Lucy has SQL, increase this attack's DMG Multiplier by 270% and remove SQL.
When casting Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, if Lucy does not have SQL, she loses 20% of current HP. If Lucy's HP is below 1%, no HP is consumed.
After casting Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, Resonance Liberation - Netrunner is replaced with Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive.
Lucy exits the the Algorithm Compaction state after casting Resonance Liberation - Netrunner or Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive, or Heavy Attack - Multi-threading is not followed up by one of these skills: Normal Attack - Locked Thread, Resonance Skill - Protocol Breach, Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination, and Tune Break - Data Crash.

Hack Response - Data Crash
Lucy deals Spectro DMG to a target inflicted with Hack - Interfered and applies the same target with Data Crash, considered Hack DMG.
Data Crash: After the target deals damage, Stagnate the target for 0.5s. Data Crash is removed after this effect is triggered.

TCP
Lucy holds up to 100 points of TCP.
Lucy gains TCP when she deals damage through Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Mid-air Attack, Dodge Counter.
Lucy gains TCP when she deals damage through Resonance Skill - Payload and Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference.
After casting Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination, casting the next Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference additionally grants 20 of TCP.

Root Access
Lucy holds up to 100 points of Root Access.
Lucy gains Root Access when she deals damage through Basic Attack - Thread Shredding, Heavy Attack - Single Threading, Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction, and Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction.

texts.name: Netrunner
texts.description:
Resonance Liberation - Netrunner
Lucy deep dives into cyberspace and pulls up the Protocol Interface for 10s. While the Protocol Interface is active, choose up to 7 different Spoofing Program effects, each requiring different RAM costs. Lucy starts with 24 of RAM.
While in the Protocol Interface, Lucy marks targets within a certain range in her view. Marked targets will be applied with all Spoofing Program effects selected afterwards. Adjust Lucy's view to mark more targets. When no target is in view, no Spoofing Program can be applied.
While in the Protocol Interface, when either the duration expires or when Normal Attack is held down, Override is triggered, which deals Spectro DMG to all marked targets before closing the Protocol Interface, considered Heavy Attack DMG. When RAM runs out or is insufficient to activate any Spoofing Programs, Normal Attack to trigger Override on all marked targets. 
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

Spoofing Program: Ping
Requires 2 RAM. Extends field of view. Lucy marks and deals Spectro DMG to all nearby targets within the effective range without having to adjust the view, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Spoofing Program: Cyberware Malfunction
Requires 4 RAM. Marked targets take 5% more DMG for 30s.
Spoofing Program: Breach Protocol
Requires 4 RAM. Marked targets' DEF is reduced by 5% for 30s.
Spoofing Program: Synapse Burnout
Requires 5 RAM. Deals Spectro DMG to all marked targets within a certain range, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement
Requires 6 RAM. Deals Hack DMG to all marked targets and reduces their ATK by 5% for 30s.
Spoofing Program: Weapon Glitch
Requires 5 RAM. Causes all marked targets' attacks to have a chance to be reduced by 100% within 30s.
Spoofing Program: Cyberpsychosis
Requires 6 RAM. Convert all marked targets to neutral units and reduce their Vibration Strength. Only effective against Common Class enemies.

Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive
When in Algorithm Compaction, after Heavy Attack - Multi-threading is cast, Resonance Liberation - Netrunner is replaced with Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive. Lucy gains all effects of Resonance Liberation - Netrunner, and the DMG Multiplier of Override is greatly increased.
After casting Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive, or when Lucy exits the Algorithm Compaction state, Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive is replaced with Resonance Liberation - Netrunner.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

texts.name: Outdated Hallucination
texts.description:
Attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG and granting Resonators in the team Involuntary Sharing, allowing them to see targets behind obstacles for 25s. Additionally, Involuntary Sharing is enhanced on Rebecca, allowing her to lock onto targets behind obstacles. If Rebecca's turret is on the field, its Overload effect is activated, increasing its DMG dealt for 4s.
If Lucy is not in Algorithm Compaction after casting this skill, Normal Attack within a certain time to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
If Lucy is in Algorithm Compaction after casting this skill, Normal Attack within a certain time to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.
After casting this skill, the next Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference additionally grants 20 points of TCP.

roleResonanceTexts.recommendDescription:
● S2: When casting either Resonance Liberation, initial [RAM] is increased to 32. After casting E2, an additional hit is triggered and treated as Heavy Attack DMG. On hit, the target additionally receives 5 Spoofing Programs (only effects with persistent duration can be applied). When casting enhanced Heavy Attack 3, if Lucy possesses SQL, its DMG multiplier is increased. Every Resonance Liberation can utilize all hack-in effects while also increasing overall DMG.

● S3: The Override multipliers and Crit. DMG of 2 types of Resonance Liberations are increased. The DMG multiplier of Spoofing Program - Cripple Movement is increased. The DMG multiplier of Hack Response - Data Crash is increased. A pure numerical upgrade that significantly boosts burst DMG.

● S6: Enemies affected by [Hack - Shifting] or currently in the [Hack - Interfered] state take increased Heavy Attack DMG and Hack DMG from Lucy. The stagnation duration triggered by Hack Response - Data Crash is extended. A massive DMG bonus that also greatly improves crowd control.
Lucy's core Resonance Chains are S2, 3, 6. S2 and S3 offer the best value. For dedicated fans, S6 is worthwhile.

weaponTexts.recommendDescription:
Spectral Trigger > Phasic Homogenizer > Solar Flame
● Spectral Trigger: Lucy's signature weapon. Provides a high Crit. DMG bonus and a stable ATK increase. Casting Resonance Skill grants stacks that increase Spectro DMG. After applying [Hack - Shifting], Heavy Attack DMG is increased and part of the target's DEF is ignored. Lucy can cast 2 consecutive stages of Resonance Skill, can apply [Hack - Shifting] herself, and primarily deals Heavy Attack DMG, making this weapon a perfect fit.

● Phasic Homogenizer: Provides a high Crit. DMG bonus and a stable ATK increase. After a teammate triggers a Tune Break Skill, Lucy gains increased DMG Amplification for all Attributes, making it highly compatible.

● Solar Flame: Provides a large Crit. Rate bonus. Dealing Basic Attack or Heavy Attack DMG grants stacks that increase ATK and Heavy Attack DMG, fitting Lucy's DPS profile well.

baseTexts.introductionName: A guide to help you get to know researcher Huaxu——Baizhi
baseTexts.roleDescription: Bai Zhi is a Huaxu researcher in the game who specializes in echo sounds. Rational thinking dominates, and she is used to taking actions rigorously and accurately. In scientific research work, she is very organized and follows her own plan to advance her work, giving people a feeling of being cold and distant. But in fact, she only focuses on her own research and work, and is not difficult to approach.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
Weapon recommendations: 1. Star Sequence Accord; 2. Fantasy Variation; 3. Echo of the Abyss
Sound Horror RecommendationRecommended：1. Recovering from the hidden world; 2. Qingyun rising from the moon
Team introduction: As one of the only three survival positions so far since the server was launched, its extension increases the total damage of the team by 30%, which can greatly increase the damage of the main C in the team, and can also restore the health of the whole team. Its resonance chain five can resurrect the unconscious characters in the team and restore 100% of their health, which can greatly improve the team's fault tolerance
baseTexts.introductionDescription: Baizhi is a four-star condensed attribute character. The weapon is a sound sensor, and she is positioned as a survival treatment assistant. Her high health limit and strong survivability can provide healing and damage to teammates based on her own attack power and health. Although has a low output and a long output shaft, it is easy to use and plays a significant role in the team.

baseTexts.roleDescription: 白芷是游戏中一名主攻回音声态的华胥研究员，理性思维主导，习惯严谨而精准地采取行动。在科研工作中，她有着很强的条理性，遵循自己的规划推进工作，给人一种冷淡疏离的感觉，但实际上她只是专注于自己的研究和工作，并非难以接近。

baseTexts.introductionName: [Advanced] What, the information should be updated? Latest strategy for Lina tide Tower version Lingyang
baseTexts.roleDescription:
1. Ling Yang is a main output character with simple operation and excellent aerial pursuit ability.

2. When the resonance circuit [Lion Soul] is fully stacked, you can hit hard and enter the flying lion aerial combat.

3. After clicking 1 chain, it has excellent resistance to interruptions and can stand up to deal with most situations.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
Weapon recommendation: Flame Judgment>All other limited five-star arm armors>Qingyuan Furious Waves>All four-star arm armors

Sound Bones Recommendation: [Ling Lie Decision Heart] and [Night-Night White Frost] are basically equal when equipped with broken branches.
With Sanhua or combined double C and other non-skills to deepen the scene, [Ningye Baishuang]>[Linglie Decision Heart].
It will strengthen skills such as repeating magic skills, [Ling Lie Decision Heart] > [Night-Night White Frost].

Skill points added: Intrinsic Skill 2>>Resonance Circuit>>Resonance Liberation>Normal Attack>=Normal Skills>Variation Skills
Inherent Skill 2 is the core source of damage, which will change qualitatively after clicking it; Resonance Circuit upgrade can increase the damage of all attacks in lion dance form; the rest can be upgraded as needed.

Team introduction:
Take the extended route and choose teammates such as Broken Branch Brandt Sanhua who can provide skills or basic attack enhancement.
Eat broken branches and wait for teammates to enter the field, open the big and then hit hard, enter the lion dance form, use basic attacks to activate skills, basic attacks to activate skills, and continuously trigger the inherent skill 2 for continuous output.

Take the combined-axis double-C route and choose teammates such as Brandt, Changli, Jiyan, etc. who can fly or can stay on the ground with long movements.
Every basic attack of Ling Yang's lion dance can be used to combine the axis and insert the output of teammates.

baseTexts.roleDescription:
1.凌阳是操作简单，空中追击能力优秀的主力输出角色。

2.共鸣回路【狮魂】叠满时即可重击进入行狮空战。

3.点出1链后抗打断能力优秀，可站撸应对大多数场合。
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
武器推荐：焰光裁定>其余所有限定五星臂铠>擎渊怒涛>所有四星臂铠

声骸推荐：带折枝情况下 【凌冽决断之心】与【凝夜白霜】基本相等。
带散华或合轴双c等无技能加深场景，【凝夜白霜】>【凌冽决断之心】。
会强化技能复读魔功等情况，【凌冽决断之心】>【凝夜白霜】。

技能加点：固有技能二>>共鸣回路>>共鸣解放>常态攻击>=常态技能>变奏技能
固有二为核心伤害来源，点出后质变；共鸣回路升级可提升舞狮形态全部攻击的伤害；剩下的按需升级即可。

配队介绍：
走延奏轮切路线选取折枝布兰特散华等提供技能或普攻加深的队友。
吃折枝等队友延奏进场，开大接重击上桩，进入舞狮形态，一下普攻一下技能，一下普攻一下技能，不断触发固有技能二进行持续输出。

走合轴双c路线选取布兰特，长离，忌炎等会飞或是动作后摇长可以留地的队友。
凌阳每一舞狮普攻都可以用来合轴，插入队友输出。
baseTexts.introductionDescription: 操作简洁，获取简单。鸣潮唯一少年角色，独特的地面洪拳与空战舞狮双形态，堆料满满。可轮椅硬抗无脑灌伤，也可合轴组队帅到飞起。

roleResonanceTexts.recommendDescription:
1链，质变共鸣链，建议有1链后再考虑培养凌阳。一链会在大招期间提供较强的抗打断能力，注意并非免疫打断，且硬抗攻击仍会受伤，高打断系数技能或高伤害技能，可以打断凌阳或直接给凌阳头像变灰。

4链，20%的全队冰伤，六个共鸣链中伤害提升最大的一个，非常团队的一个共鸣链。

6链，技能后下一次普攻获得100%普攻增伤，5ae流程下后四次普攻和连环踢可以吃到，提升第二大的共鸣链。但存在不怎么普攻的流程，会让这个链有点尴尬。

texts.name: 焰光裁定
texts.effectDescription: 攻击提升(12%/15%/18%/21%/24%)。施放普攻时，获得以下效果：自身造成伤害无视目标(8%/10%/12%/14%/16%)防御，同时自身直接造成的【光噪效应】伤害加深(50%/62.5%/75%/87.5%/100%)，持续(6/6/6/6/6)秒。重复获得时刷新持续时间。

weaponTexts.recommendDescription:
现版本首选赞妮专武焰光裁定。次选相里要专武诸方玄枢，洛可可专武悲喜剧，优诺专武万物持存的注释，以及常驻武器擎渊怒涛。

对于凌阳这种伤害类型比较杂的角色，焰光裁定提供的无视防御buff不被伤害类型局限，是目前最适合凌阳的武器。

诸方玄枢与悲喜剧紧随其后，12＋48的模板，48大招和48重击凌阳都用不上，只能吃个12全属性伤害/百分比攻击力。万物持存的注释同理，约等于诸方玄枢。

常驻五星武器擎渊怒涛，虽然被动非常契合凌阳，但是增伤数值不够高，精5后依然位于精1焰光裁定之下。

四星武器本身白值低，对比五星武器差距很大，只建议过渡使用。

texts.name: 无归的谬误

长按声骸技能，可在震击结束后，消耗耐力持续进行攻击，每次造成基于生命上限1.58%的衍射伤害；结束长按时，触发最后一击，造成基于生命上限19.82%的衍射伤害。

baseTexts.introductionName: The extremely cost-effective Four Star Fire C Chixia!
baseTexts.roleDescription:
1. Chixia is positioned as the main C, the damage attribute is melt damage, and the core skills are regarded as resonance skill damage
2. As a four-star character, it is very cost-effective and suitable for novices to open up wasteland in the early stage. When they reach graduation in the later stage, they are also a qualified main C
3. The attack frequency is fast, and the skills are divided into long and short presses, which can be stored twice
4. The ultimate move and extended skill come with AOE range damage
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
1. Operation suggestions: Basic attack and short-press skills to quickly stack bullets, long-press skills to consume bullets and hit a powerful blow [Boom], basic technique variations enter→E (short press) E (long press) RE (long press)→ Exit with extension
2. Team introduction: For the low-profile version, Chixia + Tao Qi/Yangyang + Verinai/Guardian
baseTexts.introductionDescription: Chixia is positioned as the main C. The damage attribute is melt damage. It is very cost-effective for a four-star character. It is suitable for novices to open up wasteland in the early stage. When they graduate in the later stage, they are also a qualified main C.
baseTexts.introductionDetail: Chixia, as the four-star Melta C, has good damage. The long-press skill has a powerful attack for every 30 bullets consumed. At the same time, the short-press skill also has a release mechanism. The Melta Double C team formed with Changli has a very high upper limit. In addition, its own core damage is the resonance skill damage. The low-end version is also capable of fighting with Tao Qi. The technique is also very simple. There are 4 chains of Chixia. After the variation enters the field, you can directly make a big move, and then use two long-press skills to directly increase the damage.

baseTexts.introductionName: 超具性价比的四星火C炽霞！
baseTexts.roleDescription:
1.炽霞定位主C，伤害属性为热熔伤害，核心技能视为共鸣技能伤害
2.作为四星角色非常具有性价比，适合新手前期开荒，后期达到毕业时，也是一位合格的主C
3.攻击频率快，技能分长按短按，可以储存两次
4.大招以及延奏技附带AOE范围伤害
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
1.操作建议：普攻和短按技能快速叠子弹，长按技能消耗子弹并打出强力一击【轰轰】，基础手法变奏入场→E（短按）E（长按）RE（长按）→延奏退场
2.配队介绍：低配版推荐炽霞＋桃祈/秧秧＋维里奈/守岸人
                   高配版推荐炽霞＋长离/布兰特＋维里奈/守岸人
3.声骸套装：熔山裂谷43311
baseTexts.introductionDescription: 炽霞定位主C，伤害属性为热熔伤害，为四星角色非常具有性价比，适合新手前期开荒，后期达到毕业时，也是一位合格的主C。
baseTexts.introductionDetail: 炽霞作为四星热熔主C，伤害不俗，长按技能每消耗30发子弹拥有一次强力攻击，同时短按技能也拥有脱手机制，和长离组成的热熔双C队上限非常高，加上自身核心伤害为共鸣技能伤害，低配版搭桃祈也有一战之力，手法也非常简单，有4链的炽霞，变奏进场后直接大招，再来两次长按技能，伤害直接拉满。

weaponTexts.recommendDescription:
1.炽霞的核心伤害为共鸣技能伤害，优先选择有共鸣技能伤害加成的武器，死与舞最优

3.最后无眠烈火也带有共鸣技能增伤，加上好获取，很容易满精，很适合作为过渡武器携带

The current version of Changli as a fire-type plug-in C team is quite flexible, but it requires certain techniques to test the player's understanding of the axis and team formation. It can be played alone as the main C, or it can be used as a universal sub-C to join some main players who lack the optimal sub-C solution. Among the team members, when paired with Brandt and Lupa, they form a 3c mutual transfer team. The team as a whole has a strong output level of t1. It is fully playable but the value is slightly low, and the resonance chain income is relatively conservative. It is not recommended for players other than the True Love Party to invest too much resources.


2. Basic mechanism:

Chang Li's variation, after the third period of basic attack, you can press a to release the Heart Eye Sign/Charge after the E skill and gain a layer of Lihuo at the same time. When the fourth level of Lihuo is released, you can release a strengthened heavy attack. After releasing the extended skill to leave the field, it can provide 20 Melt + 25 Resonance Liberation damage amplification for the next character to appear; Changli's E skills, Heart Eye Sign/Chong, Burning Body with Fire and other moves have a long backswing, and you can choose to combine the axis and cut people at this time to achieve the purpose of shrinking the axis;


3. Operation skills:

After the falling attack, you can immediately connect to the normal attack from the third stage; you can move to cancel the back shake of the third stage of the normal attack to increase the speed of A's release of fire; when releasing Burning Fire and Heart Eye Sign, click the space and the left mouse button at the same time to perform the falling attack at the moment when the skill is damaged, and then immediately connect to the third stage of normal attack to quickly release a layer of leaving fire; pre-inputting a heavy hit in the ultimate move animation allows priority to be used after the ultimate move is completed;


4. Team formation direction:

When Changli serves as the deputy C, he can insert skills into some main C processes with long back-swings and vacuum periods, effectively utilizing the characters' joint points to produce numerical values; as the main C, the single-C gameplay is also close to the strength of the 1-series main Cs; in the three-C mutual transfer team, it serves as an important link between the past and the next, providing good values;


5. Charging requirements:

In most gameplays, 120% resonance efficiency is generally required,

baseTexts.introductionName: 2.4版 凤仪九州，百鸟朝拜！【长离】玩法解析+养成攻略
baseTexts.roleDescription:
1.【长离】定位为火系插件c，本身拥有主c的站场时间和技能模组，同时拥有较强的合轴性能和20热熔+25共鸣解放的拐力型加深延奏
2.长离既可以在火队中承担主c位，也可以作为泛用插件插入各种角色的配队中承担二号位，同时技能范围大，aoe多的特点使其在【冥歌海墟】中表现亮眼
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
1.操作建议：

基本操作为“通过释放e技能【赫羽三相】，4下普通攻击，变奏技能【天道持枢】+平a等操作获取离火，4层离火后可长按重击释放强化回路【焚身以火】，释放大招【离火照丹心】后可获得4层离火”，基础协奏手法为：变奏冲空中重击落地a3a4 征 EAEAZRZ，延奏退场。


2.配队介绍：

目前最适配的队伍为：长离+布兰特+露帕；作为队伍主c时常用配队为长离+布兰特/露帕/散华+守岸人，作为副C时选择较为多样，可选择今汐/珂莱塔/相里要/安可＋长离＋守岸人。


3.声骸套装：

【熔山裂谷】
baseTexts.introductionDescription:
2.4最新版
【长离】定位为火系插件c，本身拥有主c的站场时间和技能模组，同时拥有较强的合轴性能和20热熔+25共鸣解放的拐力型加深延奏
长离既可以在火队中承担主c位，也可以作为泛用插件插入各种角色的配队中承担二号位，同时技能范围大，aoe多的特点使其在【冥歌海墟】中表现亮眼
baseTexts.introductionDetail:
1.角色评价：

长离当前版本作为火系插件c配队相当灵活，但是较为需求一定的手法，考验玩家对合轴和配队的理解，既可以单走作为主c，也可以当成万能副c加入一些缺少最优副c解的主力们的配队中，搭配布兰特与露帕时组成3c互拐队，队伍整体拥有t1的强势输出水平，属于完全可玩但是数值略低，且共鸣链收益较为保守，不建议真爱党以外的玩家投入过多资源。


2.基本机制：

长离的变奏，第三段普攻后，e技能后可通过点按a释放心眼征/冲同时获得一层离火，四层离火时可释放强化重击，释放延奏技能离场后可为下一位登场角色提供20热熔+25共鸣解放的伤害加深；长离的e技能，心眼征/冲，焚身以火等招式都具有较长的后摇，可以在此时选择合轴切人以达成缩轴的目的；


3.操作技巧：

下落攻击后立刻衔接普攻可从第三段开始；可通过移动取消第三段普通攻击的后摇以达成提升a出离火的速度；释放焚身以火与心眼征时，在技能出伤的一瞬间同时点击空格与鼠标左键打出下落攻击，之后便可立刻衔接第三段普通攻击迅速打出一层离火；在大招动画中预输入重击可使大招结束后优先打出焚身以火；


4.配队方向：

长离作为副c时可以将技能插入一些后摇与真空期较长的主c流程中，有效利用角色们的合轴点产出数值；作为主c时单c玩法也有接近1系主c们的实力；在三c互拐队中更是作为其中的重要一环承上启下，提供不俗的数值；


5.充能需求：

在大部分玩法中一般需求120%的共鸣效率，

texts.name: 衔火洞明
texts.description:
普攻

进行最多4段的连续攻击，造成热熔伤害。

施放地面普攻第4段后进入心眼状态，持续12秒。



空中攻击

消耗耐力，在空中进行最多4段的连续攻击，造成热熔伤害。

施放空中攻击第4段后进入心眼状态，持续12秒。



重击

在地面长按普攻，消耗耐力上挑攻击目标，造成热熔伤害。一定时间内短按普攻将会施放空中攻击第3段。



空中重击

在空中长按普攻或施放普攻心眼·冲后一定时间内短按普攻，消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成热熔伤害。一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻第3段。



闪避反击

成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成热熔伤害。

texts.name: 赫羽三相
texts.description:
心眼·劫

短按共鸣技能，长离在空间内高速攻击敌人后进入心眼状态，持续12秒，并最终施放一次向下冲刺攻击造成热熔伤害。

初始拥有2次可使用次数，每12秒可使用次数增加1次，可使用次数上限2次。

可以在空中施放。



普攻·心眼·征

心眼状态下，长离在地面短按普攻，将会施放心眼·征，快速接近敌人并造成热熔伤害，施放后退出心眼状态，此次伤害为共鸣技能伤害。



普攻·心眼·冲

心眼状态下，长离短按跳跃或在空中短按普攻，将会施放心眼·冲，快速接近敌人并造成热熔伤害，施放后退出心眼状态，此次伤害为共鸣技能伤害。

【离火】上限4层。

施放普攻心眼·征命中目标时，获得1层【离火】。

焰羽

10秒内施放重击焚身以火时攻击提升0.25，施放后效果提前结束。

进行最多4段的连续攻击，造成热熔伤害。

施放地面普攻第4段后进入心眼状态，持续12秒。



空中攻击

消耗耐力，在空中进行最多4段的连续攻击，造成热熔伤害。

施放空中攻击第4段后进入心眼状态，持续12秒。



重击

在地面长按普攻，消耗耐力上挑攻击目标，造成热熔伤害。一定时间内短按普攻将会施放空中攻击第3段。



空中重击

在空中长按普攻或施放普攻心眼·冲后一定时间内短按普攻，消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成热熔伤害。一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻第3段。



闪避反击

成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成热熔伤害。

texts.name: 成我所谋

roleResonanceTexts.recommendDescription: 长离0+1即为完全体，链子大多为较为保守的数值提升，2链全覆盖25%暴击可以把首位4c声骸的主词条换成暴击伤害，5链与6链大幅提升了本体输出，推荐真爱党酌情抽取

texts.name: 赫奕流明
texts.effectDescription: 攻击提升(12%/15%/18%/21%/24%)。造成伤害时获得1层【灼羽】，每0.5秒可获得1层。施放共鸣技能时额外获得5层。每层【灼羽】使共鸣技能伤害加成提升(4%/5%/6%/7%/8%)，可叠加14层。【灼羽】达到14层的(12/12/12/12/12)秒后，清空全部层数。

weaponTexts.recommendDescription: 武器选择上，推荐专武与常驻训刀；二者差距不大，千古的输出大概是专武的90%左右，已经有千古洑流的玩家可以酌情抽取专武，不归孤军作为四星下位武器仅推荐没有五星讯刀的玩家在过渡期使用

baseTexts.introductionName: A super-detailed guide to developing Kakaro, Solaris’s strongest resonater!
baseTexts.roleDescription:
1. Kakaro, positioned as main C of the conductive system, the core damage type is resonance liberation damage
2. Has three skills and a special variation entry animation
3. Passive after turning on the power[Killing Intent]When the stack is full, it can deliver a powerful blow
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
1. Operation suggestions: Use skills to stack three layers of passive and release Smash [Mercy] before using it. After using it, use basic attack to stack five layers of passive and release Heavy attack [Death Report], basic technique variation enters→EEEZRZ→AAAZ (repeat)→ extension exits
2. Team introduction: Kakaro + Yinlin + Shorekeeper/Virina
baseTexts.introductionDescription: Kakaro, positioned as the main C of the conductive system, the core damage type is resonance liberation damage
baseTexts.introductionDetail: As the resident main C, Kakaro does good damage. In addition to the traditional output route with Yinlin, the full passive heavy attack can also be used to combine the axis, thereby unlocking the advanced gameplay. That is to form another C, which can be Xiangli Kaname/Dark Master or Changli. This is the violent aesthetics that belongs to Kakaro!

baseTexts.introductionName: 索拉里斯最强共鸣者卡卡罗超细节养成攻略！
baseTexts.roleDescription:
1.卡卡罗，定位导电体系主C，核心伤害类型为共鸣解放伤害
2.拥有三段技能，并且有特殊的变奏入场动画
3.开大后被动【杀意】叠满，能打出一次强有力的重击
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
1.操作建议：开大前通过技能来叠三层被动并释放重击【仁慈】开大后通过普攻来叠五层被动并释放重击【死告】，基础手法变奏入场→EEEZRZ→AAAZ（重复）→延奏退场
2.配队介绍：卡卡罗＋吟霖＋守岸人/维里奈
                     卡卡罗＋相里要/散华＋守岸人/维里奈
3.声骸套装：彻空冥雷43311/不绝余音43311
baseTexts.introductionDescription: 卡卡罗，定位导电体系主C，核心伤害类型为共鸣解放伤害
baseTexts.introductionDetail: 卡卡罗作为常驻主C，伤害不错，除了搭配吟霖走传统输出路线外，满被动重击还可以用来合轴，从而解锁进阶玩法，就是再组一个C，可以是相里要/暗主或者长离，有着非常不错的效果，利用重击脱手切人这点来完成合轴，大大提高了卡卡罗操作的上限，非常适合有手法并且喜欢操作的玩家考虑，快速灌伤的同时又不失自身的优雅！这才是属于卡卡罗的暴力美学！

texts.name: 梦魇·云闪之鳞

在首位装配该声骸技能时，自身导电伤害加成提升12.00%，共鸣解放伤害加成提升12.00%。

施放声骸技能后，自身攻击提升12.00%，持续15秒。废料造成的伤害为角色的延奏技能伤害。

进行最多3段攻击，造成导电伤害。

若切换至其他角色或者一定时间内没有施放共鸣技能灭杀指令，则技能进入冷却状态。 

共鸣技能灭杀指令不会打断普攻段数。

texts.name: 猎杀使命
texts.description:
重击·「仁慈」

持有3点【残忍】时，重击替换为重击「仁慈」。

施放重击「仁慈」时，消耗3点【残忍】，造成导电伤害，此次伤害为重击伤害，并额外回复共鸣能量和协奏能量。



残忍的获取规则

【残忍】上限3点。

共鸣解放杀戮武装状态下，无法获得【残忍】。

共鸣技能灭杀指令命中目标时，获得1点【残忍】。



重击·「死告」

持有5点【杀意】时，普攻替换为重击「死告」。

施放重击「死告」时，消耗5点【杀意】，造成导电伤害，此次伤害为共鸣解放伤害，并额外回复共鸣能量和协奏能量。



【杀意】的获取规则

共鸣解放杀戮武装状态下，特殊能量替换为【杀意】。

【杀意】上限5点。

普攻猎犬剑技·狂噬影狱命中目标时，回复1点【杀意】。

texts.name: 幻影蚀刻
texts.description:

·重击的伤害提升，此次伤害为共鸣解放伤害；

roleResonanceTexts.recommendDescription: 1链作为机制链，加强了卡卡罗的循环能力，减轻了共鸣效率的压力，3链作为增伤链，开大后全程覆盖，【死告】伤害全部拉满，而且不会切人掉BUFF，有上限。最后是6链，释放重击【死告】会召唤两个分身协同作战，进一步加强了卡卡罗的攻击频率，如果掌握了4次【死告】的输出手法，该链的收益会非常恐怖！

weaponTexts.recommendDescription: 卡卡罗的核心伤害为共鸣解放伤害，优先推荐浩境粼光，共鸣解放增伤加上共鸣效率，不论是伤害还是打法循环，都是独一档！其次是今汐专武时和岁稔，共鸣技能伤害加成作为卡卡罗的第二个伤害类型，有一定占比，并且暴击武器，双爆收益会高很多，实战伤害更稳定。最后是忌炎专武苍鳞千嶂，爆伤武器高白值，重击伤害加成对应卡卡罗的重击【仁慈】，有一定占比，对比专武也仅有一点差距。

长按声骸技能，持续幻形，起飞后向下倾泻湮灭火炎，每段攻击造成55.73%的湮灭伤害。

texts.name: 无归的谬误
texts.skillDescription:
使用声骸技能，召唤无归的谬误一部分的权能，对周围的敌人造成1次基于自身生命上限15.86%的衍射伤害，使自身共鸣效率提升10%，全队角色攻击提升10%，持续20秒。

长按声骸技能，可在震击结束后，消耗耐力持续进行攻击，每次造成基于生命上限1.58%的衍射伤害；结束长按时，触发最后一击，造成基于生命上限19.82%的衍射伤害。

baseTexts.introductionName: Thunder System Collaboration Vice C [Yinlin] Character Guide 2.4 Updated Version
baseTexts.roleDescription: [Yinlin] is positioned as the cooperative sub-c of the thunder system. It can put synergy marks on multiple enemies to deal damage. At the same time, the extension has conductivity and liberation amplification. It can exist as a cooperative sub-c or a thunder team amplification.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
1. Operation suggestions:

Yin Lin's basic operation in each round is to eze and cut his teammates to warm up. After entering the variation, he will hit A and then R like crazy. Then he will play the loop Z Thousand Faced Phantom and cut his teammates to avoid the back swing, and then come back to AA to complete the harmony. The principle is that after Yinlin enters the variation, tap A to directly obtain a short section of the circuit bar with full circuit, then use r to cancel the backswing and then use the ultimate move animation to invincibly pre-enter z in advance and switch to teammates to avoid the backswing to safely release Yinlin's circuit z.

 2. Team introduction:

The most commonly used teaming as the deputy c of the thunder system is: Xiang Liyao + Yinlin + Verinay/Government; Jinxi + Yinlin + Verinay/Government; the secondary teaming is Kakaro + Yinlin + Verinay/Germany, Changli + Yinlin + Verinay/Government                                        

 3. Sound skeleton suit:

【A song played by high heaven】/【Qingyun rising from the moon】
baseTexts.introductionDescription: [Yinlin] is positioned as the cooperative sub-c of the thunder system. It can put synergy marks on multiple enemies to deal damage. At the same time, the extension has conductivity and liberation amplification. It can exist as a cooperative sub-c or a thunder team amplification.
baseTexts.introductionDetail:
1. Character evaluation: 
The current version of Yinlin exists as a thunder-type abductor. It is a standard first-generation sub-C template. It has a faster concert speed and background damage mechanism. It can be matched with the main thunder-type C phase or enter. Team Jinxi provides Jinxi with a lot of time, and both Xiangyin and Jinyin are relatively powerful teams. Even the old teams from the first generation are still capable of fighting. However, Yinlin's numerical value and resonance chain improvement are currently relatively outdated. It is not recommended to invest too much resources. It is recommended to extract XP or replenish the chain.


2. Basic mechanism:
Yinlin can quickly trigger 2 magnetic explosions through z to speed up the startup speed.
Yin Lin will enter the Magnetic Killing state after releasing the resonance skill Magnetic Killing Roar. In this state, hitting Z when fighting a group can repeatedly trigger the Magnetic Killing Burst, achieving the effect of starting the full concert at the speed of light.                                                      
Yinlin's Circuit Z will replace the Sin-Binding Mark with the Punishment Mark. Enemies with this status cannot trigger Yinlin's Magnetic Burst, which will cause a concert gap during normal startup. Please note.
After entering the Yinlin variation, you can directly click a to get a short circuit bar without any movement.


3. Basic techniques:
After warming up eze, switch the milk position to start. After the variation Yinlin enters, hit A and then r wildly, then play loop z Thousand Faced Phantom and then cut teammates to avoid the back swing. Wait for the loop z to end and switch back to aa to complete the harmony.


4. Team formation method:
The most suitable teammates are Xiangli Kaname or Imio. The former can provide it with a high turning power of 20+25, while the latter can provide a large amount of Shao through coordinated damage. Light
It is also possible to team up with Kakaluo, but the team's damage and stability are relatively poor, so it can only be used as a secondary team
Xp Dang can form a big thunder team with Changli. The two can deepen each other's liberation by 25, and are no worse than Kayin in terms of strength.


5. Charging requirements:
When playing second-hand, you usually carry a high-sky set or a light cloud set. If you have a 2-piece set with a 10% efficiency bonus, it is recommended to have an efficiency of 120%. If it is a thunder set, it is recommended to have an efficiency of 130% or more.

baseTexts.introductionName: 雷系协同副c【吟霖】角色攻略2.4更新版
baseTexts.roleDescription: 【吟霖】定位为雷系协同副c，可以对多名敌人挂上协同标记打伤害，同时延奏具有导电和解放加深，可作为协同副c或者雷队加深拐存在。
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
1.操作建议：

吟霖每轮基本操作为eze切队友暖机，变奏入场后狂点平a接r，然后打出回路z千面魅影并切队友规避后摇，然后回来aa即可满协奏。原理为吟霖变奏入场后点平a可以直接获得一小段回路条满回路，然后使用r取消后摇再利用大招动画无敌提前预输入z并切换至队友规避掉后摇即可很安全的释放吟霖的回路z。

 2.配队介绍：

作为雷系协同副c最常用的配队为：相里要+吟霖+维里奈/守岸人；今汐+吟霖+维里奈/守岸人，次级配队为卡卡罗+吟霖+维里奈/守岸人，长离+吟霖+维里奈/守岸人                                        

 3.声骸套装：

【高天共奏之曲】/【轻云出月】
baseTexts.introductionDescription: 【吟霖】定位为雷系协同副c，可以对多名敌人挂上协同标记打伤害，同时延奏具有导电和解放加深，可作为协同副c或者雷队加深拐存在。
baseTexts.introductionDetail:
1.角色评价： 
吟霖当前版本作为雷系拐存在，是标准的一代副c模板，较快的协奏速度和后台出伤机制，可以搭配雷系主c相里要或者是进入今汐队为今汐提供大量韶光，相吟和今吟都较为强力的队伍，即使是1代的老队伍在现在任有一战之力，不过吟霖的数值和共鸣链提升目前已经是较为落伍的存在，不建议投入过多资源，推荐xp党抽取或者补链。


2.基本机制：
吟霖可以通过z来快速触发2次磁殛爆发，加快启动速度。
吟霖在释放共鸣技能磁殛咆哮后会进入磁殛状态，此状态在对群时打z可以重复触发磁殛爆发，达到光速满协奏启动的效果。                                                                                          
吟霖的回路z会将缚罪标记替换为惩罚印记，拥有此状态的敌人无法触发吟霖的磁殛爆发，会导致正常启动有协奏缺口，需要注意一下。
吟霖变奏入场后点平a可以直接获得一小段回路条并且没有动作前后摇


3.基本手法：
暖机eze后切换奶位启动，变奏吟霖入场后狂点平a接r，然后打出回路z千面魅影再切队友规避后摇，等待回路z后摇结束切回来aa即可满协奏。


4.配队方法：
最适配的队友为相里要或者今汐，前者可以给其提供20+25的高额拐力，后者可以通过协同伤害提供大量韶光
与卡卡罗组队也是可以的，但是队伍伤害和稳定性都比较差，只能作为次级配队
xp党可以和长离组成大雷队，两者可以互相拐25解放加深，在强度方面也不比卡吟差。


5.充能需求：
打副c一般都是携带高天套或者轻云套，有2件套10%效率加成推荐120%效率，如果是雷套吟则推荐130%以上。

texts.name: 悬丝华刃舞
texts.description:
普攻

控制人偶“悬丝”，进行最多4段的连续攻击，造成导电伤害。



重击

消耗耐力操纵人偶“悬丝”攻击目标，造成导电伤害。



空中攻击

消耗耐力，操控人偶“悬丝”进行空中下落攻击，造成导电伤害。



闪避反击

成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成导电伤害。

texts.name: 磁殛咆哮
texts.description:
磁殛咆哮

人偶“悬丝”对目标造成导电伤害，并使吟霖进入共鸣技能磁殛状态。



磁殛状态

·普攻和闪避反击命中目标时，触发1次磁殛爆发；

·每段普攻和闪避反击仅可触发1次磁殛爆发，最多可触发4次。



磁殛爆发

攻击所有携带共鸣回路缚罪标记的目标，造成导电伤害。



召雷磁爆

施放共鸣技能磁殛咆哮后一定时间内，短按共鸣技能，将会施放召雷磁爆攻击目标，造成导电伤害。

若一定时间内没有施放共鸣技能召雷磁爆或者切换至其他角色，则技能进入冷却状态。

texts.name: 千面魅影
texts.description:
千面魅影

当吟霖【审判值】满时，重击将替换为千面魅影，消耗所有【审判值】攻击目标，造成导电伤害，命中携带缚罪标记的目标时，缚罪标记被替换为惩罚印记，持续18秒。千面魅影造成的伤害为重击伤害。



缚罪标记

常态攻击悬丝华刃舞、共鸣解放破天雷灭击或变奏技能狂雷飓风命中目标时，附加缚罪标记。

吟霖离场时缚罪标记消失。



惩罚印记

携带惩罚印记的目标受到伤害时会降下审判之雷，对所有携带惩罚印记的目标造成导电伤害，每秒最多可触发1次。审判之雷造成的伤害为共鸣技能伤害。



审判值

【审判值】上限100点。

施放变奏技能狂雷飓风时，回复【审判值】。

常态攻击悬丝华刃舞命中目标时，回复【审判值】。

施放共鸣技能磁殛咆哮时，回复【审判值】。

共鸣技能磁殛爆发命中目标时，回复【审判值】。

施放共鸣技能召雷磁爆时，回复【审判值】。

baseTexts.introductionName: A guide to getting started with the role of Xia Kong
baseTexts.roleDescription:
1. Xia Kong PositioningWind erosion effect or aerodynamic deputy C, the weapon uses a sidearm, the operation is simple, and it can increase the upper limit of the output of the wind erosion or aerodynamic team.
2. After Xia Kong casts [Resonance Liberation], he can continue to add [Wind Erosion Effect] in the background.
3. Xia Kong’s [Extension Skill] can increase the damage of [Wind Erosion Effect] by 100% for targets around the characters in the team.
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
1. Operation suggestions: Xia Kong’s main goal is to cast resonance liberation and extension skills as quickly as possible, thereby providing increased damage to the team’s main C. See the guide description for specific operating techniques.
2. Team formation introduction: Xia Kong's team formation is relatively flexible, mainly paired with [Wind Erosion Effect] main C Katishia, plus aerodynamic drifter to form a complete wind erosion team.
3. Sound skeleton suit: The first choice is [The sky where the flowing clouds disappear], which uses the [wind erosion effect] to increase aerodynamic damage for yourself and the team.
baseTexts.introductionDescription: Xia Kong is an aerodynamic deputy C with fast coordination ability and a strong ability to add [Wind Erosion Effect]. It is recommended for players who mainly cultivate the Wind Erosion Team.
baseTexts.introductionDetail:
1. Detailed explanation of skills:
① Xia Kong's normal attack mainly uses the fourth stage of normal attack to add a layer of [Wind Erosion Effect] and provide a 24% aerodynamic damage bonus, so use the fourth stage of normal attack as much as possible. Two tips: First, when the variation enters the stage, the 3rd and 4th stages of the general attack will be directly used. Second, after the two stages of air attack, the 4th stage of the general attack will be directly used.
② Xia Kong’s resonance skill is relatively simple, mainly used to add a layer of [Wind Erosion Effect] and interrupt previous actions when necessary.
③ Xia Kong's resonance circuit has 3 grids of [temperament]. When [temperament] is full, it will cast a heavy attack - four-beat ensemble, which can have the effect of gathering monsters and add a layer of [wind erosion effect].
④ Generally speaking, Xia Kong Resonance Liberation is played in situ. You can choose the playing method to choose whether to add [Light Noise Effect] or [Wind Erosion Effect]. The default selection is [Wind Erosion Effect]. You can exit after casting. This performance can be performed in the background. Switching characters does not interrupt, which is equivalent to continuously adding [Light Noise Effect] or [Wind Erosion Effect] to the enemy in the background.

2. Skill upgrade order: Resonance Liberation > Resonance Loop > Normal Attack > Resonance Skills > Variation Skills
First, upgrade Resonance Liberation, which is Xia Kong’s main character mechanism. Secondly, upgrade Resonance Loop and Normal Attack to increase Xia Kong’s output. Resonance skills and variation skills can be left untouched for now.

3. Basic cycle process:
① Xia Kong's basic attack has 4 stages. If it is a variation, the first and second stages of the general attack will be skipped. A little trick of Xia Kong is that you can use jumping or dodge/sprint to cancel the 4th animation of the basic attack to save time. When Xia Kong is casting the 4th section of the basic attack, when Xia Kong disappears, you can jump or dodge to cancel the animation.
② Basic technique 1: Variation entrance→AA jump→AA→AE→Z→Q→ZR→ (A/D selection)→ Exit with continuation
Detailed process: Variation entry→General attack 3+4 sections (jump cancels the 4th section animation of general attack)→ Two stages of air attack → The 4th stage of normal attack (resonance skill cancels the 4th stage animation of general attack) → Resonance skill → Heavy attack → Sound skeleton skill → Full [melody] heavy attack (heavy attack · Quadruple, directly cast Resonance Liberation to cancel the heavy attack animation) → Resonance Liberation → Exit with extension.
③ Basic technique 2: Variation entry→AA dodge→AAE→Z→Q→ZR→(A/D selection)→ Exit with continuation
Detailed process: Variation entry→General attack 3+4 sections (dodge/sprint cancels the 4th section animation of general attack)&ra rr;General attack 3+4 stages (resonance skill cancels the 4th stage animation of general attack)→Resonance skill→Heavy attack→Sound bones skill→Full of [melody] and heavy attack (Heavy attack·Quadruple, directly cast Resonance Liberation to cancel the heavy attack animation)→Resonance Liberation→ Exit with continuation.

4. Team formation logic:
① Wind Erosion Deputy C: Xia Kong is mainly paired with [Wind Erosion Effect] Main C Katishia, plus Aerodynamic Drifter to form a complete Wind Erosion team. Xia Kong’s various ways of adding [Wind Erosion Effect] and extended wind erosion effect to increase damage can increase the upper limit of the Wind Erosion team’s output.
② Light Noise Deputy C: If Katishia is not available, you can consider teaming up with Phoebe or Zanni, because Xia Kong can also add [Light Noise Effect] in the background, and joining the Light Noise team is also a good improvement.
③ Pneumatic secondary C: Putting aside the [abnormal effect], Xia Kong’s aerodynamic damage bonus can also improve the output capabilities of other pneumatic main Cs, such as Ji Yan.

5. Recommendation for training: Sound Corpse’s first choice is [Sky of Eternal Clouds], which uses [Wind Erosion Effect] to increase aerodynamic damage for itself and the team. The second choice is [Qingyun Chuyue] to increase the output of main C.

baseTexts.roleDescription:
1. 夏空定位风蚀效应或气动副C，武器使用佩枪，操作简洁，能提高风蚀或气动队伍的输出上限。
2. 夏空施放【共鸣解放】后，可以后台持续添加【风蚀效应】。
3. 夏空【延奏技能】可为队伍中登场角色周围的目标受到【风蚀效应】的伤害加深100%。
baseTexts.introductionSynopsis:
1. 操作建议：夏空的主要目标是尽可能快施放共鸣解放和延奏技能，进而为队伍主C提供增伤。具体操作手法见攻略描述。
2. 配队介绍：夏空配队相对灵活，主要搭配【风蚀效应】主C卡提希娅，加上气动漂泊者组成完整的风蚀队伍。
3. 声骸套装：首选【流云逝尽之空】，利用【风蚀效应】为自身和队伍提供气动伤害提升。
baseTexts.introductionDescription: 夏空是气动副C，有快速协奏能力和很强的添加【风蚀效应】能力，推荐主要培养风蚀队的玩家使用。
baseTexts.introductionDetail:
1. 技能详解：
① 夏空常态攻击主要是利用第4段普攻加一层【风蚀效应】和提供24%气动伤害加成，因此尽可能多的使用第4段普攻。两个小技巧：一是变奏入场会直接施放普攻第3段和第4段，二是空中攻击两段后也会直接施放普攻第4段。
② 夏空共鸣技能比较简单，主要用来添加一层【风蚀效应】，以及必要时打断前序动作。
③ 夏空共鸣回路是3格【音律】，【音律】满时施放重击·四拍重奏，可以有聚怪的效果并且加一层【风蚀效应】。
④ 夏空共鸣解放通俗来讲是原地演奏，可以选择演奏方式来选择是添加【光噪效应】还是【风蚀效应】，默认选择【风蚀效应】，施放后即可退场，这个演奏是可以后台进行的，切换角色不打断，相当于后台不断地给敌人添加【光噪效应】或【风蚀效应】。

2. 技能升级顺序：共鸣解放>共鸣回路>常态攻击>共鸣技能>变奏技能
首先升级共鸣解放，这是夏空的主要角色机制，其次升级共鸣回路和常态攻击，提升夏空的输出。共鸣技能和变奏技能可以先不点。

3. 基础循环流程：
① 夏空普攻共有4段，如果是变奏入场会跳过普攻第1段和第2段。夏空的一个小技巧是可以利用跳跃或闪避/冲刺来取消普攻第4段动画以节省时间，当夏空施放第4段普攻过程中，夏空消失时就可以跳或闪来取消动画了。
② 基础手法1：变奏入场→AA跳→AA→AE→Z→Q→ZR→（A/D选择）→延奏退场
详细过程：变奏入场→普攻3+4段（跳跃取消普攻第4段动画）→空中攻击两段→普攻第4段（共鸣技能取消普攻第4段动画）→共鸣技能→重击→声骸技能→满【音律】重击（重击·四拍重奏，直接施放共鸣解放取消重击动画）→共鸣解放→延奏退场。
③ 基础手法2：变奏入场→AA闪→AAE→Z→Q→ZR→（A/D选择）→延奏退场
详细过程：变奏入场→普攻3+4段（闪避/冲刺取消普攻第4段动画）→普攻3+4段（共鸣技能取消普攻第4段动画）→共鸣技能→重击→声骸技能→满【音律】重击（重击·四拍重奏，直接施放共鸣解放取消重击动画）→共鸣解放→延奏退场。

4. 配队逻辑：
① 风蚀副C：夏空主要搭配【风蚀效应】主C卡提希娅，加上气动漂泊者组成完整的风蚀队伍，夏空的多种添加【风蚀效应】方式及延奏风蚀效应增伤可提高风蚀队输出上限。
② 光噪副C：如无卡提希娅，可以考虑与菲比或赞妮配队，因为夏空也可以后台添加【光噪效应】，加入到光噪队也是不错的提升。
③ 气动副C：抛开【异常效应】，夏空的气动伤害加成也可以让其它气动主C输出能力得到提升，比如忌炎。

5. 培养推荐：声骸首选【流云逝尽之空】，利用【风蚀效应】为自身和队伍提供气动伤害提升。次选【轻云出月】，提高主C的输出。

texts.description: 目标【偏谐值】满时，可对其施放"【谐度破坏】"。

texts.name: 四拍的舞曲
texts.description:
普攻

进行最多4段的连续攻击，造成气动伤害。普攻第4段可为命中的目标添加一层【风蚀效应】。

·使用闪避打断普攻前三段时，一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放对应段数的普攻。

·普攻第4段结束后，夏空会进入音律独奏状态。夏空在主动或被动打断普攻第4段或音律独奏状态时，会生成一个合奏音影。



音律独奏

夏空或合奏音影在进入音律独奏状态时能够以自身为中心，使附近队伍中所有角色的气动伤害加成提升24%，该效果不可叠加。



合奏音影

场上最多存在2个合奏音影。

若夏空的普攻第4段被打断，合奏音影将代替夏空完成这次攻击，并进入音律独奏状态。

若夏空的音律独奏状态被打断，合奏音影将代替夏空继续音律独奏状态。

通过共鸣技能生成合奏音影时，除上述两种情况外，合奏音影将代替夏空完成这次攻击，但不进入音律独奏状态。



重击

消耗耐力并跃向空中，攻击目标，造成气动伤害。



瞄准攻击

短按瞄准键，进入瞄准状态，可以进行射击。

蓄力完成后攻击目标，造成气动伤害，此次伤害为重击伤害。



空中攻击

消耗耐力进行最多2段的攻击，造成气动伤害。

施放第2段空中攻击后一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放第4段普攻。



闪避反击

成功闪避时，一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成气动伤害。

texts.name: 谐律速奏
texts.description:
进行一段位移，对目标造成气动伤害，为命中的目标添加一层【风蚀效应】。

施放后一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放第2段普攻。

·夏空使用共鸣技能打断普攻、重击、空中攻击和音律独奏状态时，可生成一个合奏音影。

·夏空的共鸣技能可以在空中施放。

texts.name: 风与诗乐的交响
texts.description:
重击·四拍重奏

持有3格【音律】时，夏空的重击替换为重击·四拍重奏。

向前射出重奏音符，消耗所有【音律】，造成气动伤害，持续牵引周围的目标，并为命中的目标添加一层【风蚀效应】。

重击·四拍重奏可在低空施放。



【音律】的获取规则

【音律】上限3格。

施放普攻第4段和变奏技能时，可获得1格【音律】。

texts.name: 歌者的三重华彩
texts.description:
夏空与合奏音影共同演绎即兴的交响诗，对周围目标造成一次气动伤害并进入演绎状态。



演绎状态

演绎状态下，当音波进入判定圈范围时，短按绿色或黄色按钮可生成对应颜色的交响诗·主音，并回复一定协奏能量。

·演绎状态持续期间，切换至其他角色不会结束演绎状态并可自动生成交响诗·主音，自动生成的主音的颜色由切换角色前最后一个生成的主音的颜色决定。在未通过按钮交互生成交响诗·主音时直接切换至其他角色，默认自动生成绿色的主音。

·演绎状态持续期间，夏空免疫受击，受到的伤害降低50%。

·演绎状态持续期间，再次短按共鸣解放，或在切换至其他角色后再切换至夏空，可提前结束演绎状态。

·演绎状态下的合奏音影可触发音律独奏的气动伤害加成提升效果。



交响诗·主音

主音为绿色时：对周围的目标造成气动伤害，并为命中的目标添加一层【风蚀效应】。

主音为黄色时：对周围的目标造成气动伤害，并为命中的目标添加一层【光噪效应】。

texts.name: 携风吟游
texts.description:
攻击目标，造成气动伤害，为目标添加一层【风蚀效应】。

施放后一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放第3段普攻。

texts.name: 歌者的三重华彩
texts.description:
夏空与合奏音影共同演绎即兴的交响诗，对周围目标造成一次气动伤害并进入演绎状态。



演绎状态

演绎状态下，当音波进入判定圈范围时，短按绿色或黄色按钮可生成对应颜色的交响诗·主音，并回复一定协奏能量。

·演绎状态持续期间，切换至其他角色不会结束演绎状态并可自动生成交响诗·主音，自动生成的主音的颜色由切换角色前最后一个生成的主音的颜色决定。在未通过按钮交互生成交响诗·主音时直接切换至其他角色，默认自动生成绿色的主音。

·演绎状态持续期间，夏空免疫受击，受到的伤害降低50%。

·演绎状态持续期间，再次短按共鸣解放，或在切换至其他角色后再切换至夏空，可提前结束演绎状态。

·演绎状态下的合奏音影可触发音律独奏的气动伤害加成提升效果。



交响诗·主音

主音为绿色时：对周围的目标造成气动伤害，并为命中的目标添加一层【风蚀效应】。

主音为黄色时：对周围的目标造成气动伤害，并为命中的目标添加一层【光噪效应】。

texts.name: 风与诗乐的交响
texts.description:
重击·四拍重奏

持有3格【音律】时，夏空的重击替换为重击·四拍重奏。

向前射出重奏音符，消耗所有【音律】，造成气动伤害，持续牵引周围的目标，并为命中的目标添加一层【风蚀效应】。

重击·四拍重奏可在低空施放。



【音律】的获取规则

【音律】上限3格。

施放普攻第4段和变奏技能时，可获得1格【音律】。

texts.name: 四拍的舞曲
texts.description:
普攻

进行最多4段的连续攻击，造成气动伤害。普攻第4段可为命中的目标添加一层【风蚀效应】。

·使用闪避打断普攻前三段时，一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放对应段数的普攻。

·普攻第4段结束后，夏空会进入音律独奏状态。夏空在主动或被动打断普攻第4段或音律独奏状态时，会生成一个合奏音影。



音律独奏

夏空或合奏音影在进入音律独奏状态时能够以自身为中心，使附近队伍中所有角色的气动伤害加成提升24%，该效果不可叠加。



合奏音影

场上最多存在2个合奏音影。

若夏空的普攻第4段被打断，合奏音影将代替夏空完成这次攻击，并进入音律独奏状态。

若夏空的音律独奏状态被打断，合奏音影将代替夏空继续音律独奏状态。

通过共鸣技能生成合奏音影时，除上述两种情况外，合奏音影将代替夏空完成这次攻击，但不进入音律独奏状态。



重击

消耗耐力并跃向空中，攻击目标，造成气动伤害。



瞄准攻击

短按瞄准键，进入瞄准状态，可以进行射击。

蓄力完成后攻击目标，造成气动伤害，此次伤害为重击伤害。



空中攻击

消耗耐力进行最多2段的攻击，造成气动伤害。

施放第2段空中攻击后一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放第4段普攻。



闪避反击

成功闪避时，一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成气动伤害。

texts.name: 谐律速奏
texts.description:
进行一段位移，对目标造成气动伤害，为命中的目标添加一层【风蚀效应】。

施放后一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放第2段普攻。

·夏空使用共鸣技能打断普攻、重击、空中攻击和音律独奏状态时，可生成一个合奏音影。

·夏空的共鸣技能可以在空中施放。

texts.name: 和声引风
texts.description: 队伍中登场角色周围的目标受到风蚀效应的伤害加深100%，持续30秒。

texts.name: 故风的吟游序曲
texts.description: 施放共鸣技能谐律速奏时，夏空获得免疫打断的效果，持续3秒；施放普攻时，夏空的攻击提升35%，持续10秒。

texts.name: 四季的连奏之音
texts.description: 共鸣解放歌者的三重华彩持续期间队伍中的角色气动伤害加成提升40%。

texts.name: 星烁此时的即兴演奏
texts.description: 施放普攻第4段时可额外获得1格【音律】；共鸣技能谐律速奏可使用次数增加1次。

texts.name: 托卡塔与赋格
texts.description:
夏空重击四拍重奏造成伤害时无视敌人45%的防御；

夏空造成共鸣解放伤害时无视敌人45%的防御。

texts.name: 献予长夏的永恒叙诗
texts.description:
夏空共鸣解放伤害加成提升40%；

夏空共鸣解放歌者的三重华彩附近范围内的角色受到的伤害降低30%。

texts.name: 终曲未终
texts.description: 夏空或合奏音影在进入音律独奏状态时可以对周围目标造成220%的气动伤害，该伤害视为共鸣解放伤害。

roleResonanceTexts.recommendDescription: 共鸣链2提供40%高额的气动伤害加成提升，可以极大提升气动主C的输出能力。共鸣链3额外提供1格【音律】及增加1次共鸣技能使用次数可以有效改善夏空队伍的循环速度，且一定程度上可以加快【风蚀效应】叠层，让整个队伍的操作更加流畅。共鸣链6可以提升自身输出能力，提供额外范围伤害，比较适合对群输出场景，如果想用夏空打出较高伤害或提高夏空队伍的输出上限可以考虑。

texts.name: 叙别的罗曼史
texts.effectDescription: 对带有【异常效应】的怪物造成伤害时，自身攻击提升(4%/5%/6%/7%/8%)，持续(10/10/10/10/10)秒，每秒可触发1次，可叠加(4/4/4/4/4)层。

weaponTexts.recommendDescription:
推荐武器：专武【林间的咏叹调】>死与舞>停驻之烟>叙别的罗曼史>悖论喷流
夏空首选自己的专武林间的咏叹调，主要利用专武可以通过攻击带有【风蚀效应】的敌人时，降低其气动抗性，这是目前其它佩枪所不具备的独特效果，可为风蚀队或气动队进一步增强输出能力。次选五星常驻武器停驻之烟，虽然不具备风蚀或气动增伤效果，但可以为下一位变奏入场的主C提供攻击加成，加上自身共鸣效率加成，是一把不错的副C向武器。四星武器首选叙别的罗曼史，在利用【风蚀效应】输出时有不错的攻击加成。死与舞虽然伤害略高于常驻五星，但由于作为副C，伤害可以不优先考虑，因此性价比不是很高。

texts.name: 菲比
texts.skillDisplay:
基础连招：
辅助：长按共鸣技能 → 普攻*3 → 重击 → 普攻*3 → 重击 → 共鸣解放 → 声骸技能 → 延奏离场
输出：长按普攻 → 普攻*3 → 重击 → 普攻*3 → 重击 → 普攻*3 → 重击 → 普攻*3 → 重击 → 共鸣解放 → 声骸技能 → 延奏离场

texts.name: 散华
texts.skillDisplay: 基础连招：普攻*2 → 共鸣技能 → 长按普攻蓄力 → 共鸣解放 → 声骸技能 → 延奏离场

texts.name: 和光回唱
texts.effectDescription: 攻击提升(12%/15%/18%/21%/24%)。对附加了【光噪效应】的目标造成伤害时，自身普攻、重击伤害加成提升(14%/17.5%/21%/24.5%/28%)，可以叠加(3/3/3/3/3)层，持续(6/6/6/6/6)秒。施放延奏技能时，使队伍中登场角色周围的目标受到【光噪效应】伤害加深(30%/37.5%/45%/52.5%/60%)，持续(30/30/30/30/30)秒，同名效果之间不可叠加。

texts.name: 荣光节使
texts.skillDescription:
使用声骸技能，召唤荣光节使，向目标跳砸，造成118.80%的衍射伤害，并生成额外的4道【凛冽裁决】，每道造成59.40%的衍射伤害。

在首位装配该声骸技能时，自身衍射伤害加成提升12.00%，重击伤害加成提升12.00%。

技能冷却：20秒

texts.name: 此间永驻之光
texts.description: 角色为敌人添加【光噪效应】时，自身暴击提升20%，持续15秒；攻击存在10层【光噪效应】的敌人时，自身衍射伤害加成提升15%，持续15秒。

texts.name: 守岸人
texts.skillDisplay: 基础连招：普通攻击*5 → 重击 → 共鸣技能 → 声骸技能 → 普通攻击*5 → 重击 → 共鸣解放 → 延奏离场

texts.name: 维里奈
texts.skillDisplay: 普攻*5 → 共鸣技能 → 跳跃 → 普攻 *3 → 声骸技能 → 共鸣解放 → 延奏离场

texts.name: 漂泊者·气动
texts.skillDisplay: 基础连招：变奏入场→普攻*2 → 共鸣解放 → 共鸣技能 → 普攻*3 → 强化共鸣技能 → 延奏离场

texts.name: 无归的谬误
texts.skillDescription:
使用声骸技能，召唤无归的谬误一部分的权能，对周围的敌人造成1次基于自身生命上限15.86%的衍射伤害，使自身共鸣效率提升10%，全队角色攻击提升10%，持续20秒。

长按声骸技能，可在震击结束后，消耗耐力持续进行攻击，每次造成基于生命上限1.58%的衍射伤害；结束长按时，触发最后一击，造成基于生命上限19.82%的衍射伤害。

技能冷却：20秒

texts.name: 隐世回光
texts.description: 自身为友方提供治疗时，全队共鸣者攻击提升15%，持续30秒
